Title: Data Analyst Looker
Description:
¡Hola! 🙋




¿Todavía no conoces hiberus? Somos una empresa de #tecnología construida con un ingrediente diferencial, la HIPERESPECIALIZACIÓN.




Formar parte de hiberus significa crecimiento, pasión por la tecnología, interés por la innovación, ambiente laboral flexible y colaborativo, compañerismo, aprendizaje, formación continua, motivación y superación ante nuevos retos... y esto es solo el principio.




Contamos con un equipo de más de 4.500 profesionales, 46 áreas de especialización y 35 hubs de desarrollo en España, Europa, Latinoamérica, Estados Unidos y África. Somos la primera empresa tecnológica española de capital privado. En los últimos cuatro años, hemos experimentado un crecimiento exponencial, duplicando nuestro volumen de negocio año tras año. Esto nos ha permitido consolidarnos como un actor clave en el ecosistema tecnológico español y mantenernos competitivos frente a los líderes internacionales ¡Estamos redefiniendo el mapa tecnológico mundial! 🌐💻




Trabajamos muy duro, para transformar nuestra vida a través de la tecnología y queremos contar contigo para seguir creciendo. Si lo tuyo es el mundo IT, te gusta estar al día en las últimas tecnologías y quieres asumir un nuevo reto profesional ¡Sigue leyendo, te estamos buscando!




🔎¿Qué estamos buscando?

Buscamos un/a Data Analyst Senior con experiencia en Looker y Power BI, capaz de transformar necesidades de negocio en modelos analíticos, métricas y cuadros de mando de alto impacto. Queremos una persona con una sólida base en modelado de datos, orientación al cliente y capacidad para convertir información compleja en insights accionables para la toma de decisiones.

Buscamos una persona que nos ayude a seguir creciendo, con ganas de aportar y seguir evolucionando de la mano de los mejores profesionales, pero, sobre todo... ¡en hiberus buscamos buena gente! 😉




💻Algunas de tus funciones

Diseñar y mantener modelos de datos analíticos orientados a negocio.
Definir métricas, KPIs y estructuras de reporting junto a equipos de negocio.
Desarrollar, evolucionar y optimizar dashboards en Looker y Power BI.
Traducir requerimientos de negocio en soluciones analíticas escalables.
Participar en la recogida de requisitos, validación funcional y presentación de resultados a clientes.
Analizar datos y generar insights que aporten valor real al negocio.
Colaborar con equipos de Data Engineering, Arquitectura y Negocio para garantizar la calidad y consistencia del dato.
Proponer mejoras funcionales, analíticas y técnicas de manera proactiva.
Utilizar herramientas de IA para acelerar procesos de desarrollo y análisis.




💻💪🏻Habilidades y requisitos

Experiencia mínima de 4-5 años como Data Analyst o roles similares.
Experiencia demostrable en modelado de datos (dimensional, analítico o reporting).

Al menos 1 año de experiencia con Power BI, incluyendo:

Diseño de dashboards.
Modelado semántico.
Definición de KPIs y métricas.
Desarrollo con DAX.

Al menos 1 año de experiencia con Looker, incluyendo:

Desarrollo y mantenimiento de modelos en LookML.
Creación de Explores y vistas.
Desarrollo de cuadros de mando y reporting.
Conocimientos sólidos de SQL para explotación y análisis de datos.
Experiencia trabajando directamente con clientes y stakeholders de negocio.
Capacidad para comunicar resultados y presentar soluciones analíticas.
Perfil autónomo, proactivo y orientado a la resolución de problemas.
Capacidad analítica y pensamiento estructurado.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.




🙌¿Qué te ofrecemos?

💼 Contrato indefinido en una compañía puramente tecnológica, que forma parte de un gran grupo, solvente y en crecimiento.

💰 Salario fijo competitivo

🏖️ Ambiente familiar, cercano, ¡como una gran familia!

⏰ Conciliación con nuestra vida personal y laboral mediante horario flexible, desconexión digital, jornada intensiva viernes y verano.

🤙 Cultura “techie”, nos gusta estar en contacto con la tecnología, herramientas, y últimas novedades!

📚 ¡Formación! Siempre que quieras, disfrutarás de un amplio catálogo de cursos formativos, adaptados a tu perfil profesional, inquietudes y novedades del sector. Para ello, pondremos a tu disposición todo el potencial de nuestra Hiberus University y los acuerdos con los principales fabricantes.

💳 ¡Benefíciate! Programa de retribución flexible a medida: seguro médico, tarjeta de transporte público, cheques guardería, tarjeta restaurante, etc.




En hiberus estamos viviendo un crecimiento explosivo 💥 y queremos que formes parte de nuestro equipo.




Suena bien, ¿verdad? Si quieres saber más, ¡inscríbete y te contamos!




Si quieres saber más busca nuestros hashtag

#somoshiberus #lascosasocurrenaquí y conoce todo lo que hacemos.




Hablamos?




www.hiberus.com

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
Take your career to the next level with Amaris Consulting as a Data Analyst. Be part of an international team, thrive in a global group with a €800M turnover and over 1,000 clients worldwide, and an agile environment. You will join the Data team of one of our clients, working closely with business stakeholders to transform data into actionable insights. Spanish fluency is required as part of this role.




✍️ WHAT WOULD YOU NEED? ✍️

2-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar role.
Strong proficiency with SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Solid knowledge of relational databases, data modelling, and version control tools such as Git.
Familiarity with Python for data analysis and automation.
Proven experience working with reporting solutions, dashboards, and business intelligence tools.
Advanced proficiency in Spanish (written and spoken).
Intermediate level of English.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.




👉 WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions to support business decision-making.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Design, optimize, and maintain database structures to ensure data integrity and performance.
Analyse large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
Participate in data quality, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Implement reporting and monitoring solutions that provide meaningful business insights.
Stay current with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in Data Analytics and Business Intelligence.




🚀 WHY US? 🚀

Join our dynamic team of talented people and discover a world full of growth and opportunity. Here's what we offer:

Rapid growth through a personalised career path and salary assessment. 70% of our senior leaders started in entry-level positions.
Improve your skills through our Technology Academy catalogue, Udemy platform, language classes, webinars and workshops.
Take control of your training with a personal annual budget and company-paid certifications.
Enjoy flexible policies, remote work options and excellent social benefits such as transport and restaurant tickets, childcare support and private health insurance.
Benefit from our WeCare programme, which supports employees in critical situations.
Unlock your full potential, both professionally and personally.




Amaris Consulting prides itself on being an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive work environment. To this end, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, creed, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

Title: Data Analyst French Native Speaker (Python & SQL) - Spain Remote
Description:
Join us on our exciting journey!

We are recruiting a new Data Analyst with work knowledge of Python & SQL and proficient in French language.

Under guidance, performs data analytics activities related to complex business problems and issues to provide insight to decision makers. May provide analytic support for internal project teams and for external client consulting or services engagements.

If you want to play a key role in a multicultural, dynamic and committed team this could be the role for you!

Essential Functions


Under guidance, performs basic quantitative or qualitative analyses to support the development of solutions for internal or external client project teams.
Identifies and interprets trends and patterns in datasets.
Creates specifications for reports and analysis based on business needs and required or available data elements.
May directly produce datasets and reports for analysis using existing IQVIA tools.
Verifies data for accuracy and completeness.
May manipulate and transform data to optimize analyses.
Performs audits of own work or that of others to ensure conformance with established procedures or to resolve routine issues.
May work with stand alone data systems or enterprise wide tools supporting activities such as inquiry resolution, data validation, and trend analysis.


Qualifications


Bachelor's Degree Req
1-3 years of previous professional experience preferably working with pharmaceutical data. Req
Data analysis skills and working knowledge of Microsoft software tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Access), SQL, PowerBI, Python.
Works willingly and effectively with others in and across the organization to accomplish team goals.
Knowledge and understanding of the fundamental processes of the business.
Knowledge of the methods, tools and techniques related to one’s functional area.
Knowledge of the industry and an understanding of the marketplace.
Effective time management skills.


We invite you to join IQVIA™

IQVIA™ is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. We believe in pushing the boundaries of human science and data science to make the biggest impact possible – to help our customers create a healthier world. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA™ is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications and merit. We prohibit discrimination based on any unlawful consideration such as age, race, national origin, gender or other "protected status“.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights, and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com.

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

At IQVIA, we believe that diversity, inclusion, and belonging empower our mission to accelerate innovation for a healthier world. We create a culture of belonging by valuing the perspectives of all talented employees worldwide and providing them with the opportunity to power smarter healthcare for everyone, everywhere. When our talented employees bring their authentic selves and their diverse experiences to work, they enable us to accomplish extraordinary things. Multifaceted thought processes spark innovation. Multi-talented collaboration harnesses innovation to deliver superior outcomes. Likewise, as part of this culture, IQVIA is committed to ensuring effective equality between women and men, integrating it as a strategic principle in its corporate and human resources policies.

Title: PL/SQL Data Analyst (Power BI) - 100% Remote
Description:
Role Description

¡Estamos buscando el mejor talento! únete a UST

UST es una multinacional líder en servicios de tecnología digital, certificada como Top Employer, con más de 35.000 profesionales en todo el mundo y presencia en más de 30 países. Ayudamos a grandes compañías mediante soluciones tecnológicas innovadoras y proyectos de transformación digital.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos un/a PL/SQL Data Analyst con experiencia avanzada en Power BI para incorporarse a un squad Agile y participar de forma integral en el ciclo de vida de las user stories, desde el análisis de requisitos hasta la validación final con negocio.

La persona seleccionada será responsable de garantizar la calidad, consistencia y fiabilidad de la información reportada, trabajando estrechamente con equipos técnicos y usuarios de negocio para desarrollar soluciones de reporting de alto impacto.

Ubicación: 100% remoto

Idioma: Inglés nivel B1 o superior

Responsabilidades principales


Analizar requisitos funcionales y transformarlos en soluciones analíticas eficientes.
Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar dashboards, informes y visualizaciones avanzadas en Power BI.
Realizar validaciones y análisis de datos para asegurar la calidad de la información.

Title: Sr Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Location: Madrid, Spain

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


3+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have


Experience with advanced or predictive analytics using Python, R, or similar programming languages.


Why PMI?

At PMI, you'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world, and contribute to the transformation of a global organization.

We offer the opportunity to learn, innovate, grow your career, and make an impact from day one.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We believe diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Relocation support and visa sponsorship are not provided. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Spain to be considered for this role.

Title: SENIOR DATA ANALYST
Description:
Empresa líder en su sector, busca a un/a profesional con experiencia como Data Analyst.




Tu misión será convertir los datos en decisiones de producto y negocio, ayudando a los equipos a entender cómo interactúan los clientes con nuestros activos digitales y dónde existen oportunidades de mejora.




Trabajarás dentro de un entorno orientado a producto, colaborando estrechamente con Product Managers, Engineering Managers y equipos de negocio para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento, optimización y mejora de la experiencia de cliente.




Serás una referencia en analítica digital y de producto, ayudando a la organización a comprender qué está ocurriendo, por qué está ocurriendo y qué acciones deben tomarse.




Además, impulsarás el uso responsable y eficiente de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para acelerar análisis, mejorar procesos de trabajo y aumentar la capacidad de generación de insights, siempre desde una perspectiva crítica y basada en evidencias.




Funciones:




Detectar de forma proactiva anomalías, cambios de tendencia o caídas en KPIs clave, identificando sus posibles causas y proponiendo acciones correctivas.
Transformar datos complejos en insights accionables que ayuden a priorizar decisiones de producto y negocio.
Analizar el comportamiento de usuarios para identificar oportunidades de mejora en conversión, engagement, retención y experiencia digital.
Trabajar estrechamente con Product Managers y equipos tecnológicos para definir métricas de éxito, validar hipótesis y medir el impacto de iniciativas.
Diseñar y evolucionar frameworks de medición digital que permitan entender el customer journey de forma consistente a través de web, app y otros puntos de contacto.
Profundizar en el análisis de funnels, navegación, comportamiento de usuarios y patrones de conversión para detectar fricciones y oportunidades de optimización.
Participar en la definición y mejora de estrategias de atribución y medición, garantizando la calidad y fiabilidad de los datos.
Liderar análisis ad hoc de alto impacto para responder preguntas estratégicas del negocio.
Contribuir a la evolución de la cultura Data Driven de la organización, ayudando a otros equipos a interpretar correctamente los datos y utilizarlos en la toma de decisiones.
Identificar oportunidades para aplicar Inteligencia Artificial y automatización en procesos analíticos, siempre con criterio, entendiendo sus limitaciones y validando la calidad de los resultados obtenidos.




Experiencia y conocimientos técnicos:




Experiencia sólida en analítica digital y product analytics dentro de entornos eCommerce, marketplace, producto digital o negocios online.
Dominio avanzado de SQL para la extracción, transformación y análisis de datos.
Experiencia con herramientas de analítica digital como GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Adobe Analytics o similares.
Conocimiento profundo de medición web y app, definición de eventos, tracking, customer journey y modelos de atribución.
Experiencia analizando funnels de conversión, comportamiento de usuarios, retención, engagement y adopción de funcionalidades.
Experiencia trabajando con herramientas de visualización y reporting como Power BI, Looker, Tableau o similares.
Capacidad para explotar múltiples fuentes de datos y conectar señales de comportamiento procedentes de diferentes sistemas.
Valorable experiencia en entornos cloud y plataformas analíticas modernas (AWS, Athena, BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.).
Experiencia en entornos de experimentación digital, A/B Testing y análisis de impacto.




Mentalidad analítica

Capacidad para detectar rápidamente anomalías en métricas y entender qué preguntas realizar para encontrar la causa raíz.
Capacidad para convertir datos en recomendaciones concretas y priorizables.
Curiosidad constante por entender el comportamiento de usuarios.
Orientación a impacto, no únicamente a generación de informes.




Beneficios de compañía:

Retribución flexible.
% de empleado por formar parte de la compañía.
Teletrabajo hibrido.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Fraud
Description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What you will get to do


Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs
A proactive mindset — you don't wait to be asked; you spot something unusual and you dig in
Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)
Strong stakeholder management skills; you can communicate findings clearly to fraud operations, product managers, engineers, and senior leadership — and you know how to influence decisions with data across all of them.
Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams where priorities shift quickly.
Proficiency with a spreadsheet tool (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, or any other alternative)
Enjoy autonomy and a flat structure: we have millions of customers and a flat hierarchy so any individual can have an outsized impact
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field


Experience with the following would be a plus


Data governance
Python or any other scripting language
Git or any other version control tool


What we can offer you


Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.


What to expect in the hiring process


A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
Technical take-home task (SQL test).
Technical Interview with hiring manager.
A behavioural interview with the Head of Data Analytics/Science and Fraud Team.


Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Data team at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics. The Analytics pillar is split into two teams: Product Analytics, working closely with our Product teams, and Revenue Analytics, partnering directly with the Business Unit leads in the Revenue org.

The Revenue Analytics function sits at the intersection of growth, customer acquisition, lifecycle management and commercial steering, as part of the Data Analytics team. You'll join the Revenue Analytics team, led by Saghar, our Analytics Manager, who heads a team of four data analysts and you'd be the fifth. This structure means you'll spend less time fixing broken pipelines and more time uncovering high-value insights

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What’s in it for you?


Direct Business Impact: Your work will directly shape how BU Managers and Country GMs steer revenue, churn, and growth decisions across markets, with clear visibility to senior leadership.
End-to-End Business Intelligence: From acquisition and activation to churn, retention, and revenue quality, you will own the analytical narrative for your BU scope, spanning marketing performance, product adoption, and commercial health.
Local Market Influence: You will partner closely with BU Managers and local marketing teams to understand country-specific dynamics and translate data into practical commercial decisions.
Strategic Growth Partnership: You will help shape budget allocation, campaign optimisation, funnel improvements and lifecycle opportunities based on robust analytical evidence.
A Mature Stack: Work with a modern data stack including Snowflake, dbt, Python and Omni, supported by a dedicated Analytics Engineering team.
A hybrid work policy: Enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.
Modern, centrally located offices: Work from modern office spaces in prime city locations.
An international environment: Join a diverse team with colleagues from across Europe.
Mobility across locations: Opportunity to work from our offices in Madrid, Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam or Berlin.


Your Responsibilities Will Include


Business KPI Definition & Governance: Establish, define and maintain the core KPI framework for your BU scope, including revenue metrics, churn rate, activation, retention, payback, LTV and customer-quality metrics.
Steering Dashboards: Design and deliver actionable dashboards for BU Managers and Country GMs, enabling reliable performance steering across Germany and Spain.
Data Modelling & Collection: Build robust, scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad-hoc marketing analytics needs.
Project & Stakeholder Management: Lead analytical projects end-to-end, managing timelines, priorities and senior stakeholder expectations across local BUs, Marketing and Data.
Funnel & Conversion Analysis: Own the analytical view of the customer journey from first touch to activation, paying customer and retained user, identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Customer Lifecycle Analytics: Analyse onboarding, activation, retention and lifecycle campaigns, helping local teams improve customer engagement and long-term revenue quality.
Performance Marketing Analytics: Analyse paid and organic acquisition performance across channels, campaigns, audiences and markets, helping teams understand where growth is efficient and where optimisation is needed.
Experimentation & Incrementality: Support the design, measurement and interpretation of marketing experiments, including A/B tests, landing-page tests, lifecycle tests and channel tests.
Cross-functional Connectivity: Bridge insights across Revenue, Product, Marketing, Finance and Customer Success, ensuring a unified view of customer acquisition, value creation and retention.


📍 Job located in Berlin or Madrid, with possibility of two remote working days per week

About You


Experience: 5+ years in Data Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Growth Analytics or Revenue Analytics, ideally in a SaaS, fintech, subscription, marketplace or digital product environment.
Technical Excellence: Expert-level SQL and solid experience with dbt (modelling, testing, and documentation).
Business & Revenue Analytics Expertise: Strong understanding of revenue metrics (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, payback), customer lifecycle and funnel analytics and commercial KPI frameworks. Marketing analytics experience is a strong plus.
Analytical Breadth: Comfortable working across forecasting, LTV modelling, funnel analysis, and operational KPI frameworks.
Communication: Ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable recommendations for senior non-technical stakeholders.
Language: Fluent in English. German is strongly preferred for the German market scope; Spanish would be beneficial for the Spain market scope.
Nice to have: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Hightouch, Census, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads or similar.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Technical Call (60’): Discussion with Julian (Head of Data Analytics)

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation + a technical SQL assessment. (75’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Meet the team (30')

Title: Sr. Data Analyst - Monetization (Remote)
Description:
Who We Are (Mode.Inc)

Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities.

Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be the analytical partner to our Monetization team. You'll own how we measure and grow revenue across our portfolio of mobile apps and web properties, spanning subscriptions, in-app purchases, advertising, and partner offers, and turn that into clear recommendations on pricing, packaging, and revenue mix. The ideal candidate has exceptional SQL and Python skills, hands-on experience with consumer subscription apps, and the rigor to design pricing experiments that hold up.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain common datasets and data pipelines that strengthen self-service analytics and enable data-driven decision making across the organization
Improve data quality, accuracy, reliability, and documentation to strengthen self-service analytics
Own revenue and monetization metrics across the portfolio, including ARPU/ARPDAU, LTV, trial-to-paid conversion, renewal and churn rates, refunds, and revenue mix by source
Design and analyze pricing, packaging, and paywall experiments (price points, trial length, plan structure, paywall placement and copy), and read results with statistical rigor
Build subscription cohort and LTV models that inform pricing decisions and feed back into UA bidding and payback targets
Analyze ad monetization performance, including eCPM, fill rate, impressions per user, and mediation/bidding setup, and balance ad revenue against retention and user experience
Measure the economics of partner offers and rewards, including revenue earned vs. rewards paid out, to keep the rewards model profitable
Reconcile revenue data across app stores, subscription platforms, ad networks, and internal systems, and investigate discrepancies
Partner with Monetization, Product, and GMs on revenue forecasting, opportunity sizing, and roadmap prioritization
Communicate analytical findings through clear, compelling narratives to drive alignment, inform prioritization, and deliver measurable business impact


What You Bring to the Team


Analytical excellence to dissect complex, ambiguous problems and uncover actionable insights
Solid SQL and Python programming skills, and experience working with large-scale production data
Business acumen to translate data and analysis into business impact
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate in a highly cross-functional environment
4+ years in analytics, preferred background in monetization, pricing, or revenue analytics for consumer subscription apps & games
Experience with LTV modeling and revenue forecasting on subscription and ad monetized apps/games
Track record of designing and interpreting pricing or paywall A/B tests, including pitfalls like novelty effects, long conversion windows, and LTV vs. short-term conversion tradeoffs
Familiarity with app store subscription mechanics (App Store/Google Play billing, trials, grace periods, renewals, refunds) and subscription platforms (e.g., RevenueCat, Superwall, Adapty)
Nice to have: experience with ad mediation experience (AppLovin MAX, ironSource/Unity LevelPlay, AdMob), web checkout or web-to-app payments, rewards or loyalty program economics, Big Data tools (Redshift/Spark/Airflow), dashboarding tools (Looker, Tableau), experiment design, predictive modeling, log analysis, AI, or experience in tech or startup environments


Alignment with Our Core Values:


Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.


You'll Thrive Here If You Are


Analytical
Pragmatic
Curious
Communicative
Action-Driven
Collaborative


Why Join Mode Mobile


High ownership and autonomy across business units
Direct impact on product, revenue, and user experiences
Strong partners across engineering, product, growth, and content
Opportunities to shape Mode's analytics function and data culture
A fast-moving, supportive, global remote environment


We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms


Allow OKRs to Guide Us
Assume Positive Intent
Agree to Disagree & Commit
Set New Precedents
Accomplish More with Less
Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
Speak Up
Be Resourceful
Follow the 80/20 Rule


What We Are Offering


We are a 100% remote-first, global company.
A competitive compensation package.
We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full-time team members).
We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people.
Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
Bonusly - We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full-time team members).

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About the role:

We are looking for a responsible and hard-working Senior Data Analyst to join our efforts in taking over the print-on-demand industry. You would work in an international environment with talented teammates in a casual atmosphere. You’ll have your hands on very rich and diverse data related to the print-on-demand universe.

Your daily tasks will include:


Acting as a go-to data person within your respective team
Engaging in product analytics, ops analytics and business analytics
Continuously improving your team's product features with suggestions from ad-hoc and regular data analysis
Analyzing internal, market, and customer levels of data regarding various business areas
Translating data into actionable insights


You’ll level up fast by building production-grade analytics with state-of-the-art tools—Snowflake Intelligence, Streamlit in Snowflake, Amplitude, and more—gaining real ownership, mentorship, and impact at scale. In collaboration with our data engineers, you will define data models and ensure data quality through rigorous QA processes. You will work with Looker's analytical layer, defining explores, measures, and dimensions to support robust data exploration.

Your qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, physics, economics or a related quantitative field required
Strong written & verbal English communication skills
At least 4 years of professional experience in data analysis
Demonstrated ability to present and clearly articulate summarized data analysis results
Advanced SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or similar data warehouses
Proficiency in Excel usage for data analysis
Hands-on experience with BI tools to create interactive dashboards and visualizations (Looker is a plus)
Solid understanding of data modeling and data quality principles
Hands-on experience with event tracking and product analytics tools (Amplitude is a plus)
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and causal inference


What we offer:


A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done
An opportunity to work remotely
Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 10 AM)
Private health insurance
2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being
1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice
Learning Budget to support your professional development.
Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online
Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!
Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Junior Data Analyst

📍 Madrid (Hybrid) | 🕒 Full-time | Permanent




About FERO

At FERO, we’re reinventing checkout for eCommerce.

Our Smart Checkout adapts in real time to each shopper, helping merchants increase conversion, improve payment performance, and unlock significant revenue growth. We work with ambitious eCommerce brands across Europe and are growing rapidly.




About the role

We’re looking for a Junior Data Analyst for our Go-To-Market (GTM) team to support the ongoing improvement of our lead generation and data workflows.




This role focuses on operating and maintaining our existing pipeline for processing data from multiple sources, ensuring data quality, and delivering clean, usable data to the GTM team.




You’ll be working closely with the data team and leadership to drive FERO to new heights. The work you do will directly impact how efficiently leads are processed and activated across the GTM team.




You don’t need to know every tool listed below; we value people who are curious, reliable, and able to learn quickly.


What You’ll Do
Operate and maintain the lead processing workflow (lead sources → data cleaning → CRM → GTM team)
Work with tools like Apollo, Wappalyzer, and similar platforms for lead management
Clean, transform, enrich, and validate data before uploading to our CRM
Maintain and improve API integrations and data enrichment processes
Help automate manual processes to make workflows more consistent and scalable
Monitor the pipeline and troubleshoot issues when they arise
Assist with GTM KPIs and reporting to support sales team improvement
Collaborate with the GTM team to improve data quality and workflow performance

What We’re Looking For




Core skills:

Python (experience in ETL and scripting; pandas and NumPy proficiency highly valued)
SQL (basic to intermediate level; PostgreSQL or MySQL preferred)
Data visualization with popular tools (Tableau, Data Studio, Power BI, etc.)
Experience with HubSpot or other CRMs
Familiarity with LLMs and AI agents (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cursor, etc.)
Familiarity with web scraping
Experience with Jupyter notebooks 
Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Drive)
High level of English (written and spoken)




Nice to have:

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Familiarity with basic automation techniques and bash scripting




*You don’t need to meet every requirement. If you’re comfortable with the basics and willing to learn, we encourage you to apply.


Who You Are
Organized and detail-oriented
Proactive and able to work independently or as part of a team
Curious and motivated to learn
Comfortable working cross-functionally and collaborating across teams

﻿

What You’ll Gain
Hands-on experience with real GTM and data workflows
Exposure to teams across the company, from Product to Platform
Practical skills in automation, data pipelines, and CRM systems
Close collaboration with senior engineers and sales leadership
Opportunities to improve and scale systems, not just maintain them
Room to grow and learn new technologies




What we offer

Permanent contract.
Private health insurance (partially covered).
Hybrid work (3 days office / 2 remote).
Office in a central location in Madrid.




🧭 Hiring process

1. Screening call.

2. Interview with the Hiring Manager.

3. Final conversation.




⚡ Ready to make an impact with data?

If you’re excited about working with real data, improving workflows, exploring new technologies, and helping a fast-growing fintech scale, we’d love to hear from you.




Join FERO and help us turn better data into better business opportunities!

Title: Data Analyst - Fincrime Reporting
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Data Analyst - FCC Reporting

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Compliance team and we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Regulatory FinCrime Compliance domain!

Our data mission is to enable effective risk detection, monitoring and regulatory compliance through robust data models, scalable analytics and high quality reporting.

The team works closely with Compliance, Risk and Product to design and implement data-driven controls, detection mechanisms, and investigative tools across multiple jurisdictions.

Projects range from building curated data models to cover global key risk indicators for financial crime compliance and automating into standardised board packs, to scaling our regulatory reporting engine to incorporate datasets specific to transaction monitoring, screening and client KYC.

As part of the team you will


Design and maintain data models and datasets used for transaction monitoring, customer risk scoring, and financial crime investigations.
Own end-to-end delivery of FinCrime analytics solutions: requirements gathering, data extraction, transformation, validation, and deployment.
Develop and optimise detection logic and monitoring rules (e.g. transaction monitoring scenarios, anomaly detection, behavioural patterns).
Perform data quality checks and controls to ensure completeness, accuracy, and auditability of FinCrime datasets.
Build dashboards and analytical tools (Looker / Looker Studio or similar) for monitoring risk exposure, alerts, and investigation pipelines.
Support regulatory and internal audits, providing traceability of data, methodologies, and controls.
Contribute to the automation and continuous improvement of FinCrime processes (screening, monitoring, alert handling).


What We’re Looking For


2-5 years Experience in Data/Business Analytics – preferably within FinCrime, Compliance, Risk, or Financial Services.
Advanced SQL skills – able to read and write queries across complex datasets.
Experience with our modern data stack tools is a plus: dbt, Google Cloud BigQuery, Looker / Looker Studio, Git.
Experience building data pipelines, transformations, and analytical datasets.
Solid understanding of financial crime frameworks.
Experience working with Python is desirable.
Knowledge of payment flows, FX, or banking products is desirable.
Strong analytical thinking with focus on data quality, controls, and risk interpretation.
Experience working with transaction monitoring systems or alerting frameworks is a plus.
Ability to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into data logic.
Fluency in English (Spanish, a plus)


What Ebury Offers You


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment (hybrid model, 4 days office / 1 day remote)
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off and all the Málaga public holidays.
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Ebury only accepts applications via official Ebury channels. We will only contact you from an @ebury.com domain. Always check the emails you receive from us, and note that we will never request payment for any part of the recruitment process. Stay safe and report suspicious activity.

Ebury does not accept unsolicited resumes, CVs, or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies or search firms without signed written Ebury recruitment terms in place for a specific role. Any unsolicited applications will be considered the sole property of Ebury. Title: Senior Mobility Data Analyst
Description:
Somos una compañía global especializada en la distribución eficiente de vehículos, con más de 47 años de experiencia en el sector de la automoción, con origen y sede central en Madrid, España.

Nuestro enfoque de negocio, combina un profundo conocimiento de la industria, tecnología propia, digitalización e inteligencia de datos para entender las necesidades reales de movilidad y ofrecer soluciones flexibles y personalizadas a particulares, empresas y administraciones públicas.

Hoy, estamos presentes en 18 países de Europa y Latinoamérica, representando cerca de 40 marcas oficiales de vehículos a través de una red de más de 3.200 puntos de venta y servicio independientes. Pensamos de forma global y actuamos con un fuerte enfoque local, adaptando nuestro modelo a cada mercado y estableciendo, relaciones a largo plazo con fabricantes, clientes y socios financieros. En 2025, generamos una facturación de 5.500 millones de euros y vendimos 220.000 vehículos nuevos.

Move. It’s your right.

En Astara apostamos por la igualdad de oportunidades, la inclusión y la diversidad. ¡Animamos a todas las personas, incluidas aquellas con discapacidad, a unirse a nuestro equipo! Si necesitas alguna adaptación durante el proceso de selección, no dudes en contárnoslo

Astara Intelligence

En Astara Intelligence transformamos datos en decisiones de negocio para el sector de la movilidad. Somos la unidad de analítica y consultoría de Astara, compañía global de movilidad, y trabajamos con clientes públicos y privados en proyectos de movilidad inteligente, estrategia, datos e innovación.

Buscamos un/a consultor especialista en análisis de datos de movilidad para incorporarse al equipo de consultoría de movilidad en ASTARA Intelligence (Advisory). Participarás en proyectos de consultoría de movilidad, analizando datos, estructurando problemas complejos y preparando recomendaciones claras para cliente.

Main Functions/Responsibilities


Analizar datos de movilidad, demanda, territorio, usuarios, operaciones y mercado.
Apoyar proyectos de consultoría en movilidad urbana, transporte, smart cities y nuevos modelos de servicio.
Construir análisis, modelos y dashboards en Excel, Power BI, Python, SQL u otras herramientas.
Preparar informes, presentaciones y visualizaciones para cliente, en español e inglés.
Definir KPIs, escenarios, diagnósticos y recomendaciones estratégicas.
Colaborar con consultores/as, analistas, diseñadores/as y perfiles técnicos en proyectos end-to-end.
Explorar el uso de IA y automatización para acelerar research y análisis.


Professional Experience/Qualifications


+5 años de experiencia en consultoría, analítica, movilidad, transporte, smart cities, estrategia y/o data analytics.
Formación en Ingeniería, Economía, Data Science, Estadística, Matemáticas, Urbanismo, Transporte o similar.
Nivel experto de Excel y experiencia en analisis de bases de datos complejas.
Conocimiento experto de Power BI, Tableau, Looker o herramientas similares.
Inglés profesional, escrito y hablado (nivel C1-C2)
Capacidad para estructurar problemas ambiguos, extraer insights y comunicarlos con claridad
Excelente comunicación oral (presentación) y escrita (redacción de documentos)
Interés real por la movilidad, las ciudades, la tecnología y los datos

Entrar en BigQuery y atacar las tablas con SQL para responder a las preguntas de negocio.

Experiencia de 2 a 5 años como Analista BI o Analista de Mercado.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Link’s vision is to become the global leader for deep data in life sciences. We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Data Analyst to join our product team.

In this role, you will play a key part in developing and implementing a data governance framework, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and integrity. Your main responsibilities include establishing data quality monitoring processes, identifying root causes of inconsistencies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve data gaps.

To thrive in this role, you need expertise in SQL and Python for data manipulation and automation. You should be comfortable working with large datasets, designing dashboards with actionable recommendations, and applying statistical techniques to assess and enhance data quality.

The ideal candidate has experience in creating documentation (process documentation, data collection guidelines) and in contributing to data governance policies and best practices.

What You'll Do


Implement a data governance framework
Establish and maintain robust processes for tracking and assessing data quality
Develop automated checks to proactively detect data inconsistencies
Apply statistical techniques to enhance data quality
Create customized reports and dashboards
Extract data from databases (e.g., Redshift, MongoDB)
Identify and resolve root causes of quality issues
Collaborate in cross-functional teams of product managers, engineering, and operations
Create and maintain documentation


Requirements


5+ years of work experience in data analysis or data quality role
Strong technical skills in data analysis, with proficiency in SQL and Python
Experience in data storage and processing on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
Strong problem-solving skills and experience working with cross-functional teams
Experience writing process documentation and data collection guidelines


Nice to Have


University degree in medicine or life sciences
Understanding of healthcare, life sciences, or pharmaceutical industry data
Experience with data visualization tools to create dashboards and reports
Understanding of data engineering concepts (ETL, data pipelines)
Experience with workflow automation tools such as Apache Airflow
Experience working in an Agile or product-driven environment
Familiarity with data privacy and compliance regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA)


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


1% charitable giving program
Life insurance
Pension contribution
Fitness reimbursement


Compensation


Total compensation: 50,000 - 70,000 EUR
The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.


#RemoteSpain

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

Title: Global Data Analyst
Description:
The Global Data and Technology team is looking for a candidate for the position of Global Data Analyst. We are looking for a Data Analyst. Comfortable working independently with low stakeholder exposure in an internal, product‑focused environment.
Loves problem solving.
Individual contributor with full ownership of projects.
Proficiency in English is a must.

Title: Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Marketing & Communication Senior Consultant

Fundada en 2008, HipoGes es una de las plataformas líderes en Asset Management para activos distressed, con más de 48.500 millones de euros en activos bajo gestión. Con oficinas en España, Portugal, Grecia e Italia y más de 1.700 empleados, HipoGes como plataforma independiente trabaja con más de 30 clientes diferentes, instituciones financieras e inversores internacionales especializados en el sector de activos distressed. HipoGes proporciona soluciones a lo largo de todo el ciclo de inversión:
Due diligence y valoración
Cierre de operaciones y reestructuración
Gestión amistosa de préstamos / gestión legal, real estate management, estrategia de comercialización y venta, reporting ; portfolio management
En el área de asset management, HipoGes gestiona una amplia gama de activos incluyendo hipotecas residenciales, préstamos a grandes corporaciones y PYMES, activos de real estate y préstamos sin garantía.



Descripción

El departamento de Marketing & Communication es el encargado de velar por la imagen de marca de la compañía (y marcas del grupo). Gestionar y desarrollar la comunicación externa e impulsar la comunicación interna. Dando soporte a todos los departamentos de la empresa.


Perfil

Descripción del puesto:

Buscamos un/a Analista Digital de Datos e Insights para el área de Marketing, con responsabilidad directa sobre la calidad, coherencia e interpretación del dato de marketing y comercial, y un papel clave como puente entre negocio y los equipos de Data/BI.

Su misión será asegurar que los datos sean fiables, comprensibles y accionables, transformándolos en análisis claros que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas y operativas del área de Marketing de la compañía, así como la elaboración de informes y reportes para dirección.

Funciones:

· Seguimiento diario de KPIs de negocio y marketing mediante herramientas de Business Intelligence.
· Ownership de la calidad del dato de marketing (definición, control y mejora continua).
· Detección de inconsistencias entre fuentes (CRM, BI, marketing, comercial) y coordinación para su corrección.
· Definición de KPIs claros, homogéneos y compartidos entre equipos.
· Traducción de datos complejos en insights accionables para perfiles no técnicos.
· Elaboración de recomendaciones basadas en datos.
· Identificación temprana de alertas y cambios de tendencia.
· Elaboración de informes de seguimiento y análisis.
· Diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de dashboards en Power BI.
· Cruce, revisión y validación de datos procedentes de Marketing, Comercial y CRM.
· Colaboración continua con los equipos implicados para mejorar procesos y calidad del dato.

Requisitos:

Imprescindibles:
· Experiencia previa como Analista de Datos / BI / Reporting.
· Capacidad demostrada para interpretar datos.
· Perfil analítico, riguroso y ágil en el análisis.
· Buen manejo de Power BI.
· Conocimientos de SQL.
· Atlo nivel de Excel.
· SQL para exploración y validación de datos.

Valorable:
· Experiencia con datos de CRM.
· Experiencia previa en marketing, ventas, comercial.
· Experiencia colaborando con equipos de Data/Engineering.
· Experiencia en entornos con múltiples fuentes de datos.
· Experiencia en Real Estate, Finance en entornos digitales.

Title: Regional Data Analyst
Description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About The Role

Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team and play a key role in accelerating our data transformation across the Services Division. This position sits at the crossroads of business intelligence, analytics, and technology, providing an exciting opportunity to influence how data is leveraged to support strategic and operational decisions across the region.

We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented data professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a builder mindset, constantly seeking smarter, faster, and more effective ways of working through technology and innovation.

In this highly visible role, you will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain, helping teams unlock the full value of data while promoting a culture of data-driven decision making.

What You Will Do


Gather and translate business requirements into clear, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses.
Develop, enhance, and maintain business intelligence dashboards, ensuring consistency, usability, and high-quality user experiences.
Manage analytics and dashboard development projects from scope definition through delivery and continuous improvement.
Build a strong understanding of data sources, structures, and flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms.
Ensure dashboards are intuitive, actionable, and accessible to business users with minimal training.
Maintain documentation for dashboards, data models, and related processes.
Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance activities and serve as a regional point of reference for business users.
Identify data quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to implement sustainable improvement solutions.
Analyze trends across regions, product lines, and business areas to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.
Support stakeholders with ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to address complex business questions.
Partner with regional and sub-regional management teams to understand business priorities and enable informed decision-making.
Guide and support regional users in adopting and effectively utilizing BI tools and dashboards.
Design and deliver training sessions that increase data literacy and user adoption.
Support leadership teams with compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations.
Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve existing reporting and analytics processes through emerging technologies and tools.


Required

What you need to succeed:


3 to 6 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or related role.
Proven experience developing dashboards that support real business decision-making.
Advanced Excel and Power Pivot skills, including complex data models, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.
Hands-on experience with a major BI platform such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong understanding of data structures, data modelling, and working with multiple data sources.
Experience partnering with business functions such as Sales, Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
Experience collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical or IT teams.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Excellent written and spoken English.


Preferred


Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, B2B environment, or consultancy.
Exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.
Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and data warehouses such as Snowflake.
Spanish language skills.
Portuguese language skills.
Experience identifying and implementing technology-driven process improvements and automations.
Project management experience or a strong project management mindset.
Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, and business environments.


What we offer you


A permanent contract.
A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
Meal vouchers.
Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.
Be part of an experienced and international team.
A good vibe working environment.
The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.
Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.
The freedom to innovate, experiment, and help shape smarter ways of working.
Office location: Nuevos Ministerios, Madrid, Spain.
Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.


Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Title: DATA ANALYTICS AND LOSS PREVENTION ANALYST
Description:
¡Únete al Grupo Líder en Cuidado Animal!

Grupo IskayPet nace de la unión de los ecosistemas de Kiwoko (Tiendas físicas y online, peluquerías Mundo Belleza y Centros Veterinarios Kivet) y Tiendanimal (Tiendas físicas y online, peluquerías Salón de Belleza y Centros Veterinarios Clinicanimal) tras la compra por parte de EMEFIN, grupo empresarial familiar peruano con más de 80 años de experiencia en retail. Ambos ecosistemas mantienen sus identidades propias y sumando capacidades para ofrecer la propuesta más completa en el cuidado de los animales de compañía.

Hoy, con presencia en España y Portugal, más de 300 centros de trabajo y 4000 personas, trabajamos para ser referentes en el bienestar animal, bajo nuestra misión: "To care for animals and make life better".

Actualmente buscamos una persona para la posición de Loss and Fraud Prevention Analyst en el departamento de Finanzas para nuestras oficinas de Madrid.

¿Qué habilidades esperamos encontrar en esta persona?


Proactividad, autonomía y compromiso con la excelencia.
Capacidad para aportar soluciones con un pensamiento analítico y colaborar en equipo.
Gran capacidad para aportar y crear nuevas ideas que enriquezcan y fortalezcan nuestra cultura. Si te apasiona trabajar en un entorno diverso y dinámico, ¡queremos conocerte!


Las principales responsabilidades son:


Recopilar, depurar y analizar datos provenientes de distintas fuentes (ventas, operaciones, inventarios, seguridad, entre otros)
Desarrollar dashboards y reportes dinámicos mediante herramientas de Business Intelligence (Power BI).
Identificar tendencias y patrones relacionados con fraudes, mermas, robos, errores operativos u otros eventos de pérdida económica.
Proporcionar análisis ad-hoc y reportes estratégicos para la alta dirección que respalden decisiones de negocio
Desarrollar modelos de alertas tempranas para detección de anomalías en procesos críticos.
Proponer e implementar KPIs y KRIs para seguimiento de LossPrevention y Riesgos Estratégicos.


Nuestra propuesta de valor, #HappyIskaylife, reúne iniciativas que impulsan el bienestar en sus 5 dimensiones: físico, emocional, social, profesional y financiero, con medidas como:


Horario flexible de entrada y salida, con modelo híbrido (50% teletrabajo) y jornada intensiva los viernes y en julio y agosto.
Entorno #petfriendly: ¡puedes traerte a tu animal de compañía a la oficina!
Posibilidad de retribución flexible (ticket restaurante, guardería y transporte), seguro de salud para ti y tu familia y servicio de atención psicológica.
Apostamos por tu talento con formación continua y desarrollo profesional a tu medida.
Programa Erasmus con oportunidad de traslado temporal o indefinido a nuestras oficinas de Málaga, Madrid u Oporto.


Y esto es solo una parte, contamos con muchas más iniciativas pensadas para cuidarte y acompañarte en tu día a día.

Al menos 2 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, inteligencia de negocio o prevención de pérdidas.
Experiencia en desarrollo de dashboards y visualizaciones interactivas con herramientas de BI (Power BI).
Conocimientos sólidos en SQL y bases de datos relacionales.
Capacidad para traducir datos complejos en información clara, útil y orientada a la acción.

Experiencia en detección de fraude y uso de herramientas antifraude.

Title: Analista de Datos y KPIs de Proyectos | Space & Defense
Place: Tres Cantos, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
En BETWEEN te ofrecemos las oportunidades que necesitas para alcanzar tus objetivos profesionales. Si Quieres desarrollar tus capacidades en IT e Ingeniería, éste es tu próximo destino!

Damos soporte en una gran variedad de áreas como Firmware, Software, BI, Diseño, Project Management y muchas más. Además, desarrollamos soluciones tecnológicas a medida desde nuestros BETWEEN Labs.

Qué harás?


Analizar las fuentes de información disponibles, su calidad y las necesidades de seguimiento de los responsables de proyectos.
Definir KPIs comunes y específicos para diferentes tipologías de proyecto, concretando su fórmula, origen, frecuencia de actualización y criterios de interpretación.
Estructurar y depurar datos relacionados con planificación, hitos, costes, riesgos y entregables.
Desarrollar dashboards e informes operativos y ejecutivos, principalmente con Power BI.
Identificar desviaciones, tendencias y señales tempranas que ayuden a anticipar problemas.
Proponer mejoras en la calidad del dato y automatizaciones del reporting, colaborando con otros equipos cuando sean necesarias integraciones.


Requisitos


Al menos 5 años en análisis de datos, BI, reporting, PMO o control de proyectos.
Experiencia definiendo indicadores a partir de necesidades de negocio o de gestión.
Manejo sólido de Power BI, DAX, Excel y Power Query.
Conocimientos de modelado y calidad de datos.
Familiaridad con conceptos de gestión de proyectos: planificación, hitos, presupuesto, costes reales, previsiones y riesgos.
Inglés que te permita participar en reuniones y explicar análisis y propuestas.
Autonomía para trabajar con información incompleta e interlocución con perfiles técnicos y de negocio.


Valoraremos conocimientos de SQL, Power Automate, ERP/SAP y herramientas de planificación, así como experiencia en entornos industriales, de ingeniería o multiproyecto.

Condiciones


Modalidad híbrida, con asistencia semanal.
Incorporación prevista en enero de 2027.

Te integrarás en un equipo de alto rendimiento y con un alto grado de especialización.
Planes de formación personalizados con nuestra BTW University (Idiomas con Speexx, The Power Business School, Udemy, Certificaciones técnicas, Pharos, etc).

Acceso a variedad de descuentos (Viajes, tecnología... y muchos más).
Precios reducidos en bienestar, fitness y nutrición con Gympass.
