Title: Data & IA Analyst
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Sobre Nosotros

Scuffers es una marca de ropa inspirada en la estética urbana mediterránea, con un estilo y carácter distintivo impulsado por los valores de autenticidad y autoexpresión.

Nuestra filosofía se centra en el desarrollo de producto, investigamos y exploramos cuidadosamente materiales y fits únicos, para ser capaces de ofrecer ropa que no solo se ve bien, sino que también te haga sentir bien.

Ya llevamos seis años construyendo nuestro lifestyle. Comenzamos creando ropa con la que nos gustaría vestirnos a nosotros y fuimos creciendo gracias a una comunidad de personas que buscaban lo mismo.

Si te apasionan los retos y quieres formar parte de nuestro equipo dinámico y joven, buscamos nuevos perfiles para unirse a nuestro equipo.

El Rol

Buscamos un/a Data & IA Analyst que se incorpore a nuestro equipo para ayudarnos a ordenar, estructurar y analizar los datos de Scuffers, convirtiéndolos en información útil para la toma de decisiones de negocio.

Buscamos un perfil híbrido entre análisis de datos y tecnología: alguien que no solo sepa analizar información, sino que sea capaz de utilizar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para construir sus propias soluciones, automatizaciones y dashboards.

Trabajarás de forma muy cercana con el IA Builder, participando en la construcción y evolución de herramientas internas que nos permitan trabajar con nuestros datos de forma más ágil, fiable y autónoma.

Es un rol muy dinámico, ideal para alguien analítico, curioso, resolutivo y con ganas de construir cosas.

Funciones y Responsabilidades

Data & Analytics (core del rol):


Estructuración y modelado de los datos de la empresa:
Definir cómo se organizan y relacionan las diferentes fuentes de información.
Trabajar con datos de ventas, inventario, pedidos, colaboradores, marketing, etc.
Asegurar que los datos sean consistentes, fiables y fáciles de consultar.
Análisis de datos para extraer conclusiones útiles para el negocio:
Identificar tendencias, oportunidades y posibles problemas.
Analizar qué funciona, qué no y por qué.
Convertir datos en conclusiones claras y accionables.
Creación y mantenimiento de dashboards y herramientas de reporting que permitan al equipo consultar la información de forma autónoma.
Integración y conexión de diferentes fuentes de datos para crear una visión global del negocio.

IA & Product Building


Utilización de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para construir soluciones de análisis, reporting y automatización.
Trabajar con asistentes de IA para programar y desarrollar herramientas, siendo capaz de:
Dar contexto y definir correctamente los problemas.
Revisar y validar el código generado.
Detectar errores y corregirlos.
Iterar hasta conseguir soluciones fiables.
Colaboración con el responsable de IA en el desarrollo y evolución de las plataformas internas de Scuffers.
Integración de herramientas de reporting dentro de las plataformas existentes cuando sea necesario.
Automatización de procesos repetitivos relacionados con la gestión y preparación de datos.

Requisitos


Experiencia trabajando con SQL y bases de datos.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos y capacidad para estructurar y relacionar diferentes fuentes de información.
Experiencia sólida utilizando Python para limpiar, transformar, cruzar y automatizar datos.
Experiencia real utilizando herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para programar y construir herramientas, más allá de utilizar IA únicamente para consultas o generación de contenido.
Capacidad para construir dashboards, aplicaciones o herramientas de reporting.
Conocimientos de PostgreSQL será un plus.
Capacidad para leer y realizar modificaciones sencillas en Next.js.
Mentalidad analítica y capacidad para convertir datos en conclusiones de negocio.
Mentalidad proactiva y resolutiva.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma y avanzar de manera ordenada.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación para explicar información técnica y conclusiones de forma sencilla.


Será Un Plus


Experiencia trabajando con datos de e-commerce.
Experiencia con herramientas de Business Intelligence y visualización de datos.
Conocimientos de estadística aplicada.
Experiencia analizando tendencias, comportamiento de clientes o realizando previsiones.
Experiencia trabajando con APIs y conectando diferentes fuentes de datos.


¿Qué ofrecemos?

🫰🏻Una filosofía de trabajo marcada por el crecimiento de grupo y marca de forma paralela. Cada semana supone un nuevo reto, para ti y para el resto.

🎢 Crecimiento profesional: Tenemos un camino muy largo por delante, con muchos retos que cumplir y tú serás una parte fundamental, por lo que iremos creciendo juntos.

🔝Impacto: Nos movemos rápido y eso hará que cada paso cuente y se note.

🫂Dream team: Somos un equipo joven con buena comunicación y muchas ganas de aprender unos de otros.

👖Presupuesto mensual para renovar tu armario: Queremos que seas un auténtico embajador de Scuffers.

🍑 Fruta fresca, café y snacks en nuestra oficina en Pozuelo de Alarcón.

🏋️‍♀️ Descuento en gimnasios para que puedas mantener una vida activa y saludable.

Title: Junior People Operations Data Analyst
Description:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

What You'll Do

At Fever, People decisions run on data. As part of the People Analytics team, you'll turn data into actionable insights that shape our talent strategy and employee experience!

You'll work on top of a modern stack (BigQuery, Dataform, Looker, Google Sheets/Apps Script) and connect HRIs and ATS systems. We use AI daily to build faster, and we expect you to do the same, with good judgment.


Be the reference for People data insights, supporting HR, Talent, Finance and regional teams in their decisions.
Build and maintain automated dashboards and reports for key People metrics (headcount, attrition, compensation, performance, hiring).
Write SQL (BigQuery) and model People data so it is reliable, documented and reusable.
Build internal tools and lightweight apps on top of our data, using LLM-assisted development, to replace manual People processes.
Design and validate AI-powered workflows over People data (e.g. natural-language querying, automated reporting), with a strong focus on privacy and access control.
Own data quality and consistency across People systems: detect issues, trace them to the source and fix them.
Keep exploring new tools and methods to raise the bar of what People Analytics can do.


Who You Are


1-2 years of experience in data analytics; People Analytics is a plus.
Degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering or similar (a Master's is a plus).
Strong SQL and solid command of Google Sheets/Excel; experience with a BI tool (Looker or similar).
Hands-on experience using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini…) to accelerate SQL, scripting or app development, and the judgment to review and validate their output.
Ability to explain findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders and turn data into recommendations.
Care for sensitive data: you understand why compensation and performance data need special handling, especially with AI tools.
Fluent English (Spanish is a plus).


Why You'll Love It Here


Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
Work in a location in the heart of Madrid, with possible travel across our markets
Home office friendly and flexible schedule
Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee
English and Spanish Lessons
Gympass Membership
We have free food, drink and fruit at the office!
Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow


#hybrid #fulltime

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

Title: Exposure Management Data Analyst 100% (f/m/d)
Description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Exposure Management Data Analyst within our Security Compliance Competence Centre in Madrid, own the data and the measures behind everything Bank Julius Baer reports about its security exposure. Maintain and extend our reporting estate, design the formulas that turn raw findings into decision-grade measures, and build the reporting capability that a globally governed function needs under increasing regulatory scrutiny.

YOUR CHALLENGE


Own, maintain, and extend the dashboards and reports through which the bank sees its security exposure, covering a growing estate of modules. Immediate focus falls on the established practices: penetration testing, infrastructure vulnerabilities, and security configuration baseline compliance
Devise, document, and version the formulas behind our exposure measures, so that every published figure has one definition, one calculation, and one owner
Build and maintain the searches and transformations that aggregate per-asset security results at scale, including the coverage checks that distinguish an asset that passed from an asset that stopped reporting
Define the measures for exposure domains being brought under management for the first time, where no established metric exists to inherit. You will propose the definition, defend it, and build the reporting behind it
Design, validate, and support the adoption of an aggregated per-service exposure score intended to enable proportionate, risk-based governance. This begins as an experiment, and you will be responsible for establishing whether it earns operational use. Key partners will include stakeholders across delivery and governance functions
Replace the manual compilation of responses to supervisory requests with a standardized, reusable, and reproducible reporting capability, including the mapping from each requirement to the underlying data


YOUR PROFILE


Hands-on expertise with an enterprise business intelligence platform (Tableau preferred): data modelling, calculated fields, level-of-detail expressions, extract strategy, and performance tuning
Proven ability to design and document metrics and composite scores, covering weighting, treatment of missing data, sensitivity, and validation
Experience defining a measure from scratch in a domain that had none and getting it accepted by the people it measures
Scripting for data transformation and automation, ideally in Python, with the discipline to produce maintainable, documented, version-controlled work
Bachelor's degree in computer science, data engineering, information security, or equivalent practical experience
Five or more years of experience in data analytics or data engineering, including direct responsibility for reporting that other people depend on
Fluency in English


We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

Title: Finance Data Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Finance Data Analyst based in Spain.

As a Finance Data Analyst, you will transform complex financial and operational data into reliable insights that support strategic decision-making and business performance. You will bridge the gap between Finance and technical teams, ensuring data is consistent, accessible, and actionable. Working across finance, revenue, operations, HR, and cloud infrastructure systems, you will help structure datasets, improve reporting, and automate recurring analyses. You will play a key role in strengthening data quality, standardizing financial metrics, and improving forecasting and performance monitoring. In a fast-evolving, technology-driven environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to build scalable reporting processes and support future analytical initiatives. This is an opportunity to combine financial expertise, technical skills, and business curiosity to deliver measurable impact.

Accountabilities


Map and document financial and corporate data sources, systems, ownership, definitions, and data flows to improve transparency and consistency.
Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, duplication, and reconciliation issues across accounting, billing, CRM, HR, payroll, cash management, and expense-management systems.
Define data requirements for monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting, ensuring key financial and operational metrics are clearly defined and consistently calculated.
Explore, transform, and model data from data warehouses and connected business systems to create reliable, reusable, and well-documented datasets.
Reconcile data across multiple sources and investigate discrepancies to improve the accuracy and reliability of financial and corporate reporting.
Produce recurring financial analyses, dashboards, and reporting to support leadership decisions, including budget-versus-actuals analysis, variance analysis, cash monitoring, headcount planning, and SaaS performance analysis.
Collaborate with data engineering teams and system owners to improve integrations, transformations, data accessibility, and quality checks.
Automate recurring reporting, reconciliations, and analytical workflows where automation can deliver meaningful efficiency gains.
Maintain documentation covering data lineage, metric definitions, business rules, assumptions, and known limitations.
Contribute to data governance and quality monitoring, preparing reliable datasets for forecasting, anomaly detection, and future AI-driven use cases.
Handle confidential financial, HR, and payroll information with discretion, accuracy, and a strong commitment to data protection.


Requirements


At least 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, financial analytics, FP&A analytics, or a related analytical role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate data across multiple systems and identify the root causes of discrepancies.
Good command of SQL and practical experience with at least one business intelligence or data visualization tool.
Ability to translate business questions into clear data requirements, meaningful metrics, and actionable analyses.
Solid understanding of financial concepts, including budgeting, forecasting, monthly closing, variance analysis, revenue, cash flow, costs, and unit economics.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to review, audit, and structure existing financial models.
Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both Finance and technical stakeholders.
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly.
A rigorous, curious, and structured approach to data quality, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and make definitions explicit.
Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and deliver practical solutions in a changing business environment.


Nice-to-have Qualifications


Experience in a B2B SaaS, software, technology, or scale-up environment.
Familiarity with SaaS revenue metrics, including MRR, ARR, NRR, churn, and bookings.
Understanding of SaaS cost structures, including cloud storage, compute, data retention, AI-related expenses, and gross margin.
Experience with finance, accounting, billing, CRM, HRIS, payroll, expense-management, or financial planning tools.
Knowledge of data warehouses, data modeling, ETL processes, APIs, or data quality frameworks.
Experience with Python or another programming language for analysis and automation.
Previous exposure to sensitive HR or payroll data and an understanding of the confidentiality requirements involved.


Candidates who meet most, but not necessarily all, of these requirements are encouraged to apply. A strong willingness to learn, analytical thinking, and the ability to demonstrate relevant skills are equally valued.

Full-time employment in a role with meaningful exposure to financial strategy and business performance.

Title: Sr Business Analyst
Description:
Senior Business Analyst

Location: Madrid, Spain

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have


Experience working with consumer, CRM, loyalty, or customer lifecycle data.
Understanding of consumer behavior from acquisition to retention.
Experience with advanced or predictive analytics using Python, R, or similar programming languages.


Why PMI?

At PMI, you'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world, and contribute to the transformation of a global organization.

We offer the opportunity to learn, innovate, grow your career, and make an impact from day one.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We believe diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Relocation support and visa sponsorship are not provided. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Spain to be considered for this role.

Comfortable working independently with low stakeholder exposure in an internal, product‑focused environment.

Individual contributor with full ownership of projects.

Title: Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Marketing & Communication Senior Consultant

Fundada en 2008, HipoGes es una de las plataformas líderes en Asset Management para activos distressed, con más de 48.500 millones de euros en activos bajo gestión. Con oficinas en España, Portugal, Grecia e Italia y más de 1.700 empleados, HipoGes como plataforma independiente trabaja con más de 30 clientes diferentes, instituciones financieras e inversores internacionales especializados en el sector de activos distressed. HipoGes proporciona soluciones a lo largo de todo el ciclo de inversión:
Due diligence y valoración
Cierre de operaciones y reestructuración
Gestión amistosa de préstamos / gestión legal, real estate management, estrategia de comercialización y venta, reporting ; portfolio management
En el área de asset management, HipoGes gestiona una amplia gama de activos incluyendo hipotecas residenciales, préstamos a grandes corporaciones y PYMES, activos de real estate y préstamos sin garantía.



Descripción

El departamento de Marketing & Communication es el encargado de velar por la imagen de marca de la compañía (y marcas del grupo). Gestionar y desarrollar la comunicación externa e impulsar la comunicación interna. Dando soporte a todos los departamentos de la empresa.


Perfil

Descripción del puesto:

Buscamos un/a Analista Digital de Datos e Insights para el área de Marketing, con responsabilidad directa sobre la calidad, coherencia e interpretación del dato de marketing y comercial, y un papel clave como puente entre negocio y los equipos de Data/BI.

Su misión será asegurar que los datos sean fiables, comprensibles y accionables, transformándolos en análisis claros que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas y operativas del área de Marketing de la compañía, así como la elaboración de informes y reportes para dirección.

Funciones:

· Seguimiento diario de KPIs de negocio y marketing mediante herramientas de Business Intelligence.
· Ownership de la calidad del dato de marketing (definición, control y mejora continua).
· Detección de inconsistencias entre fuentes (CRM, BI, marketing, comercial) y coordinación para su corrección.
· Definición de KPIs claros, homogéneos y compartidos entre equipos.
· Traducción de datos complejos en insights accionables para perfiles no técnicos.
· Elaboración de recomendaciones basadas en datos.
· Identificación temprana de alertas y cambios de tendencia.
· Elaboración de informes de seguimiento y análisis.
· Diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de dashboards en Power BI.
· Cruce, revisión y validación de datos procedentes de Marketing, Comercial y CRM.
· Colaboración continua con los equipos implicados para mejorar procesos y calidad del dato.

Requisitos:

Imprescindibles:
· Experiencia previa como Analista de Datos / BI / Reporting.
· Capacidad demostrada para interpretar datos.
· Perfil analítico, riguroso y ágil en el análisis.
· Buen manejo de Power BI.
· Conocimientos de SQL.
· Atlo nivel de Excel.
· SQL para exploración y validación de datos.

Valorable:
· Experiencia con datos de CRM.
· Experiencia previa en marketing, ventas, comercial.
· Experiencia colaborando con equipos de Data/Engineering.
· Experiencia en entornos con múltiples fuentes de datos.
· Experiencia en Real Estate, Finance en entornos digitales.

As a Performance Monitoring and Reporting Specialist, you will produce critical KPIs and dashboards to support global trade strategies. You will work within the European Trade Finance Service Centre to drive efficiency and data-driven decision-making.

Produce and analyze recurrent reports and dashboards for main stakeholders.
Chair SLA meetings with internal Business, IT, and Operations teams.

Description:

Damos soporte en una gran variedad de áreas como Firmware, Software, BI, Diseño, Project Management y muchas más. Además, desarrollamos soluciones tecnológicas a medida desde nuestros BETWEEN Labs.

Qué harás?


Analizar las fuentes de información disponibles, su calidad y las necesidades de seguimiento de los responsables de proyectos.
Definir KPIs comunes y específicos para diferentes tipologías de proyecto, concretando su fórmula, origen, frecuencia de actualización y criterios de interpretación.
Estructurar y depurar datos relacionados con planificación, hitos, costes, riesgos y entregables.
Desarrollar dashboards e informes operativos y ejecutivos, principalmente con Power BI.
Identificar desviaciones, tendencias y señales tempranas que ayuden a anticipar problemas.
Proponer mejoras en la calidad del dato y automatizaciones del reporting, colaborando con otros equipos cuando sean necesarias integraciones.


Requisitos


Al menos 5 años en análisis de datos, BI, reporting, PMO o control de proyectos.
Experiencia definiendo indicadores a partir de necesidades de negocio o de gestión.
Manejo sólido de Power BI, DAX, Excel y Power Query.
Conocimientos de modelado y calidad de datos.
Familiaridad con conceptos de gestión de proyectos: planificación, hitos, presupuesto, costes reales, previsiones y riesgos.
Inglés que te permita participar en reuniones y explicar análisis y propuestas.
Autonomía para trabajar con información incompleta e interlocución con perfiles técnicos y de negocio.


Valoraremos conocimientos de SQL, Power Automate, ERP/SAP y herramientas de planificación, así como experiencia en entornos industriales, de ingeniería o multiproyecto.

Condiciones


Modalidad híbrida, con asistencia semanal.
Incorporación prevista en enero de 2027.

Te integrarás en un equipo de alto rendimiento y con un alto grado de especialización.
Planes de formación personalizados con nuestra BTW University (Idiomas con Speexx, The Power Business School, Udemy, Certificaciones técnicas, Pharos, etc).

Title: Customer Strategy Analyst - Santander Insurance
Description:
Country: Spain

IT STARTS HERE




Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organization, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.




This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.




Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.




The Wealth Management & Insurance division covers three businesses in all Santander Group countries: Insurance, Asset Management and Private Banking. We work to provide the best solutions to our clients in these three businesses in the 10 countries where we are present.




THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE




Santander Insurance is looking for a Customer Strategy Analyst based out of Madrid.




The role will develop a deep understanding of key customer performance indicators to support value creation and strategic decision-making. Reporting to the Customer 360 & AI Director within the Customer Strategy & AI team.




As a customer strategy analyst your mission will be to build and maintain a robust and scalable analytical framework to monitor, understand and drive customer strategy performance across global and local markets. The role will support data-driven decision making by providing actionable insights on key customer KPIs, identifying performance drivers, and assessing the business impact of strategic initiatives.




We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:




1. Customer Analytics Framework

Develop and maintain a robust analytical environment to monitor customer performance across geographies, ensuring consistency between global and local views.
Define and standardize KPIs, metrics and analytical methodologies to ensure comparability and alignment across countries.
Design and enhance reporting tools and dashboards to provide clear visibility on customer performance.




2. KPI Monitoring & Performance Tracking

Track and analyze the evolution of key customer KPIs, including:
Customer lifetime Value
Net Promoter Score (NPS)
Customer churn
Customer base evolution
Product holding (e.g., insurance policies per customer)
Identify trends, deviations vs. targets and early warning signals.
Provide regular performance updates to key stakeholders and senior management.




3. Deep-Dive Analysis & Insights Generation

Conduct in-depth analyses to identify key drivers of performance, improvement levers and potential risks to achieving budget and strategic targets.
Segment customers and behaviors to uncover actionable insights.
Support hypothesis generation and validation using data.




4. Business Impact Assessment

Analyze and quantify the impact of strategic initiatives (e.g., commercial actions, retention strategies, cross-selling initiatives) on customer KPIs and business outcomes.
Develop frameworks to measure ROI and effectiveness of initiatives.
Support prioritization of initiatives based on data-driven insights.




5. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

Work closely with business, data and local teams to ensure alignment on definitions, analyses and insights.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear and actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Support decision-making processes at both global and local levels.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING




Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organization. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.




The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.







Professional Experience

At least 5 years of professional experience in the insurance industry, preferably in roles related to analytics and performance tracking.
Proven experience in data analysis, KPI monitoring and business performance management.
Experience working with large and complex datasets across multiple sources.
Artificial intelligence application on task and process automation, data analytics and innovation. (Preferred)




Education

Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.




Languages

Very high proficiency in English and Spanish are required.
Portuguese is desirable (Preferred)




Hard Skills

Proficiency in SQL and Excel for data extraction and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to build dashboards and reports.
Familiarity with data models, data structures and analytical frameworks is a plus. (Preferred)




Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Ability to connect data analysis with business impact and decision-making.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex insights to non-technical stakeholders.







WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT




Your contribution matters, and it’s recognized. You can expect a fair, competitive reward package that reflects the impact you create and the value you deliver. But we know rewards go beyond numbers.

We’re enable our teams to go beyond through global opportunities and broad career paths.
Flexibility that works. Enjoy a hybrid working models—some days remote, some days onsite with your team—along with flexible hours.
Learning for life. Access hundreds of courses on our platforms, including exclusive access to our global learning space: Santander Open Academy (www.santanderopenacademy.com)
Competitive rewards. Receive a highly competitive salary with performance-based bonuses, motivating you to keep growing with us.
Financial advantages. Benefit from preferential banking terms, special interest rates on loans, life insurance, and more.
Your health is our priority. Through BeHealthy, our global wellness programme, we promote Holistic wellbeing.
We know family is everything. That’s why we offer childcare support and family-friendly programmes tailored to each life stage.
Always by your side. Get access to Santander Contigo, our program for employees and their families offering legal, emotional, and administrative advisory services.
Extra benefits. Gym/WellHub membership, medical centers in some of our facilities, meal subsidy, parking, shuttle service from various points in Madrid, as well as exclusive discounts and offers for Santander employees. And that’s only the beginning—we’ll tell you more when you join!




We’re here to keep you motivated, help you reach your goals, and celebrate your progress, every step of the way.




LOCAL COMPLIANCE




Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible application process for all candidates.




WHAT TO DO NEXT




If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

Title: Global Business Insights Analyst
Description:
The Straumann Group is a global leader in the field of aesthetic dentistry. We combine expertise, scientific evidence, and innovation with passion, committing to uncompromising quality to provide dentists and patients worldwide with the best possible solutions. As pioneers and market leaders in dental implantology, we have consistently expanded our product portfolio in recent years. Today, we operate in all areas of aesthetic dentistry: from tooth preservation, regeneration, restoration, orthodontics with transparent aligner trays to tooth loss solutions.

The Business Insights Analyst plays a pivotal role in turning customer, market, and business data into insights that accelerate innovation and support sustainable growth within the Straumann Implantology Business Unit. The role owns the development and delivery of customer and market insights, from identifying and managing relevant data sources to translating complex analyses into clear recommendations and measurable business actions. Acting as a strategic partner to senior stakeholders and Product Management, the Business Insights Analyst enables confident, evidence-based decision-making across key business initiatives. Success in this role requires strong analytical expertise, sound business and industry understanding, and the ability to connect cross-functional teams, challenge perspectives, and turn business questions into practical, actionable solutions.

Your Responsibilities


Shape and drive the business intelligence and analytics agenda for the Straumann Implantology Business Unit, aligned with strategic priorities and business needs.
Act as a trusted business partner to Product Management and other senior stakeholders, using data and market insights to support strategic decisions, identify growth opportunities, and address business challenges.
Lead stakeholder engagements to understand business objectives, pain points, and information needs, and build alignment on analytical priorities and expected outcomes.
Translate complex business questions into clearly defined analytical objectives, use cases, requirements, KPIs, success criteria, and actionable recommendations.
Drive end-to-end analytical projects, from framing the business problem and sourcing the data through to analysis, solution development, stakeholder adoption, and impact measurement.
Identify and combine relevant internal and external data sources, and conduct analyses to uncover trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
Establish KPI frameworks, measurement concepts, business rules, and reporting standards to support consistent and meaningful performance management.
Design and deliver executive-ready reports, dashboards, visualizations, and management presentations tailored to different stakeholder groups.
Ensure the quality, consistency, usability, and appropriate interpretation of analytical outputs, collaborating with data owners, IT, and technical experts where required.
Promote data-driven decision-making by communicating complex findings clearly, challenging assumptions constructively, and influencing stakeholders at different levels.
Identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, and automate processes
Build Product Managers’ data and analytics capabilities through coaching, training, and knowledge-sharing.


Your Profile - Qualifications


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, economics, business administration, data analytics, or a related field.
At least five years of relevant experience in business analysis, business intelligence, data analytics, or a related discipline; experience in healthcare, dental, medtech is preferred.
Proven experience partnering with business stakeholders to understand objectives, define analytical requirements, establish KPIs, and translate business questions into actionable insights.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, assess business performance, challenge assumptions, and communicate clear recommendations.
Proficiency in developing and delivering reports, dashboards, data visualizations, and experience in management presentations.
Ability to translate business requirements into clear functional, analytical, data, and technical requirements, and to align stakeholders on expected outcomes and success criteria.
Proficiency working with data from multiple sources including extraction, transformation, validation, and preparation for analysis and reporting.
Understanding of ETL processes, data models, data quality, and data governance, with the ability to collaborate effectively with data engineers, IT, and data owners.
Proficiency in relevant analytics tools, particularly SAP BW, Snowflake, SQL, AWS, Power BI, and advanced Excel. Familiarity with Python is a plus.
Experience managing analytical projects from business problem definition through solution development, stakeholder adoption, and impact measurement.


Additional Qualifications


Experience in Voice of Customer (VOC) methodologies and tools is a plus.
Innovative mindset with eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies in the field of data analytics and business intelligence.
Open-minded and proactive personality with the ability to cultivate effective working relationships in an international matrix environment as well as to motivate and engage stakeholders.
Fluent in English; proficiency in other languages is an asset.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Description:
Misión del Puesto

Como Analista de Datos de Negocio, serás el motor analítico que ayude a impulsar la estrategia de retención y fidelización. Debes poseer la profundidad técnica para entender los datos y la visión estratégica para entender el negocio. Serás el encargado de liderar la identificación de patrones de comportamiento mediante el ecosistema de Google Cloud (BigQuery) e IA, transformando datos en soluciones que reduzcan directamente la tasa de abandono.




Funciones Principales

Análisis de Negocio y Operativa

Comprender a fondo la operativa del negocio para asegurar que los análisis realizados se ajusten a la realidad del cliente y de la compañía.
Analizar el ciclo de vida del cliente para detectar señales de alerta antes de que se produzca una baja o impago.
Transformar datos complejos en información que los responsables de negocio puedan ejecutar de inmediato.
Generar bases de datos precisas para el lanzamiento de campañas de retención, asegurando la correcta exclusión de perfiles y la personalización de las ofertas.
Elaboración de informes ad-hoc para el Área de Retención y Fidelización, garantizando la coherencia y cubriendo sus necesidades específicas.

Colaboración Multidisciplinar (Técnico-Negocio)

Actuar como enlace permanente entre el equipo de Retención, Fidelización y el equipo de IT/Datos así como con el resto de unidades de Negocio (Ventas, Producto).
Aunque IT gestiona la exportación técnica entre plataformas (ej. desde nuestra solución actual, Genesys Cloud u otras plataformas de Contact Center equivalentes, hacia Google Cloud), el analista debe conocer ambas para optimizar el uso de los datos.
Trabajar con IT para asegurar que las fuentes de información sean veraces y que las métricas definidas respondan a las necesidades reales de negocio.

Experiencia y Formación

Grado en ADE, Economía, Estadística, Análisis de Datos o similar.
Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en departamentos analíticos de negocio. Se valorará el sector asegurador, pero se aceptan perfiles de banca, retail, telco o utilities con fuerte enfoque en retención.




Perfil Requerido

Perfil técnico y de conocimiento

Entendimiento de los procesos de negocio y ciclo de vida del cliente.
Experiencia en la explotación de datos y métricas de herramientas de Call Center. Se valorará muy positivamente el conocimiento específico en Genesys Cloud como fuente de origen de datos de voz e interacciones.
Dominio de SQL y manejo de grandes volúmenes de datos en BigQuery.
Experiencia sólida en Looker y/o Microstrategy para la creación de dashboards e informes de negocio.
Capacidad para trabajar con modelos de lenguaje y análisis de datos no estructurados.

Perfil Competencial

Capacidad para hablar el "lenguaje técnico" con IT y el "lenguaje de resultados" con los directivos de negocio.
Foco absoluto en la mejora de los KPIs de retención.
Capacidad para identificar problemas y proponer soluciones sin necesidad de supervisión constante.

Title: Commercial Performance & Sales Effectiveness
Description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Sub Function

Business Intelligence

Job Category

Professional

All Job Posting Locations:

Madrid, Spain

Job Description

About Vision

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding on the possibilities of vision treatments? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how vision is improved? Our Vision team solves the toughest health challenges. Help combine cutting-edge insights, science, technology, and people to encourage eye care professionals and patients to proactively protect, correct and enhance healthy sight for life. Our products and services address these needs – from the pediatric to aging eye – in a patient’s lifetime.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

Purpose: The role is responsible for enhancing commercial performance and sales force effectiveness through robust data analysis and validation, systematic monitoring of results against targets, and the delivery of actionable insights to support informed decision-making. In close collaboration with Commercial Excellence, Sales, Sales Force Effectiveness, and other key functions, the role identifies potential performance gaps, recommends corrective actions, strengthens commercial execution, supports the local implementation and adoption of sales force effectiveness tools and methodologies, and ensures the accurate, consistent, and fully traceable calculation of sales incentives across Surgical Vision Iberia.

Responsibilities


Consolidate, reconcile, validate, and analyze commercial data from approved internal sources, ensuring accuracy, integrity, consistency, and full traceability.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical tools to track sales performance, commercial activity, productivity, and key performance indicators.
Monitor sales performance against quarterly targets, prepare the corresponding reports, and provide a clear, timely, and accurate view of performance trends.
Analyze trends, performance gaps, and opportunities; identify the underlying drivers; and recommend corrective actions in coordination with business stakeholders.
Prepare analyses, executive summaries, and performance materials to support periodic business reviews and informed decision-making.
Develop sales forecasts and projections, together with ad hoc analyses, in line with business requirements and management direction.
Contribute to the definition, monitoring, and continuous improvement of performance indicators, methodologies, processes, and governance routines related to commercial effectiveness.
Partner with Commercial Excellence, Sales, Business Analytics, Finance, and, in particular, the Sales Force Effectiveness team to enhance and tailor commercial effectiveness tools.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation covering data sources, definitions, calculation criteria, reporting methodologies, and the processes within the role’s scope of responsibility.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline preferred.
Advanced level of English, both written and spoken.
Proven experience in commercial analysis, reporting, sales operations, business analytics, or sales support functions.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Power BI.
Experience within the medical technology, healthcare, or other regulated industries is preferred.
Exposure to sales forecasting, incentive compensation programs, and commercial performance monitoring is considered an advantage.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong knowledge of data visualization and analytics tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with SAP, RDP, and CRM systems is considered a plus.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends and performance gaps, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
Solid business acumen and understanding of commercial performance drivers.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly, concisely, and effectively to a variety of stakeholders.
Strong collaboration and influencing skills
Excellent planning, prioritization, organizational, and execution capabilities, demonstrating autonomy, accountability, and strong attention to detail.
Continuous improvement mindset


Required Skills

Data Analytics, Microsoft Excel

Preferred Skills

Advanced Analytics, Analytical Reasoning, Business Behavior, Business Intelligence (BI), Data Analysis, Data Capturing, Data-Driven Decision Making, Data Modeling, Data Privacy Standards, Data Reporting, Detail-Oriented, Execution Focus, Process Oriented, Project Support, Requirements Analysis, Statistical Analysis Systems (SAS) Programming, Workflow Analysis

The Anticipated Base Pay Range For This Position Is

€34,700.00 - €55,430.00

Benefits

In addition to base pay, we offer the following benefits*: an annual bonus with set target (% of pay) depending on pay grade / location, where the actual amount is based on the employees’ and companies’ performance of the previous calendar year, or sales commissions. Moreover, we offer vacation days, parental leave for a minimum of 12 weeks, bereavement leave, caregiver leave, volunteer leave, well-being reimbursement, programs for financial, physical and mental health. We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. For more information, visit Employee benefits | Supporting well-being & career growth | Johnson & Johnson Careers.


This is for informative purposes only. Amounts and actual benefits may vary by location and are subject to change.

Title: Reporting Specialist (strong SQL)- Hybrid Madrid
Description:
Role Description

We are looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our team!

More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer and Great Place to Work company with over 35.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 35 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies.

What we look for?

We are looking for a Reporting Specialist with strong expertise in SQL, data analysis, and reporting, combined with a solid understanding of banking operations and core banking data sources. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented professional who can collaborate effectively with stakeholders, translate business requirements into reporting solutions, and ensure high standards of data quality, accuracy, and compliance.

Main Tasks And Accountabilities Will Be

Deliver accurate, timely, and reliable ad hoc and recurring reports to support internal business needs.

Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements, gather specifications, and manage expectations.

Design, develop, and maintain custom reports using data from T24, CRM/CLM, KYC platforms, Oracle databases, and the Global Data Platform (Trino).

Analyze, extract, transform, and present complex datasets in a clear and actionable format.

Ensure compliance with data governance standards, including data quality, integrity, confidentiality, and regulatory requirements.

Continuously improve reporting processes and existing reporting solutions in collaboration with business and IT teams.

Document reporting logic, processes, and dependencies, while supporting knowledge sharing within the team.

Act as a key point of contact for report-related inquiries and reporting support.

What do we expect from you?

Proven experience in report development and data extraction with advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, subqueries, and query optimization.

Hands-on experience with Dataiku for data preparation, workflow automation, and analytics projects.

Strong knowledge of banking products, processes, and systems, including customer onboarding, account management, and transaction data.

Excellent requirements-gathering and stakeholder management skills, with a consultative and customer-focused approach.

Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.

Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

High level of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering quality results.

Team-oriented mindset with strong collaboration and knowledge-sharing skills.

Ability to adapt to changing priorities and thrive in dynamic environments.

Familiarity with enterprise reporting and analytics tools such as Tableau and Dataiku.

Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Work Location

Hybrid position in Madrid (3 days at client´s office, Madrid city center).

Work Schedule

Business hours.

What can we offer?

23 days of Annual Leave plus the 24th and 31st of December as discretionary days!

Numerous benefits (Health Care Plan, teleworking compensation, Life and Accident Insurances).

`Retribución Flexible´ Program: (Meals, Kinder Garden, Transport, online English lessons, Health Care Plan…)

Free access to several training platforms

Professional stability and career plans

UST also, compensates referrals from which you could benefit when you refer professionals.

The option to pick between 12 or 14 payments along the year.

Real Work Life Balance measures (flexibility, WFH or remote work policy, compacted hours during summertime…)

UST Club Platform discounts and gym Access discounts

If you would like to know more, don’t hesitate to apply and we’ll get in touch to fill you in detail. We are waiting for you!

In UST we are committed to equal opportunities in our selection processes and do not discriminate based on race, gender, disability, age, religion, sexual orientation or nationality. We have a special commitment to Disability & Inclusion, so we are interested in hiring people with disability certificate.

Skills

Dataiku, Tableau, SQL, Data Analysis, Requirements Gathering

Title: Customer & Market Analytics Specialist
Description:
Sobe la posición:

Buscamos un profesional analítico con una combinación única de visión de negocio, conocimiento del sector Telco y capacidad técnica en gestión y automatización de datos.

La misión principal del puesto será transformar grandes volúmenes de información en conocimiento accionable para apoyar la toma de decisiones comerciales y estratégicas de Vodafone. La persona seleccionada trabajará en la intersección entre la explotación técnica de datos y la generación de insights de cliente y mercado, colaborando estrechamente con equipos de Marketing, Comercial, Producto y Strategy.

Buscamos un perfil capaz de identificar patrones de comportamiento de los clientes, analizar tendencias del mercado, monitorizar indicadores clave del negocio y desarrollar procesos automatizados que permitan optimizar la generación de análisis y la explotación de la información.

Principales responsabilidades


Analizar el comportamiento de clientes y tendencias de consumo en servicios móviles y de conectividad
Diseñar, construir y automatizar procesos de extracción, transformación y análisis de datos
Elaborar cuadros de mando e informes analíticos orientados a negocio
Monitorizar KPIs estratégicos del negocio Telco y detectar riesgos y oportunidades comerciales
Analizar fenómenos de captación, fuga y evolución de clientes para identificar palancas de crecimiento
Desarrollar estudios de segmentación y evolución de la base de clientes
Realizar análisis de mercado y seguimiento competitivo utilizando información interna y fuentes sectoriales
Colaborar en estudios de investigación de clientes, combinando información cuantitativa y cualitativa
Traducir análisis complejos en recomendaciones claras y accionables para stakeholders de negocio
Impulsar iniciativas de automatización y mejora continua en los procesos analíticos del equipo



¿Qué necesitamos?

Experiencia


Experiencia previa en posiciones de Customer Insight, Business Intelligence, Marketing Analytics, Data Analytics o Investigación de Mercados
Se valorarán especialmente candidatos procedentes del sector Telecomunicaciones o con conocimiento profundo del negocio Telco
Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos y entornos analíticos complejos
Experiencia en automatización de procesos analíticos y reporting



Formación


Grado en Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, ADE, Marketing, Ingeniería, Sociología o disciplinas afines



Habilidades técnicas


Gestión y análisis de datos
Dominio de SQL para consulta, extracción y transformación de datos
Capacidad para trabajar con grandes bases de datos y múltiples fuentes de información
Experiencia construyendo procesos de análisis y reporting automatizados
Analítica y estadística
Conocimientos sólidos de estadística aplicada y análisis de datos
Capacidad para interpretar estudios cuantitativos y cualitativos
Experiencia en segmentación de clientes y análisis de comportamiento
Conocimiento de negocio Telco
Conocimiento de los principales KPIs del sector telecomunicaciones:
Churn Rate
ARPU
Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
Portabilidades
Market Share
Capacidad para interpretar dinámicas competitivas y tendencias de mercado
Herramientas y programación
Excel avanzado para análisis y explotación de información
Conocimiento de Python para automatización y analítica de datos (muy valorable)
Experiencia con herramientas de IA Generativa o automatización aplicada al análisis de datos (deseable)


Aspectos muy valorables


Experiencia en entornos Telco
Experiencia en consultoría analítica, Customer Analytics o Business Intelligence
Conocimiento de técnicas de modelización, segmentación o análisis predictivo
Experiencia en investigación de clientes y gestión de encuestas
Familiaridad con herramientas de automatización, IA Generativa y asistentes analíticos



Soft Skills


Pensamiento analítico y orientación al dato
Capacidad para combinar visión técnica y visión de negocio
Habilidad para sintetizar información compleja y comunicarla de forma clara
Mentalidad resolutiva y orientación al impacto
Excelente interlocución con equipos multidisciplinares
Flexibilidad y adaptación a entornos dinámicos
Curiosidad intelectual y actitud de mejora continua



¿Qué te ofrecemos?

🌍 Trabajo flexible: 60% desde casa y 40% desde la oficina, ¡con horario flexible!

🏡 20 días adicionales de teletrabajo: Trabaja desde cualquier punto de España.

🗓️ 25 días de vacaciones: Además, disfruta de los días 24 y 31 de diciembre libres, y tienes la opción de comprar hasta 10 días adicionales.

🍽️ Tickets restaurante: Adicionales a la retribución fija y plan de remuneración flexible.

🩺 Seguro de salud gratuito: Cobertura con Adeslas, seguro de vida y un programa integral de gestión de cuidado de la salud y bienestar, tanto físico como mental.

💰 Opción de plan de pensiones. Asegura tu futuro con nuestras opciones de plan de pensiones.

❤️ 3 día de voluntariado al año: Dedica tiempo a proyectos de voluntariado con estos días adicionales.

🚀 Desarrollo de carrera y formación.

📲 App para la gestión digital. Organiza tu día a día en la oficina de manera sencilla con nuestra app.

Si quieres conocernos mejor, entra en nuestra web y descubre cómo sería la vida trabajando en Vodafone: https://www.vodafone.es/c/conocenos/es/vodafone-espana/trabaja-con-nosotros/

Title: Data Research Analyst (French Speaker)
Description:
About Morningstar

Morningstar is a leading global provider of independent investment insights, serving both individual and institutional investors across public and private markets. Our offerings include a wide range of data, research, and investment management services, with $300+ billion in assets under management. Operating in 32 countries, Morningstar supports financial advisors, asset managers, retirement plan providers, and more with comprehensive investment solutions.

About The Role

Our EMEA Data Team is looking for a Data Research Analyst to process our data across global markets. We are specifically looking for a French speaker. We are a team of data analysts who have effective relationships with other teams and are committed to deliver best quality data. As a Data Research Analyst in the Data Division, you will work closely with the Global Data Team and Local Business Representatives, taking responsibility for data coverage, quality, and timeliness to the highest standards. The Operation Data Analyst will form closer links with providers related to data acquisition processes and gain knowledge of our database. The position will be based in our Data and Development Center EMEA in Madrid.

Responsibilities


Collaborate closely with the global data teams
Data expert on investment data points, processes, methodologies, calculations & different fund structures
Manage business relationships with fund companies. Connecting with providers & setting up acquisition channels as well as acting as a point of escalation
Meet the predetermined production deadlines for internal and external clients
Continuously evaluate procedures, create and enhance analytical tools, and implement process improvement projects.
Utilize project management methodologies such as LEAN Six Sigma to track, evaluate and determine resolution approach for complex data issues.
Collect and maintain Morningstar data, ensuring high levels of data accuracy, completeness and coverage.
Demonstrate a high sense of ownership of the issues in the data ticket queue to be responsive and provide timely updates, follow-up, expedition, and resolution.
Understand roles, responsibilities, and expertise of internal partners to expedite issue resolution.
Translate requests from internal clients into detailed written specifications and user stories.
Improve and document client use cases to ensure any new functionality meets and exceeds client expectations


Requirements


Fluency in English and French Is mandatory
Fluency in Arabic would be an advantage
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent is required
Proficient oral and written communication skills.
Collaborates well in a team environment, have the ability to communicate and work with team members from diverse backgrounds, in a conscientious and inclusive way.
Sensitive to clients’ needs
Solid understanding of the financial industry and passionate about investment data.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills, capable of handling high volumes of data and meeting strict deadlines
You will be collaborating with cross functional teams and leading from the front when it comes to Operational data, Performance data, etc, so experience within data methodology/quality and processes is a big bonus.
Previous experience in project management is preferred.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel


Ready to Shape the Future? At Morningstar, every hire we make strengthens our mission to empower investor success. Apply now and help shape the future of investing with us.

Base Salary Compensation Range

EUR 30.000,00-40.000,00

Bonus Target

5% Annual

We expect the compensation and target bonus for this role to fall within the stated range. The specific compensation offered will depend on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and other job-related factors.

Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

Title: CRM Business Analyst
Description:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet The Team

The Marketing & Growth team is one of the largest and most dynamic at Fever, playing a central role in driving visibility, engagement, and business impact across the company. We work closely with nearly every department, combining strategy, creativity, and data to connect millions of people with unforgettable experiences.

Join us if you want to drive global impact, master data-driven creativity, and help millions of people discover their next unforgettable experience.

The Role

As a CRM Business Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of data, strategy, and customer engagement. Your primary job is to turn user data and business questions into actionable insights and concrete improvements to how Fever retains and grows its global user base.

You'll define customer segmentation frameworks, measure the impact of engagement initiatives, automate reporting, and help translate analytical findings into CRM strategies that the broader team executes. You won't just report numbers — you'll own the analytical layer that shapes what we do next.

What You'll Do


Design and maintain customer segmentation models, cohort analyses, and behavioural analytics frameworks to understand Fever's global user base.
Define measurement and attribution methodologies for CRM initiatives — quantify the impact of engagement campaigns on retention, frequency, and revenue.
Translate business questions into structured analyses, and analytical findings into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Collaborate with Data Engineering and Product teams to build and automate reporting pipelines, dashboards, and data products that track CRM performance.
Work with the CRM execution team to define audience targeting logic, personalisation rules, and trigger conditions grounded in data.
Identify growth levers across the customer lifecycle (acquisition, activation, retention, win-back) and propose data-backed strategies to improve each.
Support cross-functional alignment between Marketing, Product, and Data teams on customer strategy and CRM roadmap priorities.


Who You Are


Bachelor's or Master's degree in a STEM field — Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering (any discipline), or Computer Science. This is non-negotiable.
2–5 years of experience in a data-analytical role: customer analytics, business intelligence, management consulting (strategy/analytics practice), or CRM strategy.
Strong SQL skills — you can write complex queries to extract and transform customer data independently.
Python or R experience for data analysis and automation. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable scripting analyses.
Ability to build business cases and communicate data findings to non-technical audiences. You bridge the gap between the data layer and business decisions.
Structured, hypothesis-driven thinking — you approach ambiguous business questions methodically.
High level of English. Spanish is a plus.
Consulting or analytics background at a top-tier firm (Deloitte, McKinsey, Accenture, BCG, or equivalent) is a significant advantage.
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) is a plus. Familiarity with CRM or marketing automation platforms (Salesforce, SFMC, Braze, or similar) is helpful but not required.


Why You'll Love It Here


Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax-exempt).
Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance.
Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes.
Private health & dental insurance with Cigna: 100% covered by Fever. You can also add your family members via flexible remuneration.
Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.
Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location.
Snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available at the office.
Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.


Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

Title: Junior Operations Analyst
Description:
Descripción

En Rastreator, compañía referente en su sector, buscamos incorporar un/a Operations Analyst Junior con 1-2 años de experiencia para unirse al equipo de Business Analyst Operations, dando soporte al área de Call Center.




Formarás parte de un equipo multidisciplinar orientado a la mejora continua y a ofrecer la mejor experiencia al cliente. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con el equipo de Operaciones para impulsar una cultura data-driven, transformando los datos en información útil para la toma de decisiones. Entre tus principales retos estarán apoyar el desarrollo y la implementación de procesos de tratamiento de datos, así como la elaboración de informes y visualizaciones que respondan a las necesidades del negocio y ayuden a identificar oportunidades de mejora.




¿Quieres unirte a una empresa líder en su sector? ¿Te gustaría formar parte del equipo y ayudarnos a seguir creciendo? Si eres una persona entusiasta, dinámica y con capacidad de adaptación al cambio, tienes curiosidad por los datos, ganas de aprender y motivación para contribuir al crecimiento del negocio ¡Te esperamos!




Tus funciones principales serán las siguientes:




Análisis y seguimiento de los principales KPI operativos: contactabilidad, volumen de leads, conversión, ventas, productividad y tiempos de gestión.
Análisis de datos históricos para identificar tendencias, desviaciones y oportunidades de mejora.
Diseño y propuesta de mejoras operativas orientadas a optimizar la eficiencia y el rendimiento de los equipos.
Cálculo y seguimiento de los incentivos variables del equipo.
Análisis del rendimiento de las campañas comerciales y propuesta de acciones para mejorar sus resultados.
Control de los niveles de servicio y SLA, detectando desviaciones y proponiendo medidas correctoras.
Automatización y optimización de procesos operativos, mediante herramientas de análisis y reporting, con el objetivo de reducir tareas manuales y mejorar la eficiencia.
Análisis del dimensionamiento del equipo: evaluación de las horas disponibles, turnos, vacaciones planificadas y previsión de leads para anticipar necesidades de ampliación de horas y optimizar la planificación de las vacaciones según la demanda esperada




Si tienes:

Grado o Licenciatura en Estadística, Matemáticas, Ingeniería, Física, Economía, ADE, Ciencia de Datos o similar.
Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en funciones similares a las descritas.
Nivel medio de inglés hablado y escrito.
Excel Avanzado: tablas dinámicas y fórmulas avanzadas
SQL básico para consulta y extracción de datos.
Manejo de herramientas de Business Intelligence y visualización de Datos.
Capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados.
Atención al detalle y rigor con los datos.
Proactividad, carácter resolutivo y capacidad de trabajar en equipo.
Atención al detalle, organización y cumplimiento de plazos.




Y además cuentas con:

Conocimiento de KPI's de Contact Center: SLA, TMO, ocupación, contabilidad y conversión.




Te ofrecemos:

Salario Fijo + Variable.
Modelo de trabajo híbrido.
Horario flexible y jornada intensiva los viernes y en verano.
25 días de vacaciones. Adicionalmente tendrás la opción de comprar 5 días extra.
El día de tu cumpleaños tendrás un permiso de 3 horas.
Paquete de retribución flexible (restaurante, transporte y guardería).
Seguro médico para ti y tu familia, seguro de vida y Plan de Bienestar (App de contenido saludable, iniciativas que fomentan la actividad física, Plataformas de descuentos y mucho más...).
Acceso a plataformas de E-Learning.
5 días extra de vacaciones pagados para participación en voluntariado/proyectos solidarios.
Actividades disruptivas periódicas, Day off y fiesta en Navidad.
Oficina pet friendly.
Un equipo humano diverso con el que disfrutarás aprendiendo y trabajando.
Excelente ambiente de trabajo - Empresa Great Place to Work




¡Muchas gracias!
