Title: Sales Strategy Analyst
Description:
Wolters Kluwer is a global leader in information services and solutions for professionals in the finance, tax and accounting, risk and compliance, health and legal sectors.

We are currently looking for a Sales Strategy Analyst to join our Corporate Performance & ESG Business Unit.

CP & ESG delivers software solutions and services that help organizations manage financial, sustainability, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements, enabling better business performance, risk management, and compliance through data-driven decision-making.

About the Role:

The Sales Strategy Analyst provides analytical and operational support to the Sales Strategy and Revenue Operations functions, helping drive commercial effectiveness, revenue growth, and data-driven decision-making. This role is responsible for delivering actionable insights, maintaining sales reporting and forecasting processes, supporting sales compensation administration, and identifying opportunities to optimize sales performance. The Sr. Sales Strategy Analyst works closely with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure accurate reporting, strong data integrity, and efficient sales operating rhythms. While working under general guidance, this role applies analytical expertise to solve business problems, support strategic initiatives, and improve the effectiveness of the go-to-market organization.

Responsibilities:

Sales Analytics & Business Intelligence

Develop, maintain, and enhance sales dashboards, reports, and scorecards using Salesforce, Power BI, and other analytics tools. Analyze pipeline health, sales productivity, conversion rates, bookings performance, and forecast trends. Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to Sales Leaders and key stakeholders. Support recurring business reviews with data preparation, analysis, and presentation materials. Conduct ad hoc analyses to support strategic business decisions.

Pipeline Management & Forecasting

Support structured pipeline review processes and forecasting activities. Monitor pipeline movement and identify leading and lagging indicators affecting performance. Assist in maintaining forecast accuracy through data validation and trend analysis. Partner with sales leaders to identify revenue risks and opportunities. Produce reporting that supports territory planning, quota attainment, and sales performance management.

Sales Compensation Support

Assist in the administration and analysis of sales compensation programs. Support compensation calculations, plan validation, and payout reporting. Analyze compensation effectiveness and provide recommendations for improvement. Ensure accurate documentation and communication of compensation-related metrics.

Sales Process & Operational Excellence

Support initiatives to improve sales processes, workflows, and operational effectiveness. Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve reporting efficiency. Assist with CRM governance and sales process compliance. Document business requirements and support system enhancements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance commercial execution.

Systems, Tools & Data Integrity

Maintain high standards for data quality across Salesforce and related systems. Monitor data integrity and proactively identify data issues. Support adoption and effective utilization of sales tools and technologies. Assist with system testing, reporting enhancements, and process documentation. Partner with Revenue Operations, IT, and business stakeholders on technology improvements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success teams. Support strategic projects that improve revenue performance and operational effectiveness. Provide analytical support for business planning, territory management, and go-to-market initiatives. Build productive relationships with stakeholders across a matrixed organization.

Skills

Analytical & Technical SkillsS

Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving capabilities. Proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Ability to identify trends, patterns, and actionable business insights from large datasets. Experience working with CRM platforms, preferably Salesforce. Familiarity with reporting automation and business intelligence tools.

Business & Operational Skills

Understanding of sales operations, pipeline management, forecasting, and sales performance metrics. Knowledge of sales compensation administration and sales planning concepts. Process improvement mindset with attention to detail and operational rigor. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.

Communication & Collaboration

Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to present findings and recommendations clearly to business stakeholders. Effective relationship-building skills across cross-functional teams. Strong organizational and project coordination skills.

What We Are Looking For


Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant field; or equivalent experience
Experience: 2+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, Strategy, Finance, or a related analytical role.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and performance metrics for business stakeholders.
Exposure to pipeline management, forecasting, or sales planning processes.
Experience working with Salesforce, Power BI, Excel, and other sales analytics tools.



Join us at Wolters Kluwer and be part of a global technology company that helps organizations navigate complex financial, risk, and regulatory challenges. If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
As a Senior Data Analyst on our Growth team, you will play a pivotal role in driving our marketing performance to new heights. You will collaborate closely with User Acquisition and Growth partners to analyze data, find opportunities, and deliver actionable insights. Your work will empower strategic business decisions and improve player experiences.

What You'll Do
Partner closely with UA and Growth collaborators to understand performance, investigate business questions, and provide actionable recommendations.
Lead analytical projects end-to-end, from problem definition and data exploration through to insights and collaborator communication.
Own and evolve the business logic and analytical requirements of Growth data models, ensuring they accurately represent how the business measures performance.
Act as a key collaborator with Data Engineering, translating business and analytical needs into clear data requirements and validating delivered solutions.
Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues, inconsistencies, and gaps across Growth reporting and underlying data models.
Build and maintain scalable reporting and analytical solutions, reducing repetitive manual analysis where possible.
Define and maintain key Growth metrics and measurement logic across areas such as spend, acquisition, revenue, attribution, and marketing performance.
Perform deep-dive analyses to understand performance drivers, find opportunities, and support investment decisions.
Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical collaborators, including senior leadership.
Provide technical mentorship and share standard methodologies with other analysts while contributing to consistent analytical standards across the team.
Work closely with Data Scientists on measurement, experimentation, and modeling projects by offering solid analytical and data foundations.


What We're Looking For

We are seeking an ambitious and seasoned Senior Data Analyst with a proven track record of delivering outstanding results. You should have:
4+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related role.
Strong experience independently delivering analytical projects and working directly with business collaborators.
Experience owning or contributing significantly to analytical data models, metric definitions, or reporting foundations.
Advanced SQL skills and strong experience working with large and complex datasets.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation and analytical workflows.
Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and analytical data structures.
Experience converting business requirements into data requirements and collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams.
Proficiency in a data visualization/BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.
Good understanding of statistical analysis and experimentation.
Familiarity with digital marketing data, attribution, and acquisition metrics is a strong plus.
A strong ownership approach, comfortable independently driving work through to completion.
A curious and analytical nature, always looking to investigate unexpected results and challenge assumptions.
Realistic and dedicated to identifying ways forward.
Strong attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy and reliability.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities in a fast paced business environment.
Strong collaboration skills, capable of working effectively across Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, and business teams.
Excellent communication skills, able to challenge constructively and build trust with technical and non-technical collaborators.
Willingness to assist in the technical growth of other analysts and help maintain high analytical standards throughout the team.


This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) , who desires to contribute to the growth and success of our Data & Analytics Team.

You tackle complex business problems end to end, translating ambiguous questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations the business can act on.
You deliver data products rather than one-off reports, reusable models and tools that keep delivering value over time.

Demonstrated experience with Product Analytics tools (eg: Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, Google Analytics)
Demonstrated experience with BI Data Visualization tools (Qlik preferred)
Master degree in Statistics, Engineering, Economics or a related field is preferred
Previously worked in a Tech Company
English proficiency (written and spoken level B2)

Previous experience in the travel industry or similar sectors

MSX International es un líder global en servicios para el sector de automoción, presente en más de 80 países. Como Analista de Datos, serás responsable de gestionar, analizar y transformar datos clave relacionados con proyectos del sector automoción. Tu misión será convertir grandes volúmenes de datos en insights claros y accionables que apoyen la toma de decisiones, la optimización de procesos y el rendimiento general del negocio.

Preparar informes avanzados alineados con KPIs y requisitos del proyecto
Mantener, actualizar y asegurar la calidad de la documentación y reportes en herramientas como SharePoint y Office365

Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para convertir insights en acciones concretas
Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares internos en informes y dashboards
Presentar análisis, conclusiones e información relevante a equipos internos y dirección
Asegurar la precisión, consistencia y calidad de los datos analizados
Proponer mejoras continuas en procesos, metodologías y flujos de análisis

Habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar con equipos diversos

Capacidad para gestionar prioridades y trabajar con plazos ajustados
Dominio de Tableau, Power BI y Excel
Conocimientos de sistemas de gestión de datos, minería de datos, procesos ETL y reporting automatizado
Competencias en análisis estadístico y modelos de rendimiento
Experiencia con herramientas de automatización (RPA) es un plus
Conocimiento de Microsoft Dynamics (deseable)


Formación


Grado en Ingeniería, Economía, Estadística, Matemáticas o formación equivalente


Experiencia


Experiencia previa demostrable como Analista de Datos


Idiomas


Español nativo
Inglés B2 (escrito y hablado)


Información adicional

Puesto permanente con contrato indefinido desde el primer día.
Política de teletrabajo de hasta el 50% de la jornada mensual tras el periodo de adaptación.
Formar parte de un gran equipo de profesionales en una compañía internacional consolidada.
Obtener una visión global del sector automoción, interactuando con clientes, proveedores, consultores y concesionarios.

Acceso a MSX Bazaar, el portal de compras colectivas con grandes descuentos para empleados.
Posibilidad de adherirte al Plan de Retribución Flexible (seguro médico, tarjeta transporte, tarjeta restaurante, formación...).
23 días laborables de vacaciones al año según convenio y 3 días por año completo trabajado.

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Murphy deploys AI agents for banks starting with the most straightforward business case: voice AI for debt collection. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and SMS to maximize results while preserving trust.

We’re live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry.

About The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst to turn every transaction into the reliable analytics. You'll work directly with the co-founders and will own the metrics, models and dashboards behind every decision we make.

What you'll do


Own the numbers. Define the KPIs every team runs on, and make sure everyone calculates them the same way.
Build the source of truth. Write the data models and dashboards that turn raw call, debt and payment data into answers people trust.
Automate invoicing. Turn billing every bank, in every currency, into a pipeline that runs itself.
Prove what works. Design and read the experiments that tell a real lift in recovery from noise.
Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the root cause of every number that looks off, and fix it at the source.


Who you are


Highly analytical, and precise. You've built metrics and models a business actually ran on.
You're fluent in SQL and Python.
You own outcomes, and you never settle. You don't stop at the chart — you chase the number until it changes a decision.
You have a STEM degree, and you were top of your class. You're technical, you're rigorous with numbers, and you have a strong philosophy of a champion.
AI-native, ruthless on quality. You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default. You know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously.
You don't need a collections or fintech background. We'd rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can't ship — you'll pick up the data, the domain and the regulation cold, fast.


🤝 What we offer

📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential.

💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark.

🧩 Real ownership — Murphy's numbers are yours to define and defend.

⛳️ Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact.

👏🏻 The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it.

🍱 Healthy meals: No more boring tupperware – enjoy daily meals with Nora Foods. We cover 50% of each order!

💳 Cobee card: Flexible compensation for transport and restaurants, so you can make the most of your net salary.

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office in Poblenou, surrounded by a thriving tech scene, and 2 days of remote work. But if there’s one thing that defines us, it’s flexibility: we trust you to organize your time and space in the way that helps you do your best work.

Our Process

We believe that hiring is a two-way street: while we get to know you, you also deserve the chance to understand who we are, how we work, and what makes Murphy AI special. Here’s what you can expect:

1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You

A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive

You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case

A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ Coffee at the Office with the Founders

Finally, you’ll join us in our Barcelona office for a relaxed coffee with the founders and the Hiring Manager. It’s the perfect opportunity to experience our culture firsthand and meet more of the team who could soon be your colleagues.

👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.

Title: Senior Data Analyst – Subscription Mobile Games- GameHouse+
Description:
Senior Data Analyst – Subscription Mobile Games- GameHouse+

Location: Hybrid Barcelona (Spain) / Remote (CET time zone)




About GameHouse+

GameHouse has been building and publishing games for 25+ years, and we were early pioneers in subscription gaming for women 30+. That experience gives us a clear point of view: our players don’t come to GH+ for hype, pressure, or endless grind — they come for a reliable daily moment that feels good.

GameHouse+ (GH+) is a premium mobile gaming service for women 30+, offering a curated, high-quality experience designed for “Play Your Way” enjoyment. Players can choose ad-free access with a subscription or play with ads, while still getting calm, emotionally satisfying entertainment focused on stress relief and mental stimulation — built to respect their time, mood, and daily life.




Role OverviewWhat You Will Do

As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll work closely with small, cross-functional teams to help us understand our players and make better decisions across our subscription-based gaming ecosystem. Our setup is flat and collaborative. You won’t be a “report factory,” and you won’t work in isolation. Instead, you’ll partner day-to-day with Product, Game Teams, Growth, and LiveOps to explore questions together and turn data into shared understanding.

Our ecosystem includes a catalog of 100+ games and a central discovery app, so your work will span individual games, cross-game journeys, and the overall subscriber experience.




Understand Our Subscribers and players: Explore how players discover games, engage with content, move across the catalog, and decide to stay (or leave). Use data to surface insights that improve retention and long-term value.




Portfolio & Cross-Game Thinking: Look beyond single games to understand how the catalog works as a whole, what players play together, how discovery happens, and how different titles contribute to overall engagement.




Discovery & Platform Insights: Help teams improve the central app experience by analyzing non-linear funnels, recommendations, cross-promotion, etc.




Experimentation Together: Design and analyze A/B tests with product and game teams to learn what works, share results openly, and iterate quickly.




Turn Data into Stories: Communicate findings in a clear, approachable way. Help teams and leaders understand not just what happened, but why it matters.




Dashboards That People Actually Use: Build and maintain dashboards that give teams visibility into subscriber and game health without needing an analyst in the room.




Learn and Build as a Team: Collaborate with other analysts, data scientists, and engineers on deeper analytical projects, and be generous in sharing knowledge and best practices.




Support a Data-Literate Culture: Help colleagues become more confident with data, metrics, and experimentation.




What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is analytically strong, curious, and kind; someone who enjoys solving problems with others and is comfortable working across multiple products and domains.




Experience: Several years working in data analytics, product analytics, or a similar role, ideally with subscription products, games, or consumer apps.




Strong Foundations: Advanced SQL and solid R/Python skills for exploratory analysis and statistical work.




Experimentation Know-How: Hands-on experience designing and analyzing A/B tests; good understanding of applied statistics. Bayesian and sequential testing experience is a plus, not a requirement.




Visualization & BI: Comfortable building clear, useful dashboards in tools like Looker, Metabase, Periscope or similar.




Product & Player Mindset: You care about the player experience and can think at both the individual game and portfolio level.




Clear, Inclusive Communicator: Able to explain insights to different audiences and create space for discussion and learning.




Pragmatic & Impact-Focused: You balance rigor with speed and know when “good enough” is the right call.




Collaborative by Nature: You enjoy helping teammates, asking questions, and learning from others. We value how we work together as much as what we deliver.

En Dentaid buscamos incorporar un/a Data Analyst | Performance & Commercial Excellence para nuestras oficinas centrales en Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona).

En Dentaid trabajamos con un propósito claro: promover y mejorar la salud bucal de las personas a lo largo de toda su vida.

Como parte del área de Center of Excellence, contribuirás a impulsar una cultura orientada al dato, desarrollando soluciones analíticas que permitan optimizar la toma de decisiones, mejorar la ejecución comercial y generar nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento para el negocio.




🎯 Tu misión

Transformar datos operativos y comerciales en información fiable, automatizada y accionable, proporcionando visibilidad sobre el desempeño del negocio y facilitando la toma de decisiones basada en datos.

Diseñar y mantener dashboards e informes automatizados para el seguimiento de la actividad comercial y los principales indicadores de negocio.
Definir, documentar y asegurar la correcta aplicación de KPIs y métricas junto con las áreas propietarias del proceso.

Desarrollar herramientas y funcionalidades que faciliten la preparación de visitas y la priorización de acciones comerciales.

Colaborar de forma transversal con los equipos de Comercial, Marketing, Finanzas, Supply Chain, CRM e IT.
Impulsar la gobernanza, calidad y trazabilidad de los datos utilizados en la organización.

Grado universitario en ADE, Economía, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Data Science o disciplinas afines.
Experiencia de entre 1 y 3 años en posiciones relacionadas con Business Intelligence, Sales Analytics, Commercial Excellence o Reporting.

Title: Content Partners Data Analyst
Description:
Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role Overview

We are looking for a Content Partners Data Analyst to analyse how advertising drives user acquisition, engagement and retention for streaming, CTV, gaming and other content-app brands.

This is a client-facing role combining strong SQL and data visualisation skills with deep knowledge of the content-app market. You will analyse advertising, audience and app-usage data, build clear measurement frameworks and dashboards, use AI tools to accelerate insight generation, and present actionable recommendations to clients and senior stakeholders.

Key responsibilities:


Measure Advertising Performance: Analyse campaign exposure and performance across CTV, streaming, gaming and other content-app environments
Connect Ads to Outcomes: Measure how campaigns influence app usage, acquisition, engagement, retention and re-engagement
Build Client Insights: Turn complex behavioural and advertising data into clear, commercially relevant stories and recommendations
Develop Measurement Frameworks: Define KPIs and repeatable approaches for reach, frequency, incrementality, conversion and engagement measurement
Create Dashboards & Reporting: Build scalable visualisations and reporting that make campaign and audience performance easy to understand
Use AI to Accelerate Analysis: Apply tools such as Claude to speed up exploration, QA, insight generation and reporting workflows
Present to Stakeholders: Lead analysis readouts and confidently present findings to clients, partners and senior internal teams
Understand the Content Market: Track CTV, streaming and gaming trends and translate market changes into better measurement and client recommendations


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


5+ years of experience in advertising measurement, analytics or insights within streaming, CTV, digital content, gaming or a closely related industry
Strong SQL skills: Able to independently query, join and analyse large behavioural and advertising datasets
Advertising measurement expertise: Experience with campaign performance, reach/frequency, attribution, incrementality, conversion and engagement metrics
Content-app experience: Strong understanding of streaming, broadcaster, FAST, gaming or other digital content businesses and their growth and engagement goals
Data visualisation skills: Hands-on experience with tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Looker or Power BI and a strong eye for clear analytical storytelling
AI-enabled analytics: Comfort using tools such as Claude, Amazon Bedrock or similar LLM platforms to improve analytical productivity and insight generation
Excellent presentation skills: Confident explaining analysis and recommendations to both technical and non-technical internal and external stakeholders
Analytical curiosity: A genuine love of content, strong commercial judgement and the ability to turn data into actionable recommendations; Python is a plus


Benefits

Reasons to apply:


Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions


If you're excited about this position, don't hesitate to apply. We're waiting for you to join us! And if you want to know more about us, follow us on LinkedIn!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Data Analyst

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our team. You will be leveraging data to generate impactful insights for strategic purposes. This is a pivotal position to bring the business to the next level, you will support one of our business domain teams using analytics to drive better decisions at Perk.

What you will do:


Work with other Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists and Engineers in our team to generate advanced analysis that answers key business questions and unlocks opportunities.
Explore data from different sources, turning it into information, information into insight and insight into decisions
Design and develop metrics, dashboards, experiments and analyses to track and assess the impact of new initiatives and features.
Develop data frameworks and products to drive insights and behavioural analysis.


What you need:


2+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in data analytics or data science role, including relevant tools, techniques and technology
Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken, in English


You will need to prove the following:


You are a Master using SQL for data querying, transformation and modelling - experience with dbt is a strong plus.
Experience with statistical concepts and packages (Python / R)
Experience with data visualisation and BI tools (Looker)
Data storytelling and stakeholder management experience
The desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction, alongside highly engaged individuals.


AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position can be onsite (Paris) or full remote within CET time ±3h.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io 2.

With Paper.io2, we’re building an iconic game that players will never forget!

We're a small team of excellent people who take care of everything from ideas to testing, and we intend to grow while maintaining our high standards.

Role


Autonomously take ownership of the A/B testing cycle on Paper.io 2, validating feature values, refining key parameters, and optimizing monetization to drive core KPIs.
Lead analysis of large, complex datasets to uncover player behaviors and growth opportunities.
Translate data insights into clear, actionable recommendations that shape game design and the product roadmap.
Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and developers to embed data-driven decisions throughout the game lifecycle.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that keep the team aligned on critical metrics.


Profile


4+ years in analytical roles within gaming, comfortable working with product teams.
Skilled in SQL and either R or Python; experience with complex, large datasets.
Strong grasp of A/B testing and statistical analysis methods.
Autonomous and pragmatic problem solver with a sharp analytical mind and attention to detail.
Thrives in fast-paced live-ops/product-driven environments with rapid iteration.
Creative thinker who challenges assumptions and sees beyond the obvious.
Player-first mindset with genuine interest in games and player behavior.
Excellent communicator who turns data into compelling, actionable stories.
Collaborative team player who adapts quickly to change and ambiguity.
AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work.


Benefits


Best-in-class compensation
Other benefits based on your country of residence

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

Context of the role

We are looking for a driven and product-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day-to-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company.

You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics.
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools.
Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.
Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well-structured, and fit for analytical use.
Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.
Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.



Professional Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.
2-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role.
Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.
Strong hands-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development.
Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.
Proven ability to work with complex datasets and turn business questions into structured, actionable analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from stakeholder requests to practical data solutions.
Good understanding of reporting design, data visualisation best practices, and how to present insights clearly for business users.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.
Experience supporting multiple business functions and balancing different stakeholder needs in a structured way.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements, align expectations, and communicate clearly throughout delivery.
Demonstrated business curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding how the business works beyond the data itself.
Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to work independently and follow through from problem understanding to solution delivery.



Sound like you? Apply now!

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

Our platform combines content discovery and advertising technology in one solution, helping leading TV brands unlock greater value. Titan OS powers devices from major brands including Philips, AOC and JVC, reaching millions of viewers across Europe and LATAM. Titan OS is also powering free premium FAST Channels on selected SONY Android TVs.

Over the last two years, Titan OS has grown revenue 10x and attracted leading investors, including Highland Europe and Mangrove.

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

In this role, you will bring data to life through engaging visualizations and compelling insights that help business teams make confident decisions. You will partner with teams across the business to understand their strategic goals and translate them into actionable KPIs and data requirements. Working closely with Data Engineering, you will help define and deliver the data needed to track these metrics effectively.

You will apply your numerical and statistical expertise to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities within the data, turning your findings into clear recommendations for business teams and Senior Management. You will also help shape how data is used across the organization, driving a more data-driven and data-democratic culture.

Building engaging and intuitive BI dashboards and data visualizations
Accurately capture the data requirements that support the delivery of business objectives
Translate these requirements to the Data Engineering / Science teams and be responsible for their delivery
Proactively bring insights to the attention of the business teams with a high degree of focus on driving revenue and growth opportunities
Become a trusted partner to the business teams you work with. You should be seen as a knowledge peer, with subject-matter expertise in data
Bring new and interesting ideas on how to build data storytelling capabilities
KPI development and tracking - we own the measurement of the business


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


At least 6 years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Product Owner or Data Scientist
A strong numerical background with an MS/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a science-related discipline
High proficiency in Python and Dbt-SQLMesh
Ability to create tables and develop schemas that function efficiently, are optimized and scalable
Experience with statistical methodologies and A/B (hypothesis) testing is a huge plus
Hands-on experience using BI data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Open Source, etc)
A data storytelle, that can present data in a compelling and intuitive way
Fantastic communication and interpersonal skills


Benefits

Centrally located office in the heart of Barcelona, with public transportation nearby
Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions

Summary

We are seeking an organised and self-motivated Data Analyst to work embedded in our Everyday Banking team, to help shape the development of one of the world's leading FinTech products.

About The Opportunity

As a Data Analyst (Product) you will enable our product and business segments (Cards, Payments in the Everyday Banking domain to make data-driven decisions. You will monitor, measure and analyse the effectiveness of your product teams’ initiatives, as well as help drive the strategy of your business segment. You are here to establish a data-mindset and thereby to foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. You will work in a cross functional setup, working closely with other analysts, engineers, designers, and product managers.

In This Role, You Will


Help us set the right goals: Develop clear and measurable targets based on an initiatives’ scope. Improve our overall forecasting and goal setting capabilities.
Handle stakeholders: Be an internal go-to-person for your teams when it comes to data related questions.
Evaluate initiatives: Support Product experimentation & A/B testing initiatives; design test plans, obtain cross-functional alignment, execute robust analysis, and deliver actionable insights. Share these learnings through clear documentation and concise and empathic communication.
Contribute to self-serve data platform: Help building the right analytics foundations ,by pairing up with technical peers, so our product and business teams can interact with data and extract the right insights themselves.
Provide monitoring tools: Build the dashboards your team looks at every week to make sure they are impacting our company OKRs.
Improve data literacy of organisation: Educate teams to become independent when it comes to data access and understanding function led training and team wide workshops to foster data driven culture.
Be part of our data-community: Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations.
Support some of the following product & business team initiatives (not limited to):

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Growth)
Description:
⭐ Who we are




Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology.




Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.




⭐ Role Overview




The Growth Enablement Team is the connective tissue of our Growth organization: we don't optimize a single funnel stage, we build the foundations that let every Growth squad (Acquisition, Activation & Retention, Sales, and Partnerships) move faster, measure better, and experiment with confidence.

As a Senior Growth Data Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of marketing technology, data engineering, and growth analytics, spearheading Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), advanced data modeling, and campaign performance insights that directly shape multi-channel marketing investment and revenue growth.




You'll own advanced analytics frameworks end-to-end, mentor peers, and set the standard for data quality across the growth org.




⭐ How will you make an impact?

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM): You design, calibrate, and maintain Marketing Mix Models to quantify cross-channel marketing performance and guide long-term media spend allocation.
Growth data modelling: You architect scalable data models and analytical schemas that integrate multi-channel marketing, web, and product telemetry into unified growth datasets. You have expertise in the technological stack with BigQuery as the warehouse, DBT for production-grade modelling, RudderStack for event streaming, and Omni as the self-serve BI layer.
Campaign performance & insight generation: You conduct deep-dive exploratory analytics across acquisition channels (paid search, paid social, organic) to surface high-leverage growth opportunities.
AI-enabled analytics and agentic automation: You actively use AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting workflows, and improve insight generation speed across the growth org. You contribute to Lodgify's AI Enablement programme by identifying and deploying analytics automation opportunities.
CRM and lifecycle analytics: You design and implement measurement and incrementality frameworks for event-driven lifecycle workflows, evaluating their short-, mid-, and long-term impact on customer activation, retention, and lifetime value.
GEO and AI search measurement: You ****design measurement frameworks for AI search visibility, tracking share of voice in LLM answer engines and attributing traffic contribution from GEO channels where traditional UTM attribution is structurally insufficient.
Data storytelling & executive presentations: You synthesise complex quantitative findings into clear visual artefacts and strategic narratives for marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Attribution and measurement: You own Lodgify's full measurement stack, spanning MMM as the strategic budget allocation layer, incrementally and geo-lift testing to validate true channel impact, and privacy-first server-side event tracking as the data collection standard. You design measurement approaches for AI search and GEO channels where UTM-based attribution is structurally insufficient
Strategic cross-functional alignment: You partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to align growth analytics with core unit economics like CAC and LTV.
Data governance & analytics standards: You establish data documentation, reporting standards, and visualisation guidelines to raise overall analytical quality across the growth organisation.




⭐ What makes you a great fit:

Presentation and Influencing: Crafts compelling presentations that connect technical or functional insights to business outcomes, ensuring clarity and resonance across departments. Uses storytelling and analogies to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus without formal authority. Persuades through evidence-backed recommendations while addressing potential concerns upfront. Shapes direction by influencing decisions in cross-functional initiatives through clear, confident communication.
Data-Driven Mindset: Synthesises complex datasets into concise insights that guide decision makers, e.g., highlighting trends, anomalies, and risks. Uses multiple data sources (quantitative & qualitative) to tell a coherent story, and distinguishes between correlation and causation. Applies strong judgment in interpreting incomplete or noisy data, and articulates limitations. Coaches others in data visualization and storytelling, raising the team’s overall data literacy.
Business Acumen: Translates strategic goals into operational decisions and trade-offs for own work. Anticipates business challenges by integrating customer insights, market trends, and internal data. Builds a solid understanding of how different departments contribute to commercial success. Advocates for initiatives with clearly articulated business impact.
Problem Solving: Anticipates problems before they escalate and proactively mitigates risks. Develops creative, workable solutions to complex, cross-functional challenges. Balances trade-offs between resource constraints, stakeholder needs, and long-term business goals. Critically analyses multiple sources of information, validating credibility before making decisions. Guides colleagues on structured problem-solving techniques and decision-making frameworks.
Stakeholder Management: Anticipates stakeholder concerns and proactively addresses them in planning and delivery. Navigates complex or conflicting stakeholder priorities by facilitating compromise grounded in data and shared outcomes. Builds long-term stakeholder trust through consistent, transparent communication and follow-through. Educates stakeholders on technical or operational constraints to manage expectations and build mutual understanding.
Analytics Expertise. Proven experience with marketing analytics, deep knowledge of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and multi-touch attribution to evaluate and optimise growth campaigns.




Why you’ll love us:

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.




What's in it for you?*

🏠 Remote Flexibility: The freedom to work from home any day that works for you.

🌴 Time to Recharge: 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August..

💊 Alan Health Insurance: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.

😋 Meal Perk: €150/month allowance on your Alan card + 50% off Ametller Origen prepared dishes at the office.

💸 Tax-Free Savings: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for extra meal costs (up to €70/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).

🖥️ Home Office Gear: We provide a table, ergonomic chair, and monitor for your home setup.

🇪🇸 Language Learning: Free Spanish classes.

🤑 Referrals: Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.

🌟 Social Life: Daily office breakfast and monthly team events

🎯 Dynamic Hub: A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.

*Benefits offered may differ based on the type of contract that is issued




So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.


We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts



Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Expansion
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team

The Business Strategy Analytics team's mission is to transform data into strategic insights that empower our leaders to make informed decisions, effectively track progress, and unlock growth opportunities. Through deep metric understanding, holistic business views, and detailed analytics, we enable concrete actions that drive business success.

What You’ll Be Doing


Partner with Expansion leadership on major transformation initiatives shaping the value proposition, business model, customer experience, monetization strategy, and operational playbook for new geographies, segments, and product lines.
Evaluate and prioritize new market entries, customer segments, and strategic bets through rigorous market sizing, competitive benchmarking, and customer analysis
Run focused, data-driven deep dives into expansion-stage customer behavior, unit economics, funnel performance, and competitive dynamics to surface where to double down and where to pivot.
Lead cross-functional performance analyses across Expansion workstreams — surfacing trends, explaining the drivers behind new-market KPIs, and delivering clear, actionable insights to the executive team.
Build the analytical models that underpin Expansion decisions: market sizing and TAM/SAM/SOM models, ramp and forecasting models for new launches, scenario models to pressure-test strategic options, and financial models to quantify the upside (and downside) of each bet.


What You Need To Succeed


5+ years of experience in business analytics, product analytics, consulting, or a related analytical role.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, capable of influencing Leadership-level stakeholders.
Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
A proactive, curious mindset with a drive to investigate discrepancies and identify opportunities.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives.
Exceptional attention to detail and a rigorous, structured approach to analysis.
Proven Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills (e.g., driver-based modeling, sensitivity analysis, financial impact estimation).
Experience leading cross-functional analytics projects and engaging diverse stakeholders.


Nice to have


Experience in corporate strategy or strategic consulting, with a track record of supporting senior leadership on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives
Experience in fast-growing, data-driven startups, marketplaces, or subscription businesses
Hands-on experience with Looker and Snowflake


Why you’ll love it at Preply


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: Commercial Reporting and Insights Analyst – Healthcare – Barcelona, Spain
Description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Commercial Reporting and Insights Analyst – Healthcare – Barcelona, Spain

Please note, internally, this position is titled: Sales Operations Analyst

Meet The Team


You’ll join Dexcom’s Commercial Excellence organization, where data, systems, and insights support commercial planning, execution, and performance measurement across EMEA. The team is building a more connected, consistent data ecosystem to help regional and country teams make better decisions and drive commercial impact.
This role helps standardize commercial performance reporting, dashboards, and key metrics, turning agreed data definitions into timely insights that highlight trends, risks, and areas requiring action.


Where You Come In


Build, maintain, and improve standardized EMEA commercial performance dashboards and recurring reports aligned to agreed business definitions.
Partner with Commercial Excellence, Analytics, Sales Operations, Finance, Marketing, and country teams to translate reporting needs into practical, reusable solutions.
Support adoption of common key performance indicators, calculation rules, targets, filters, and reporting hierarchies across EMEA.
Monitor trends, variances, and exceptions to surface material performance changes and areas requiring follow-up.
Validate and reconcile reporting outputs, investigate inconsistencies, and coordinate resolution with data owners.
Create clear summaries and visualizations that explain what changed, where it changed, and why it matters.
Help rationalize existing reports and dashboards, reducing duplication and improving consistency across EMEA.
Maintain reporting documentation, gather user feedback, support testing, and promote effective use of standardized reporting.


What Makes You Successful


Experience in commercial analytics, business intelligence, sales operations, performance reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience building dashboards and recurring reports using Tableau or Power BI.
Strong understanding of reporting concepts, including metrics, filters, hierarchies, targets, trend analysis, and data validation.
Ability to use SQL, Excel, or comparable tools to analyse data, validate outputs, and investigate discrepancies.
Able to translate business questions into clear analyses, concise visualizations, and practical commentary.
Structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable documenting logic, reconciling outputs, and maintaining reporting consistency.
Effective collaborator with regional, country, business, data, and system stakeholders.
Proactive and execution-focused, able to manage recurring deadlines and follow through on open issues.
Experience in MedTech, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another regulated commercial environment is preferred.


What You’ll Get


A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
A full and comprehensive benefits program.
Growth opportunities on a global scale.
Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.


Travel Required


5-15%


Experience And Education Requirements


Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2-5 years of related experience.


Flex/Hybrid Workplace

Your primary location will be your assigned Dexcom site but you may work part of the week from a home office. You must live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically within an hour’s commute).

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

AI in Hiring Notice: We may use AI supported tools to help make our hiring process more efficient, consistent, and accessible for candidates around the world. All hiring decisions are made by people.

At Dexcom, we are committed to providing a fair and inclusive recruitment process, and welcome candidates of all genders and gender identities to apply. If any wording in this description appears unintentionally gendered or exclusionary, please be assured this is not intentional.

Should a reasonable accommodation be necessary to aid a disability, requests should be sent to Dexcom Talent Acquisition at talentacquisition@dexcom.com.

The annualised base salary for this position is from €41,055.00 to €53,130.00 gross. Final offer will depend on your qualifications, competencies, and professional experience.

Title: Data Analyst (CRM)
Description:
We are looking for Data Analyst (CRM), to join our team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What Will You Do

The CRM Analyst is the measurement and intelligence engine of the central CRM organization. Operating across all game titles, this person pulls, verifies, and reports on campaign performance; tracks trends; and ensures experimentation is structured to produce reliable, actionable results. Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance


Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs


Experimentation Design & Governance


Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations


Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights


Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns


Data Integrity & Targeting Validation


Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch


What We’re Looking For


4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.


Technical Skills


SQL (required)
Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Basic understanding of data pipelines and data quality checks


About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Title: Senior Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Senior Fraud Data Analyst, you'll handle one of the most critical challenges in digital payments: keeping millions of transactions safe in real time.

Here's What That Looks Like In Practice


Architect Real-Time Strategies – You will be responsible for our real-time decisioning engine, designing and deploying logic that combines ML scores with velocity features to make millisecond decisions.
Precision Rule Development – Translate complex fraud patterns into high-performing rules, optimising the balance between False Positive Rates (FPR) and Gross Fraud Loss.
Deconstruct Payment Fraud – Proactively hunt for emerging schemes (ATO, social engineering) and turn these insights into end-to-end mitigation strategies.
Optimise the Decisioning Stack – Partner with Product and Engineering to define analytical requirements for new features and third-party data signals.
Calibrate ML & Heuristics – Work with Data Science to operationalise machine learning models, determining how to best "wrap" model scores with heuristic rules.
Champion Frictionless UX – Analyse security measures to identify unnecessary hurdles, designing dynamic friction strategies for a seamless user experience.
Strategic Performance Reporting – Monitor rule efficacy and portfolio health, presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to evolve our risk appetite.


Who We're Looking For

This role needs someone genuinely curious about how fraud works, and driven enough to stay one step ahead of it.


Experience – You have at least 6 years’ experience, specifically within the risk, payments, or credit sectors.
Technical Proficiency – You are highly skilled in SQL and Python for data analysis and strategy development.
Domain Expertise – You have a solid understanding of payment fraud dynamics and experience working with real-time decisioning environments.
Communication – You possess excellent communication skills and are fluent in English.
Nice to Have – Experience with Machine Learning, Data Science, PySpark, or GraphQL knowledge is a significant plus.


Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:


❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!
