Title: Senior Supply Chain Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

About the role

As a Senior Supply Chain Data Analyst, you work on global transformation and optimizing projects in Supply Chain. You contribute to successful project outcomes by focusing on the end-to-end data roadmap, from data querying and data quality review to data analysis, dashboarding, data modelling and communication with client business and IT teams.

In This Role You Will


Support master data management and data governance activities, including data preparation, validation, documentation and stakeholder alignment.
Query, analyse and model supply chain data, and review data quality across large datasets.
Support data architecture and integration between ERP, APS and reporting environments, including data migration, data factories and data warehousing.
Create dashboards and analyses that translate data into business insights.
Work closely with project teams, client business and IT teams, and support workshops to gather data requirements and promote best practices.


Job Requirements

About you


3+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics, data consulting or a related field, preferably working with large datasets from ERP or APS systems. Experience with OMP, Kinaxis or S/4HANA is a plus.
You have good proficiency in data querying, analysis and dashboard creation using tools such as MS Excel, PowerQuery, SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Looker or QlikView.
You are familiar with master data management, data governance best practices, data factories, data architecture and integration.
You have strong problem-solving skills, an analytical mindset and an understanding of the business and customer context.
You have persuasive communication skills, are comfortable working with clients and can prioritize workload and communicate progress in a fast-paced international environment.
You like to learn and develop, are curious about how AI can improve data quality and integration, and are willing to stay hands-on with traditional master data work.
You hold a Master's degree in a relevant field, are fluent in English and are willing to travel globally and work in a hybrid setup from Barcelona. Spanish is a plus.
You feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together move fast and be kind!


Why join us?


You join a company built around supply chain transformation rather than broad, generalist consulting.
You become part of our supply chain data community, with different growth paths depending on what you want to deepen: data analysis, data quality, data modelling, data architecture, dashboarding, or people and process focused work.
You work on international supply chain projects where you do not only analyse data, but also help structure, cleanse, model, integrate and visualize it.
You leverage your expertise in a pioneering role, with the full support of our international team of supply chain and data experts to drive Barcelona’s success.
You are part of a global network spanning Belgium, the USA, Switzerland, Ireland, the Netherlands, Australia and Singapore, working on impactful international projects.
You have opportunities to travel to client sites, making your work truly international and engaging across borders.
You work on data that directly supports supply chain decisions, transformation projects and the successful implementation of planning solutions.
You work in a flexible and hybrid environment, combining remote work, office presence and onsite client visits.
You benefit from a competitive salary package.


About us

At Bluecrux, we transform supply chains into smart, efficient value chains through a blend of expert consulting and cutting-edge technology. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we're committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

Within the Supply Chain Plan business unit, we have built up specific expertise in three main areas: Life sciences/pharma, CPG&CH and Chemicals&Industries. In these industries, we support a range of global leaders in their E2E planning transformation journey such as Bayer, Johnson&Johnson, BASF and Bridgestone.

During these E2E supply chain planning transformations, our experts support our customers in every step of their journey. We partner up to define a vision and review the operating model to create a strong and agile basis for the future.

The Plan business unit designs & implements our customers’ business transformation by defining the future organizational operating model, designing new ways of working & solutions advanced planning systems (APS), feeding their data factory, accelerating their setup towards agile S&OP or guiding them through their end-to-end supply chain planning. We do not work for them but rather with them, and we stand by their side the entire time. That is the only way to make changes stick and flourish.

Title: BUSINESS DATA ANALYST - GLOBAL DISTRIBUTION
Description:
En MANGO vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad.

Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. Nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo.

Tu Nuevo Puesto

Tu objetivo será contribuir a la mejora de la distribución comercial y la gestión de stocks a través del análisis de datos y la participación en proyectos transversales. Trabajarás con los equipos de negocio, técnicos y de sistemas para identificar oportunidades, convertirlas en propuestas concretas y acompañar su implementación y seguimiento.

Tus Principales Responsabilidades


Extraer, preparar y cruzar datos de distintas fuentes con autonomía, asegurando la calidad y consistencia de la información utilizada en los análisis.
Desarrollar y mantener indicadores, dashboards y herramientas de análisis que faciliten el seguimiento del negocio y la toma de decisiones.
Analizar el comportamiento de las ventas, los stocks y la distribución, y elaborar modelos analíticos y escenarios que permitan identificar oportunidades, priorizar iniciativas y evaluar su impacto.
Participar en la definición y revisión de criterios y reglas de negocio para mejorar la asignación de producto, la reposición y la gestión del inventario.
Participar en la gestión y seguimiento de proyectos transversales del área. Acompañar la implementación de mejoras y realizar el seguimiento de sus resultados mediante los indicadores definidos, contrastando el impacto real con los objetivos previstos.
Traducir las necesidades de negocio en requerimientos claros para los equipos técnicos y de sistemas, colaborando en la validación de las soluciones desarrolladas.
Preparar presentaciones, conclusiones y recomendaciones que comuniquen de forma clara los resultados de los análisis.
Contribuir a la mejora continua de procesos, herramientas y automatizaciones.


Sobre Ti


Formación en Ingeniería, ADE, Estadística, Economía u otras disciplinas con una sólida base cuantitativa y analítica.
+/- 4 años de experiencia en roles analíticos con exposición a negocio, preferiblemente en entornos de retail, distribución o gestión de stocks.
Dominio de SQL y capacidad para trabajar con autonomía en la extracción, transformación y análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos, en entornos como Databricks.
Nivel avanzado de Excel. Se valorará experiencia con herramientas de visualización como Power BI o Looker.
Conocimiento práctico de Python valorable.
Capacidad para interpretar los datos desde una perspectiva de negocio y convertir los resultados en conclusiones y propuestas de acción.
Capacidad de organización, planificación y seguimiento de tareas.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y gestión de stakeholders, para presentar información compleja de forma clara y colaborar con perfiles de negocio y técnicos.
Nivel medio/alto de inglés.


Tus Beneficios


Disfruta de un horario flexible y trabajo híbrido que se adapta a tus necesidades. En MANGO, apostamos por la conciliación de la vida profesional y personal.
En MANGO, el fin de semana empieza el viernes a mediodía. Ofrecemos horario intensivo los viernes y vísperas de festivos.
Planifica tus vacaciones según tus preferencias. En MANGO, valoramos tu tiempo y queremos que disfrutes de cada momento.
Como parte del equipo de MANGO, tendrás descuento en todas nuestras líneas, ¡para que estés siempre a la última!
Disfrutarás de My Mango Benefits, nuestra plataforma de beneficios, desde la que podrás adaptar tu compensación a tu estilo de vida con ventajas fiscales, además de acceso a un portal de descuentos en múltiples marcas y servicios.
Paquete de retribución flexible con ventajas fiscales: seguro médico, formación, catering y programa de guardería.
Transporte de empresa gratuito desde Barcelona y El Vallés.
En MANGO, invertimos en tu crecimiento personal y profesional. Accede a una oferta de formación variada, mentorías personalizadas, programas de desarrollo continuo y oportunidades de promoción interna que te impulsarán hacia el éxito. A nivel técnico, podrás formarte en el uso de diferentes plataformas tecnológicas, así como participar en workshops, meetups, comunidades de prácticas, team buildings y company meetings.
¡Piensa en grande! MANGO te ofrece oportunidades internacionales en más de 120 mercados para expandir tu horizonte y crecer junto con nosotros a nivel global.


En MANGO, creemos en una cultura inclusiva donde la creatividad y la innovación nos inspiran a llevar la moda más allá. Por ello, tenemos el compromiso de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades para todas las personas, valorando la autenticidad de cada individuo.

Title: Data Analyst - Risk and Fraud
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

Job Ref ID: JR0076157

YOUR MISSION

Courier fraud costs Glovo millions a year. Account sharing, GPS spoofing, cancellation abuse, payment manipulation. Your job is to make that number smaller, end to end. You’ll design the detection logic, build the models, ship the dashboards, and push AI into the anti-fraud pipeline across every Glovo market. The problems are adversarial, the data is messy, and every percentage point you recover hits the P&L.

THE JOURNEY


Own the global fraud strategy. Define rules, thresholds, and detection logic across all markets. Iterate as fraud patterns evolve. Partner with Operations and Legal to align enforcement with local regulation.
Build detection frameworks that scale. Design and ship heuristic scores, rule engines, and anomaly flags for cancellation abuse, account sharing, GPS spoofing, and payment fraud. Work with Data Engineering to keep them running in production.
Bring AI into the pipeline. Scope ML use cases, partner with Data Science to build them, and own the path from prototype to deployed model. If central doesn’t build it, you do.
Ship dashboards local teams actually open. Build self-service monitoring so ops teams across 10+ markets can spot signals and act without waiting for you. Collaborate with local operations to make the tools fit their reality.
Quantify impact and drive decisions. Run deep-dives that end in countermeasures, not slide decks. Give leadership clear, regular reporting on fraud trends, financial exposure, and what’s working.
Think like a courier. Understand their incentives, pain points, and the vectors they’re exposed to, so the solutions you build are effective and fair.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay

Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content.

Role Overview

Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based.

Key Responsibilities


Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.
Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time.
Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process.
Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help.


Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise


Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team.
Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve.
The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls.

Title: Business Analyst Junior
Description:
Buscamos un/a Business Analyst Junior para transformar datos en información estratégica que facilite la toma de decisiones de negocio. La persona seleccionada participará en el análisis de resultados, la elaboración de dashboards, el seguimiento de KPIs y la evaluación de campañas, identificando tendencias y oportunidades de mejora.



Responsabilidades



Analizar datos de negocio para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades de mejora.

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards e informes utilizando Power BI y Looker Studio.

Extraer, transformar y analizar datos mediante SQL, BigQuery y Excel.

Definir y monitorizar KPIs para realizar el seguimiento del rendimiento del negocio.

Analizar campañas y evaluar sus resultados en función de los objetivos establecidos.

Traducir los resultados de los análisis en conclusiones y recomendaciones accionables.

Recopilar requisitos de negocio y colaborar con diferentes equipos para identificar necesidades.

Identificar oportunidades de optimización de procesos mediante el análisis de datos y la automatización.

Utilizar herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA para crear prototipos y aplicaciones digitales, integrando bases de datos, backend, frontend y APIs.

Participar en proyectos de Business Intelligence, transformación digital y mejora continua.



Requisitos



Entre 1 y 3 años de experiencia en Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Business Intelligence o posiciones similares.

Conocimientos de Power BI, Looker Studio, SQL, BigQuery y Excel.

Experiencia en elaboración de dashboards, reporting y seguimiento de KPIs.

Conocimientos de análisis de negocio y evaluación de resultados de campañas.

Capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y orientación a la resolución de problemas.

Habilidad para interpretar datos y comunicar conclusiones de forma clara.

Interés por la inteligencia artificial, la automatización y el desarrollo de soluciones digitales.

Perfil proactivo, organizado y con ganas de aprender en un entorno dinámico.

Job description:



 

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Finance and Controlling team and bring your passion and talent to work.

 

Senior IT Data Analyst 100%

 

Barcelona, Spain

 

Your contribution

 

In this challenging and important role, you will be responsible for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company’s SAP Datasphere and BW data landscape. Your responsibility is to ensure, from the definition of business requirements through to implementation and delivery, that data solutions are reliable, scalable, and aligned with business needs. You will work closely with business teams and IT to design and deliver high-quality data models, reporting solutions, and analytics capabilities.

 

The objectives and scope of the job are the following:

DataSphere and BW System ownership with administration, maintenance and development
Build, optimize, and maintain DataSphere models and reporting solutions.
Drive global reporting solutions across system landscape.
Integrate data from ERP, CRM, finance, and other systems.
Partner with business teams to design effective analytics solutions.
Analyze and visualize business data to support decisions
Create dashboards and KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud and explore new BI tools.
Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance (e.g., GDPR)
Lead or support BI and digital transformation projects.
Apply strong knowledge of SAP Datasphere and SAP ERP (S/4).

 

Responsibilities

Ensure availability, quality, consistency, and compliance of company data (incl. data protection and governance).
Support the strategic development of Tecan’s data landscape across platforms
Advise management and business units on data-driven decisions.
Prioritize, implement, and monitor analysis requirements.
Create data models, ETL processes, and related standards.
Provision of technical documentation and knowledge transfer within the team.
Support cross-functional projects throughout the full lifecycle (Design, Implementation, Testing, Go-live and Hypercare).
Enforce consistent application of tools, methods, and standards in data & analytics.
Provide documentation, training, and knowledge transfer to colleagues and business users.

 ·      

Your background

 

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

Extensive experience as a BI specialist/data analyst in SAP HANA.
Strong knowledge of SAP Datasphere, SAP ERP (S/4), SAP Analytics Cloud, and ETL Tools.
Experience in data modelling, SQL Scripts and performance optimization.
Understanding of SAP S4 data structures (FI/CO, MM, SD, PP)
Excellent analytical, communication and project management skills.
Hands on experience in Project Management.
Fluent in English and Spanish; German is a plus.
Team player with a structured, independent work style.
Degree  in Business IT, data science or similar is a nice to have.
Experience with OneStream, Salesforce, TableauNext, Power BI would be a plus.

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

Working in an international and diverse environment
The chance to grow your career within the company
Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture
Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Hybrid remote working model
Ticket restaurant
Private health insurance
30 working days of annual leave
Flexible working hours

Todo ello en contacto directo con el cliente.




Tareas





Análisis del uso que hace el cliente de los datos y estratégia de negocio.


Detección de oportunidades de explotación de sus datos y de datos externos con alto impacto en su negocio.


Exploración y análisis de datos, identificación de variables relevantes para resolver retos concretos.

Title: Lead Data Analyst – Marketing Analytics & Experimentation (Paid Search) | €61K - €75K
Description:
One of the companies we work with at Joppy is looking for a Lead Data Analyst to lead paid search analytics globally. They’re an international two-sided marketplace with several brands across many markets.




The question you’d own

The company’s brands often bid on the same searches. When they compete for the same customer, did the business actually grow, or did spend just move from one brand to another?

Your job is to answer that with experiments, causal methods and good judgement, and to turn the answers into decisions on millions in paid search spend.




What you’ll do

Prove what’s incremental. Design and analyze geo-split, channel and multi-brand experiments, and tell the team what really drives growth.
Guide investment. Model marginal returns, LTV and payback across brands, and help SEM leaders decide where the next euro should go.
Separate signal from attribution. Reconcile platform data with internal measurement and build the dashboards everyone trusts.
Set the agenda. Own the SEM analytics roadmap and act as the go-to thought partner for SEM, Finance and Data Science.
Raise the bar. Mentor analysts and review their SQL and methods. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports, but real influence.




You’ll likely have

6+ years in analytics, with examples of analysis that changed a business decision.
Advanced SQL, plus Python or R for statistical work.
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experiment design. Bonus if you’ve used causal inference or geo-experiments and can explain where they break.
Comfort leading big analytical projects and presenting to non-technical stakeholders.




Nice to have (they don’t expect all of these)

Marketing or paid-search analytics (CAC, ROAS, LTV), marketplaces or multi-brand businesses, MMM, dbt.

Paid search experience is not required. If you’re a strong experimentation analyst from product, pricing or growth, they want to hear from you.




What they offer

Long-term incentive plan (cash payout tied to company performance)
Pension plan + private medical insurance
25 days PTO
Flexible hours, meal allowance, flexible comp (transport, nursery)
Gym membership + annual wellness budget
Office with snacks, fruit and regular team events
Hybrid setup: office on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is up to you. You need to live in Barcelona or be open to relocating.

Title: ANALYST / SENIOR ANALYST - LOAN DATA & SRT OPERATIONS
Description:
Descripción del puesto:

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

En Servicios Operativos de Tesorería (SOT) trabajamos en el núcleo operativo de los mercados financieros de CaixaBank, dando soporte a actividades críticas de post-trade, lifecycle, liquidez, clearing, garantías, renta fija, derivados y nuevas iniciativas estratégicas de Tesorería. La nueva unidad especializada en Loan Data & SRT Operations se integrará en SOT con una visión transversal, apoyando a ALM Treasury & Funding en la calidad, trazabilidad y uso operativo del dato de activos que soporta las operaciones de titulización.

 

Misión del puesto


Asegurar la calidad, integridad, trazabilidad y explotación operativa de los datos de activos asociados a operaciones Synthetic Risk Transfer (SRT), contribuyendo al seguimiento de carteras, reporting, evidencias auditables y mejora continua del modelo operativo.

 

Responsabilidades principales

Gestionar y analizar loan tapes y bases de datos de activos subyacentes de operaciones SRT.
Ejecutar controles de calidad de dato, validaciones, reconciliaciones y seguimiento de excepciones.
Dar soporte operativo al closing y al lifecycle de titulizaciones: altas, bajas, amortizaciones, defaults e incidencias.
Preparar reporting operativo, evidencias auditables y dashboards para stakeholders internos, inversores y supervisor cuando aplique.
Diseñar automatizaciones y herramientas de control mediante SQL, Python, Power BI u otras tecnologías de análisis.
Participar en proyectos transversales relacionados con datos, regulación, originación, control y transformación operativa.

 

Requisitos mínimos
Titulación superior con componente cuantitativo: Matemáticas, Física, Ingeniería, Economía, ADE o similar.
Conocimientos sólidos de análisis de datos y programación: SQL, Python o equivalente.
Nivel alto de inglés escrito y hablado, con capacidad para interactuar con partners internacionales.
Manejo avanzado de Excel. Se valorará experiencia con Power BI, herramientas de reporting y data quality.
Interés por mercados financieros, gestión de riesgos, productos estructurados y dinámica de balance/capital.
Se valorará experiencia en operaciones financieras, riesgos, reporting regulatorio, gestión de datos o proyectos de transformación.

 

Competencias clave
Capacidad analítica
Orientación al detalle
Trabajo transversal
Autonomía e iniciativa
Aprendizaje continuo
Resiliencia y adaptación

 

¿Qué ofrecemos?
Incorporarte a una unidad de nueva creación, con visibilidad y recorrido profesional.
Desarrollar una combinación diferencial de expertise de mercados, análisis de datos y control operativo.
Trabajar en un entorno dinámico y colaborativo, con impacto directo en una actividad estratégica para la gestión de capital y balance del banco.

Title: Business Insights Specialist
Description:
Summary

El/la Business Insights Specialist – Can Tooling lidera las actividades analíticas que dan soporte al rendimiento del negocio, la planificación de la demanda y la estrategia a medio y largo plazo del segmento Can Tooling. El puesto se centra en recopilar y revisar datos internos y externos (ventas, producción, clientes e información de mercado) para garantizar que sean adecuados para el análisis y transformarlos en información accionable.

Entre sus principales responsabilidades se incluyen realizar análisis avanzados para identificar impulsores del negocio, tendencias y oportunidades; desarrollar y mantener modelos predictivos y previsiones de ingresos (incluidos los próximos tres meses); diseñar cuadros de mando e informes para supervisar indicadores clave; y dar soporte a la definición y seguimiento de la estrategia de precios. La persona actuará como referente analítico del equipo, apoyará la priorización de pedidos para contribuir a maximizar los ingresos mensuales y colaborará estrechamente con Producción, Ventas y Dirección como socio/a clave transversal

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Las principales responsabilidades de esta posición incluirán:


Recopilación y calidad de datos para el análisis
Recopilar y consolidar datos internos y externos relevantes (por ejemplo, ventas, producción, datos de clientes, informes de mercado, informes de visitas del equipo de Ventas, publicaciones y estudios de mercado) adaptados a las necesidades del segmento Can Tooling.
Análisis de negocio e insights
Analizar datos para identificar los principales impulsores del negocio, tendencias de rendimiento, riesgos y oportunidades para el segmento Can Tooling.
Segmentar a los clientes de Can Tooling en función de KPIs de valor y otros criterios relevantes para apoyar iniciativas comerciales y estratégicas.
Convertir resultados analíticos complejos en conclusiones y recomendaciones claras, concisas y prácticas para los directivos y las partes interesadas.
Actuar como referente analítico del equipo, proporcionando orientación sobre análisis, cuadros de mando e interpretación de resultados.
Liderar proyectos de modelización predictiva y forecasting
Desarrollar, mejorar y mantener modelos predictivos para prever la demanda futura de productos y apoyar la alineación de la capacidad con la demanda futura.
Elaborar y mantener previsiones de ingresos para los próximos tres meses, actualizándolas a medida que haya nueva información disponible.
Utilizar los resultados predictivos y de forecasting para apoyar la toma de decisiones en áreas como el desarrollo de mercado, la planificación de la demanda y la priorización de pedidos.
Cuadros de mando e informes
Preparar, actualizar y mejorar cuadros de mando de seguimiento del negocio utilizando datos de Hyperion (DW) y otras herramientas analíticas para supervisar indicadores clave relevantes para el segmento Can Tooling.
Soporte a ingresos y colaboración transversal
Colaborar estrechamente con Ventas, Producción y Dirección como socio/a analítico/a clave, garantizando que los insights, previsiones y cuadros de mando apoyen decisiones basadas en datos y la alineación estratégica.
Participar en conversaciones e iniciativas relacionadas con el desarrollo de mercado y la estrategia de ventas de valor añadido desde una perspectiva analítica.
Definición y seguimiento de la estrategia de precios
Definir y apoyar la estrategia de precios para el segmento Can Tooling, garantizando su alineación con los objetivos de negocio, el posicionamiento de mercado, el valor para el cliente y los objetivos de rentabilidad.
Supervisar la implementación y efectividad de la estrategia de precios analizando su impacto en indicadores clave del negocio como ingresos, precio bruto, beneficio bruto y evolución del margen.
Realizar el seguimiento de la evolución de precios por cliente, producto, mercado y segmento, destacando tendencias relevantes y proporcionando insights y recomendaciones claras para apoyar la toma de decisiones.
Colaborar con Ventas, Dirección y otros stakeholders relevantes para garantizar que las decisiones y acciones relacionadas con precios estén basadas en datos, sean comercialmente sólidas y estén alineadas con la estrategia general del negocio.



Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education And/or Work Experience


Grado y máster preferiblemente en Ingeniería Industrial o Gestión Industrial.
Se valorará muy positivamente experiencia en Excel, Power Query, PBI y modelado de bases de datos.
Al menos 1 año de experiencia trabajando en Product Management.
Nivel avanzado de inglés. Se valorarán muy positivamente otros idiomas.



Technical Skills/Physical Requirements


Actitud proactiva
Gran atención al detalle
Capacidad para trabajar en un entorno dinámico
Orientación al cliente
Iniciativa empresarial
Espíritu de equipo

Title: Business Operations Analyst
Description:
¿Te gustaría convertir datos en decisiones que tengan un impacto real en el negocio?

En LIDERING buscamos incorporar un/a Business Operations Analyst con una combinación de visión de negocio, capacidad analítica y curiosidad por entender cómo funcionan las cosas.

No buscamos únicamente a alguien que construya dashboards o prepare informes. Queremos una persona que quiera ir un paso más allá: entender qué está ocurriendo en el negocio, por qué está ocurriendo y qué podemos hacer para mejorar. Cuestionar constructivamente el "siempre lo hemos hecho así" y buscar maneras más eficientes de hacer las cosas. Que no se quede únicamente en el diagnóstico, sino que busca convertir sus análisis en decisiones y mejoras reales.

Trabajarás de forma transversal con diferentes departamentos, analizando información financiera, comercial y operativa, entendiendo sus procesos e identificando oportunidades que nos ayuden a trabajar mejor y tomar mejores decisiones.

Si disfrutas convirtiendo preguntas de negocio en análisis, y análisis en decisiones, queremos conocerte.

Misión

Impulsar la mejora del negocio a través del análisis de datos, la comprensión de los procesos y la identificación de oportunidades que permitan tomar mejores decisiones.

Tendrás una visión transversal de la compañía y trabajarás junto a las diferentes áreas para comprender cómo funciona el negocio, analizar sus resultados y transformar datos financieros, comerciales y operativos en insights, recomendaciones y acciones concretas.

Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, iniciativa y visión de negocio, capaz de combinar una mentalidad analítica con una clara orientación a resultados y mejora continua.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?


Analizar la evolución del negocio a través de datos de ventas, márgenes, rentabilidad, clientes, productos, compras y otros indicadores relevantes, identificando tendencias, desviaciones y oportunidades.
Transformar datos en insights y recomendaciones de negocio, ayudando a comprender qué hay detrás de los resultados y qué decisiones pueden contribuir a mejorarlos.
Trabajar de forma transversal con Ventas, Compras, Producción, Ingeniería y Finanzas, comprendiendo sus procesos y necesidades para identificar oportunidades de mejora y evaluar su impacto en el negocio.
Realizar análisis ad hoc y business cases para evaluar oportunidades, problemáticas o iniciativas desde una perspectiva económica y de negocio.
Definir y monitorizar KPIs de negocio y performance junto con los responsables de las diferentes áreas.
Diseñar, desarrollar y evolucionar dashboards y cuadros de mando en Power BI, convirtiendo la información disponible en herramientas útiles para la gestión y la toma de decisiones.
Identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos, utilizando los datos y el conocimiento del negocio para detectar ineficiencias, cuellos de botella y nuevas formas de trabajar.

Title: Business Intelligence Developer
Description:
🤗 ¿Quiénes somos? 🤗




Edenred, empresa reconocida como una de las “100 mejores empresas para trabajar en España” en 2024 y certificada como Great Place to Work, nació llena de ilusión hace más de 60 años, siendo pioneros en el desarrollo de beneficios sociales para equipos y operando en la actualidad en 45 países, ofreciendo soluciones como plataforma digital a 60 millones de usuarios.




Desde nuestros inicios, hemos mantenido vivo un sueño que sigue presente en todas las decisiones de la compañía: generar conexiones de valor que fomenten el crecimiento de nuestros stakeholders y de la sociedad en general.




😊 Misión del puesto 😊




Como Business Intelligence Developer tu misión será diseñar, desarrollar y mantener soluciones de Business Intelligence que transformen los datos en información clara, fiable y accionable, facilitando la toma de decisiones estratégicas y operativas del negocio.




Actuarás como nexo entre los equipos de negocio y los datos, asegurando una correcta interpretación de la información y una experiencia de usuario óptima a través de soluciones de reporting y visualización de alto impacto.




En su día a día, el rol estará enfocado en:

Desarrollo de dashboards y reportes orientados a negocio
Análisis de datos y generación de insights clave
Diseño de visualizaciones intuitivas y centradas en el usuario
Garantizar la consistencia, calidad y correcto uso del dato




📚Tus principales responsabilidades📚




1. Business Intelligence & Reporting




Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards e informes interactivos orientados a negocio.
Traducir requerimientos funcionales en soluciones BI claras, eficientes y fáciles de consumir.
Aplicar principios de visualización de datos, UX/UI y data storytelling en dashboards y reportes.
Participar en la definición de KPIs y métricas de negocio, asegurando consistencia y alineación.
Optimizar el rendimiento de dashboards, modelos semánticos y consultas SQL / DAX.
Definir y mantener estándares de diseño y buenas prácticas de BI.




2. Análisis de datos




Analizar datos para identificar tendencias, desviaciones y oportunidades de mejora.
Apoyar a los equipos de negocio en la interpretación correcta de los datos.
Elaborar documentación funcional de dashboards, KPIs y lógicas de cálculo.
Actuar como punto de referencia en el uso correcto de indicadores e informes.




3. Gestión del dato (nivel BI)




Validar la calidad y consistencia del dato consumido en BI.
Gestionar incidencias de datos y coordinar con equipos de IT cuando sea necesario.
Asegurar una interpretación común de los KPIs y métricas entre usuarios.







🤓 Requisitos deseables 🤓




-Más de 3 años de experiencia en Business Intelligence, Análisis de datos o Controlling/ performance management.

-Experiencia práctica en entornos analíticos orientados a negocio.

-Dominio de inglés hablado y escrito (interacciones con sede y data community de otros business).

-Se valorará Grado en Administración de Empresas, Ciencia de Datos, Ingeniería informática, o Estadística.

-Imprescindible tener experiencia en :

Herramientas de Business Intelligence y visualización (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik u otras) y habilidades analíticas sólidas.
Databricks como plataforma de datos (uso de notebooks -SQL/Python-, consumo de datos desde Delta Lake, comprensión de arquitecturas Lakehouse).
Conocimientos sólidos en SQL y modelado de datos (modelo estrella, relaciones, métricas).
Experiencia en lenguajes analíticos como DAX (o equivalentes según herramienta BI) e integrando múltiples fuentes de datos.

-Es deseable que el/la candidata posea:

Conocimientos en Data Engineering básico (pipelines, optimización de queries).
Experiencia de storytelling con datos y presentaciones ejecutivas.
Conocimiento de herramientas de diseño (Figma, Adobe XD, similares).
Experiencia en entornos cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP) y en metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban).




🤗 ¿Qué Podemos ofrecerte? 🤗




Edenred está aquí para ofrecerte un montón de beneficios que te ayudarán a sentirte bien y a equilibrar tu vida laboral y personal. ¡Échales un vistazo ya que están pensados especialmente para ti y tu bienestar!




-Ticket Restaurant 11€/día de lunes a jueves entre septiembre y junio.

-Flexibilidad horaria en entrada y salida, además de jornada intensiva todos los viernes del año así como los meses de julio y agosto.

-Formato hibrido de trabajo: hasta 8 días de teletrabajo al mes.

-Office Day: día semanal en la oficina con desayuno, café y fruta incluida.

-Entorno dinámico y multidisciplinar.

-Actividades en días clave como voluntariados, Women & Pride week, cena de navidad, entre otras.




Y no menos importante, ¡un ambiente laboral de 10!




¿A qué esperas para que te podamos conocer?




Edenred se basa en la meritocracia. Vienes tal y como eres y contribuyes. De hecho, el Grupo Edenred reconoce, contrata y desarrolla todos los talentos y singularidades. Nos comprometemos a prevenir cualquier forma de discriminación y a ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades a todos nuestros candidatos, independientemente de su género y expresión de género, discapacidad, origen, creencias religiosas y orientación sexual o cualquier otro criterio.

Actuarás como nexo entre los equipos de negocio y los datos, asegurando una correcta interpretación de la información y una experiencia de usuario óptima a través de soluciones de reporting y visualización de alto impacto.


En su día a día, el rol estará enfocado en:

  • Desarrollo de dashboards y reportes orientados a negocio
  • Análisis de datos y generación de insights clave
  • Diseño de visualizaciones intuitivas y centradas en el usuario
  • Garantizar la consistencia, calidad y correcto uso del dato


📚Tus principales responsabilidades📚


1. Business Intelligence & Reporting


  • Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards e informes interactivos orientados a negocio.
  • Traducir requerimientos funcionales en soluciones BI claras, eficientes y fáciles de consumir.
  • Aplicar principios de visualización de datos, UX/UI y data storytelling en dashboards y reportes.
  • Participar en la definición de KPIs y métricas de negocio, asegurando consistencia y alineación.
  • Optimizar el rendimiento de dashboards, modelos semánticos y consultas SQL / DAX.
  • Definir y mantener estándares de diseño y buenas prácticas de BI.


2. Análisis de datos


  • Analizar datos para identificar tendencias, desviaciones y oportunidades de mejora.
  • Apoyar a los equipos de negocio en la interpretación correcta de los datos.
  • Elaborar documentación funcional de dashboards, KPIs y lógicas de cálculo.
  • Actuar como punto de referencia en el uso correcto de indicadores e informes.


3. Gestión del dato (nivel BI)


  • Validar la calidad y consistencia del dato consumido en BI.
  • Gestionar incidencias de datos y coordinar con equipos de IT cuando sea necesario.
  • Asegurar una interpretación común de los KPIs y métricas entre usuarios.



🤓 Requisitos deseables 🤓


-Más de 3 años de experiencia en Business Intelligence, Análisis de datos o Controlling/ performance management.

-Experiencia práctica en entornos analíticos orientados a negocio.

-Dominio de inglés hablado y escrito (interacciones con sede y data community de otros business).

-Se valorará Grado en Administración de Empresas, Ciencia de Datos, Ingeniería informática, o Estadística.

-Imprescindible tener experiencia en :

  • Herramientas de Business Intelligence y visualización (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik u otras) y habilidades analíticas sólidas.
  • Databricks como plataforma de datos (uso de notebooks -SQL/Python-, consumo de datos desde Delta Lake, comprensión de arquitecturas Lakehouse).
  • Conocimientos sólidos en SQL y modelado de datos (modelo estrella, relaciones, métricas).
  • Experiencia en lenguajes analíticos como DAX (o equivalentes según herramienta BI) e integrando múltiples fuentes de datos.

-Es deseable que el/la candidata posea:

  • Conocimientos en Data Engineering básico (pipelines, optimización de queries).
  • Experiencia de storytelling con datos y presentaciones ejecutivas.
  • Conocimiento de herramientas de diseño (Figma, Adobe XD, similares).
  • Experiencia en entornos cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP) y en metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban).

Title: TÈCNIC/A ANALISTA DE NEGOCI
Description:
Ametller Origen som una empresa en expansió del sector alimentari que gestiona de forma integral el procés de producció i comercialització dels seus productes. Cultivem, elaborem i seleccionem els nostres productes per garantir sabor i qualitat des de l'origen.

El nostre propòsit és promoure un estil de vida més saludable i sostenible, facilitant l’accés a una alimentació més nutritiva, plaent i neta, amb un ferm compromís amb la societat i el medi ambient.

Vols formar part del nostre equip i unir-te a nosaltres per fer arribar el nostre propòsit a la comunitat?

Volem incorporar un/a Tècnic/a Analista de Negoci per actuar com a referent d’Analytics dins dels àmbits d’operacions i retail, transformant les necessitats del negoci en solucions analítiques útils, fiables i accionables que facilitin la presa de decisions, assegurin la qualitat de la informació i impulsin l’autonomia analítica del negoci.

Què faràs?


Produiràs, manteniràs i evolucionaràs els productes analítics del domini, incloent dashboards operatius, alertes proactives, monitoritzacions automàtiques i anàlisis recurrents, assegurant-ne l’ús, la qualitat, l’actualització i la retirada quan deixin d’aportar valor.
Traduiràs les necessitats del negoci en preguntes analítiques concretes, preparant briefings complets i assegurant que les peticions estan ben definides abans d’iniciar qualsevol solució o entregable.
Dissenyaràs i consolidaràs el model d’autoconsum analític del domini, facilitant que l’equip pugui resoldre les consultes habituals de manera autònoma a partir de dades certificades.
Resoldràs anàlisis ad hoc i consultes puntuals de l’àrea utilitzant la capa de dades existent i certificada, evitant dependències innecessàries de l’equip de Data per a consultes estàndard.
Especificaràs a l’equip de Data les necessitats de dades no disponibles, detallant què es necessita, amb quina finalitat i amb quin nivell de granularitat.
Executaràs el control de qualitat i la validació funcional dels nous models de dades lliurats per l’equip de Data, abans que la informació es publiqui com a capa certificada i es comparteixi com a dada oficial.
Participaràs en projectes analítics transversals com a expert/a funcional del domini, aportant coneixement del negoci, dels processos i de les palanques de decisió de l’àrea.
Identificaràs de manera proactiva oportunitats, riscos, tendències o desviacions del domini, proposant anàlisis, alertes o millores que ajudin a anticipar decisions.
Habilitaràs el Power User Líder del domini, formant-lo, explicant-li les eines disponibles, recollint feedback i mesurant el seu grau d’autonomia.
Presentaràs tancaments operatius de l’àrea amb dades certificades, interpretació accionable i orientació a la presa de decisions.
Escalaràs a l’Analytics Specialist els projectes que requereixin major complexitat tècnica i al Head of Analytics les situacions que excedeixin la capacitat, impliquin nous KPI mestres, creuin diversos dominis o generin conflictes de priorització.
Participaràs en els rituals transversals del pilar Analytics, com l’intake setmanal, els comitès de priorització, les sessions d’adopció i les retrospectives del model.


¿Què busquem de tu?

Grau universitari en Administració i Direcció d'Empreses, Economia o similar.

Experiència prèvia relacionada amb la posició 2-4anys. Valorable coneixement pràctic del model operatiu del retail.

Nivell avançat de Microsoft Excel. Coneixement d'usuari d’ eines de BI com Power BI, Looker o similar.

Disposar de carnet de conduir i vehicle propi per accedir a les oficines.

¿Què t’oferim?

Incorporar-te a una empresa líder del sector, amb un model de negoci únic i diferenciat, en ple procés de creixement i expansió.

Contracte indefinit.

Lloc de treball: Olèrdola/Teletreball.

Vols formar part del nostre equip?

Title: eCommerce Analyst & Demand Planner
Place: El Prat de Llobregat, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
Revelyst – Adventure Sports Group Europe is a fast-growing action sports company that prides itself on attracting passionate and talented individuals. We are looking for a data-driven, analytical and commercially minded Amazon eCommerce Analyst & Demand Planner to join our team.

This role sits at the intersection of eCommerce, demand planning and commercial analytics, turning POS, inventory and sales data into clear forecasts, actionable insights and operational decisions. The position will support Amazon account management, demand planning and day-to-day business performance across EMEA.

The main tasks of the position are:

The Amazon eCommerce Analyst & Demand Planner will be responsible for analyzing commercial data, supporting forecasting activities, monitoring Amazon operational health and acting as a bridge between Sales, Planning and Operations.




Commercial Analytics & Insight Generation

• Build and maintain regular state-of-the-business dashboards using revenue, POS and inventory data

• Analyze sell-out, sell-in, rejections, stock cover and purchasing trends to support strategy development and decision-making

• Identify incremental sales opportunities and potential business risks through data analysis

• Deliver clear, data-backed recommendations to internal stakeholders

• Present findings and insights to senior executives and external customer teams when required

• Collaborate with Marketing, Finance and Product teams on third-party data to enrich commercial understanding




Demand Planning & Forecasting

• Support Sales and Demand Planning with long-range forecasting

• Integrate commercial signals into the S&OP process

• Work closely with the Wholesale Demand Planning team to align forecasts and monitor inventory shifts and risks

• Monitor stock cover and support the maintenance of optimal inventory levels

• Maintain the central planning database up to date by season

• Ensure planning data is accurate and available to support buy decisions and replenishment planning




Amazon Operational Health & Vendor Central

• Monitor and maintain Amazon account operational health on a daily basis

• Track key metrics including stock levels, inventory shifts and confirmation rates

• Maintain close communication with the Amazon Customer Success team regarding chargeback reports

• Regularly review Amazon reports and proactively flag potential risks

• Manage action items within Amazon Vendor Central

• Support operational tasks, ad hoc requests and recurring activities within Vendor Central




Cross-functional Collaboration & Process Improvement

• Act as the bridge between Sales, Planning and operational functions including Demand Planning, Supply Chain and Amazon Operations

• Ensure information flows accurately between business stakeholders and operational teams

• Proactively identify process gaps and recommend improvements to reduce friction and improve business performance

• Document process implementations

• Build easy-to-use KPI tracking tools so the Sales team can monitor territory performance




Position requirements:

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Supply Chain, Economics or a related field

• 2–4 years of experience in an eCommerce, data analytics, demand planning or commercial operations role

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query and XLOOKUP

• Working knowledge of SAP (SD/MM) for sales and inventory data

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Vendor Central

• Experience building dashboards and reporting tools

• Experience translating complex data into clear business insights

• Experience supporting Sales or Demand Planning functions




Competences:

• Strong accountability and drive for results

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

• Action-oriented and proactive approach

• Strong planning and organizational skills

• Ability to build effective relationships with cross-functional teams

• Customer-focused mindset

• Strong operational excellence

• Ability to work effectively with complex data and translate it into actionable insights




Preferred

• Experience with Power BI or equivalent dashboarding tools

• Familiarity with third-party data sources such as NPD or similar

• Background in eCommerce, retail or consumer goods

• Familiarity with action sports, outdoor or performance gear industry

• Experience working with cross-functional teams in an EMEA or international context




📩 Sounds like you? Apply now and join our Amazon eCommerce & Planning team in Europe.

Title: FLIGHT OPERATIONS ANALYST
Description:
At Vueling, we connect people, places and opportunities ✈️

As part of the IAG Group, we are one of Europe’s leading airlines, serving around 250 routes across 30 countries and welcoming millions of customers every year. With more than 5,000 employees, Vueling is the only European airline recognized as a Top Employer for three consecutive years. Driven by innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to sustainability, we are shaping the future of aviation while creating an environment where our people can grow, contribute, and make an impact.

Mission

The Flight Operations Analyst is responsible for analysing, monitoring and optimising flight operations performance, ensuring operational efficiency and compliance with aviation standards. The role supports Flight Operations Management through data analysis, KPI monitoring, operational reporting and continuous improvement initiatives, providing insights that contribute to better decision-making and crew engagement.

Tasks & Responsibilities


Monitor and report monthly operational KPIs for Flight Operations Management and the Director.
Prepare and analyse monthly diversion reports and related surveys.
Manage and analyse Return to Stand reports in collaboration with MEL and FCOM teams.
Control and report monthly headcount and FTE data.
Track crew seniority by base and analyse pilot flight hours on a weekly basis.
Analyse operational delays and provide reports directly to managers, chief pilots and senior leadership.
Participate in and support operational projects, surveys and improvement initiatives for Flight Operations leadership.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and databases to support performance monitoring and decision-making.
Manage crew base and detachment data and processes.
Maintain regular communication with pilots through operational notifications and updates.
Collaborate in the creation of the monthly Performance Newsletter, gathering operational insights and recommendations for flight crews.


Academic Background


Bachelor's degree in Aviation Management, Aviation Engineering, Business Administration, Economics or a related field.


Experience


Minimum 1 year of experience in operational environments, such as airport operations, airline operations, or analytical roles involving operational performance and reporting.


Skills


Strong analytical and numerical skills with high attention to detail and data accuracy.
Excellent problem-solving capabilities and ability to work under deadlines.
Strong teamwork and communication skills.
Advanced Excel skills, including macros, formulas and data analysis tools (mandatory).
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Word.
Experience with AIMS systems (mandatory).
Knowledge of Tableau for dashboard creation and data visualisation.
SQL and/or Python skills would be considered an asset.
English level B2 minimum (mandatory).

Our values are what we believe in, what we stand for and how we behave.

Make it better
Make it safe
Make it cost-focused
Make it customer-oriented
Win together

Title: Marketing Analyst, New Business and M&A
Description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.




We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.




Job Summary:

Toptal is looking for a Marketing Analyst to build and own the marketing data infrastructure to support new businesses and companies we acquire through M&A. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. You will track paid advertising performance and translate it into metrics such as LTV and ROAS that inform budget allocation and channel strategy, from structuring the underlying data pipelines to developing the reports that help marketing and business leaders make data-driven decisions.




Are you passionate about bringing rigor to how early-stage businesses measure and optimize acquisition spend from day one? If so, we encourage you to apply! This person will define the metrics that matter, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports that drive decisions. They will also build models, forecast outcomes, run experiments, and perform in-depth diagnostic analysis.




Ultimate success goes beyond data-related activities, you’ll be delivering the “so what” that drives decisions and real business impact. It is imperative to fully understand each business (processes, objectives, organization, performance drivers, barriers), and connect the dots between paid acquisition data, marketing strategy, and financial and operational effectiveness. This role partners closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions, ensuring marketing performance insights are integrated with the broader business and revenue picture. We expect that we not only answer the question asked, but also the question that was not.




This Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude.




This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.




Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions.
Build, own, and maintain the marketing data infrastructure, from ad impression and click through lead acquisition to revenue, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other paid advertising platforms as required.
Rapidly assess and integrate the marketing data of newly acquired (M&A) companies, establishing tracking, attribution, and reporting so their acquisition spend is measured with the same rigor as the rest of Toptal.
Measure and diagnose paid advertising performance across channels and businesses—analyzing spend efficiency, CAC, funnel conversion, lead value, ROAS, and LTV—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy.
Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives, including consistent definitions of LTV, ROAS, and payback across businesses.
Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders and business owners.
Partner closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions to connect marketing performance with revenue, unit economics, and the broader business picture.
Map marketing processes and channel journeys to their corresponding data flows across acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation.
Proactively identify and surface opportunities to improve efficiency, conversion, revenue generation, client and talent experience, operations, communication, systems & tools, cash usage, etc.
Leverage Generative AI tools to accelerate analysis and automate reporting workflows.




Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree is required.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics.
Demonstrated experience analyzing paid advertising performance (e.g., Google Ads and other paid media platforms) and translating it into metrics such as LTV, CAC, and ROAS is required.
Demonstrated experience building or owning marketing data infrastructure (tracking, attribution, data pipelines, and reporting) is required.
Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus.
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.).
Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus.
Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting.
Experience with exploratory data analysis, prototyping, testing hypotheses, performing root cause analyses, modeling business processes, building forecasts, creating predictive models, defining metrics, and/or measuring marketing performance.
Track record of linking data and analytics to marketing strategy, financial performance, and operations to drive real impact.
Working knowledge of probability and statistics, experience with process improvement is a plus.
Experience in a startup, early-stage business, or M&A integration environment is a plus.
Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders and balance multiple, conflicting priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Ability to explain complex issues simply and intuitively, and willingness to challenge assumptions, communicate limitations, and flag blind spots.
The ideal candidate needs to have a strong technical background particularly when it comes to marketing data infrastructure and Google products (Google Analytics, Google Ads) while having the ability to master marketing processes of diverse nature.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Title: FinOps Reporting Analyst
Description:
Job Description

We are Adevinta, a leading online classifieds group and champion for sustainable commerce across Europe and beyond. With digital marketplaces across many countries, our portfolio spans consumer goods, mobility, real estate, holiday rentals and jobs. Together, our marketplaces attract more than 120 million users every month and over a million businesses.

Our locally loved marketplaces, including Marktplaats in the Netherlands, mobile.de in Germany, Kleinanzeigen in Germany and Spain, leboncoin in France and Subito in Italy, help everything and everyone find a new purpose by creating perfect matches  – whether it’s a car, an apartment, a sofa or a new job.
Our brands are supported by global Hubs in Barcelona and Amsterdam.



Job Requirements

Following a change of ownership in 2024 Adevinta is now owned by a consortium of private equity houses led by Blackstone and Permira and represents one of their largest investments in Europe in recent times. Our businesses are demonstrating strong profitable growth following a change of operating model placing focus on business autonomy supported by a small but highly skilled team of central finance professionals driving performance improvements across the markets and central functions.

As FinOps Reporting Analyst you will be a key part of this team and responsible for creating, managing, and enhancing financial reports and dashboards that support operational efficiency, compliance, and strategic decision-making within the processes of RTR, PTP and OTC and advancing the use of AI across the finance function. You are likely to be involved in multiple projects so there is great opportunity to broaden your experience significantly. 

The ideal candidate enables data-driven decisions by analyzing performance, identifying risks and opportunities, and improving reporting and process automation and efficiency, with a delivering results, transformational and continues improvement mindset.

Qualifications: 
3 to 5 years of experience on:


Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, or related field.
Proficiency in Excel and experience working with finance software & ERP systems: Experience with financial systems like SAP S4, Blackline, OneStream, Microsoft Dynamics, Netsuite etc.
Relevant experience in finance operations, reporting, or shared services environments.
Experience working with RTR, PTP, and OTC process cycles in a corporate or global business services setting
Hands-on experience with BI/reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.).
Familiarity with SQL or data modeling concepts is a plus.
Demonstratable proficiency with AI tools such as Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT
Understanding internal control frameworks and SOX compliance is advantageous.
Experience working within outsourced or shared services FinOps functions and ideally in a finance transformation project.
Ability to develop strong stakeholder relationships and become a trusted partner. 
Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to interface with all levels of management and customers. 
Fluent in English (other European languages are a plus i.e. Spanish, French).
Ability to drive changes and influence within a matrixed and decentralized operating model.
Problem-solving capabilities to address issues related to financial reporting and process inefficiencies.

Other Requirements:

Demonstrated customer service orientation and proficiency in working with multiple Finance and Accounting customer groups across a global organization.
Must be comfortable presenting to large/senior executive audiences; able to quickly build rapport and establish credibility with stakeholders.
Must have excellent time management skills to perform in a fast-paced environment, work well under tight deadlines.
Must be collaborative, team player, with a global mindset, flexible and able to quickly adjust to changing priorities.
Ability to translate objectives into project plans and tasks, to drive projects to completion. 



Job Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:


Design and automate dashboards using conventional tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Looker or AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini for real-time visibility into RTR, PTP, and OTC metrics.
Improve data governance by ensuring accuracy, consistency, and audit-readiness of reporting data.
Collaborate with Finance and FinSys teams to gather requirements and deliver targeted reporting solutions.
Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders to support decision-making.
Identify gaps and inefficiencies in RTR, PTP, and OTC reporting processes.
Ensure reporting processes are compliant with internal controls and external audit standards.
Consolidate and validate financial and operational data from ERP systems and data warehouses.
Recommend and implement enhancements to streamline operations and reduce manual effort.



Job Benefits

Life at Adevinta comes with its perks! Our Adevintans enjoy the following benefits:


An attractive Base Salary
Participation in our Short-Term Incentive plan (annual bonus)
Work From Anywhere: Enjoy up to 20 days a year of working from anywhere! Maybe not from the moonwell why not! just make sure you have internet connection!
A 24/7 Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, because we care ‍
Win together, lose together is one of our key behaviours. At Adevinta you will find a collaborative environment with an opportunity to explore your potential and grow  

Adevinta is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role but are interested, please consider applying anyway. Research suggests that women and individuals from underrepresented groups may self-select out of opportunities if they don’t meet 100% of the job requirements. We strongly encourage people from historically excluded groups to apply and look forward to speaking with you.

Title: Commercial Reporting and Insights Analyst – Healthcare – Barcelona, Spain
Description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Commercial Reporting and Insights Analyst – Healthcare – Barcelona, Spain

Please note, internally, this position is titled: Sales Operations Analyst

Meet The Team


You’ll join Dexcom’s Commercial Excellence organization, where data, systems, and insights support commercial planning, execution, and performance measurement across EMEA. The team is building a more connected, consistent data ecosystem to help regional and country teams make better decisions and drive commercial impact.
This role helps standardize commercial performance reporting, dashboards, and key metrics, turning agreed data definitions into timely insights that highlight trends, risks, and areas requiring action.


Where You Come In


Build, maintain, and improve standardized EMEA commercial performance dashboards and recurring reports aligned to agreed business definitions.
Partner with Commercial Excellence, Analytics, Sales Operations, Finance, Marketing, and country teams to translate reporting needs into practical, reusable solutions.
Support adoption of common key performance indicators, calculation rules, targets, filters, and reporting hierarchies across EMEA.
Monitor trends, variances, and exceptions to surface material performance changes and areas requiring follow-up.
Validate and reconcile reporting outputs, investigate inconsistencies, and coordinate resolution with data owners.
Create clear summaries and visualizations that explain what changed, where it changed, and why it matters.
Help rationalize existing reports and dashboards, reducing duplication and improving consistency across EMEA.
Maintain reporting documentation, gather user feedback, support testing, and promote effective use of standardized reporting.


What Makes You Successful


Experience in commercial analytics, business intelligence, sales operations, performance reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience building dashboards and recurring reports using Tableau or Power BI.
Strong understanding of reporting concepts, including metrics, filters, hierarchies, targets, trend analysis, and data validation.
Ability to use SQL, Excel, or comparable tools to analyse data, validate outputs, and investigate discrepancies.
Able to translate business questions into clear analyses, concise visualizations, and practical commentary.
Structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable documenting logic, reconciling outputs, and maintaining reporting consistency.
Effective collaborator with regional, country, business, data, and system stakeholders.
Proactive and execution-focused, able to manage recurring deadlines and follow through on open issues.
Experience in MedTech, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another regulated commercial environment is preferred.


What You’ll Get


A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
A full and comprehensive benefits program.
Growth opportunities on a global scale.
Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.


Travel Required


5-15%


Experience And Education Requirements


Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2-5 years of related experience.


Flex/Hybrid Workplace

Your primary location will be your assigned Dexcom site but you may work part of the week from a home office. You must live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically within an hour’s commute).

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

AI in Hiring Notice: We may use AI supported tools to help make our hiring process more efficient, consistent, and accessible for candidates around the world. All hiring decisions are made by people.

At Dexcom, we are committed to providing a fair and inclusive recruitment process, and welcome candidates of all genders and gender identities to apply. If any wording in this description appears unintentionally gendered or exclusionary, please be assured this is not intentional.

Should a reasonable accommodation be necessary to aid a disability, requests should be sent to Dexcom Talent Acquisition at talentacquisition@dexcom.com.
