Title: Data Analyst (CRM)
Description:
We are looking for Data Analyst (CRM), to join our team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What Will You Do

The CRM Analyst is the measurement and intelligence engine of the central CRM organization. Operating across all game titles, this person pulls, verifies, and reports on campaign performance; tracks trends; and ensures experimentation is structured to produce reliable, actionable results. Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance


Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs


Experimentation Design & Governance


Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations


Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights


Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns


Data Integrity & Targeting Validation


Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch


What We’re Looking For


4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.


Technical Skills


SQL (required)
Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Basic understanding of data pipelines and data quality checks


About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Title: Senior Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Senior Fraud Data Analyst, you'll handle one of the most critical challenges in digital payments: keeping millions of transactions safe in real time.

Here's What That Looks Like In Practice


Architect Real-Time Strategies – You will be responsible for our real-time decisioning engine, designing and deploying logic that combines ML scores with velocity features to make millisecond decisions.
Precision Rule Development – Translate complex fraud patterns into high-performing rules, optimising the balance between False Positive Rates (FPR) and Gross Fraud Loss.
Deconstruct Payment Fraud – Proactively hunt for emerging schemes (ATO, social engineering) and turn these insights into end-to-end mitigation strategies.
Optimise the Decisioning Stack – Partner with Product and Engineering to define analytical requirements for new features and third-party data signals.
Calibrate ML & Heuristics – Work with Data Science to operationalise machine learning models, determining how to best "wrap" model scores with heuristic rules.
Champion Frictionless UX – Analyse security measures to identify unnecessary hurdles, designing dynamic friction strategies for a seamless user experience.
Strategic Performance Reporting – Monitor rule efficacy and portfolio health, presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to evolve our risk appetite.


Who We're Looking For

This role needs someone genuinely curious about how fraud works, and driven enough to stay one step ahead of it.


Experience – You have at least 6 years’ experience, specifically within the risk, payments, or credit sectors.
Technical Proficiency – You are highly skilled in SQL and Python for data analysis and strategy development.
Domain Expertise – You have a solid understanding of payment fraud dynamics and experience working with real-time decisioning environments.
Communication – You possess excellent communication skills and are fluent in English.
Nice to Have – Experience with Machine Learning, Data Science, PySpark, or GraphQL knowledge is a significant plus.


Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

About

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:


❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.


Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

We are looking to welcome yet another brilliant Senior Marketing Data Analyst into our Marketing Analytics team.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll be responsible for designing and driving high-impact analytics solutions, from developing advanced statistical frameworks to evaluate marketing performance, to building data pipelines that integrate third-party sources, to creating interactive tools that empower partner teams. These are just a few examples of the initiatives you’ll help lead and deliver end-to-end, playing a key role in shaping the technical direction of our analytics efforts. The demands on this team are constantly evolving with the needs of Socialpoint’s and Zynga’s dynamic marketing teams, so it is important that you be able to adapt and utilize your time efficiently.

What You'll Do


Partner closely with marketing and cross-functional teams to identify growth opportunities, improve efficiency, and shape strategic initiatives.
Lead analytical deep dives to surface insights and translate them into actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Visualize and communicate analytical findings clearly, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Apply statistical methodologies to evaluate performance and account for uncertainties in major initiatives.
Proactively explore and prototype opportunities using AI-driven automation to streamline investigations and improve decision-making.


What You Bring


Demonstrated experience with some or all of the following: predictive modeling, statistics, experimental design, optimization, data visualization
Understanding of marketing metrics and KPIs, with experience in campaign optimization, Lifetime Value (LTV) modeling, and incrementality analysis
Proficiency in SQL and Python with hands-on experience in Redshift, Databricks, PySpark, and Airflow
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate ambiguous questions into data-driven insights
Strong communication skills — you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus
A team player, you establish effective relationships to work with others for the win
Proven work experience in data analytics or data science roles
BS in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Economics, or other quantitative field; Masters, MBA or PhD preferred


What's in it for you as a Socialpointer?


Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week
A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
Private medical insurance for you and your family to keep your health bar full
Disability and life insurance
Choose from the latest iOS or Android device when you join (phone or tablet)
Free language lessons in English, Spanish and Catalan
Spotify Premium to add the perfect soundtrack to your adventure
Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam
Take-Two Interactive employee stock purchase plan (eligibility criteria applies)
Professional development budget for skills training


Onsite Perks Include


State of the art gym facilities
Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee
Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!)

Title: Senior Supply Chain Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

About the role

As a Senior Supply Chain Data Analyst, you work on global transformation and optimizing projects in Supply Chain. You contribute to successful project outcomes by focusing on the end-to-end data roadmap, from data querying and data quality review to data analysis, dashboarding, data modelling and communication with client business and IT teams.

In This Role You Will


Support master data management and data governance activities, including data preparation, validation, documentation and stakeholder alignment.
Query, analyse and model supply chain data, and review data quality across large datasets.
Support data architecture and integration between ERP, APS and reporting environments, including data migration, data factories and data warehousing.
Create dashboards and analyses that translate data into business insights.
Work closely with project teams, client business and IT teams, and support workshops to gather data requirements and promote best practices.


Job Requirements

About you


3+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics, data consulting or a related field, preferably working with large datasets from ERP or APS systems. Experience with OMP, Kinaxis or S/4HANA is a plus.
You have good proficiency in data querying, analysis and dashboard creation using tools such as MS Excel, PowerQuery, SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Looker or QlikView.
You are familiar with master data management, data governance best practices, data factories, data architecture and integration.
You have strong problem-solving skills, an analytical mindset and an understanding of the business and customer context.
You have persuasive communication skills, are comfortable working with clients and can prioritize workload and communicate progress in a fast-paced international environment.
You like to learn and develop, are curious about how AI can improve data quality and integration, and are willing to stay hands-on with traditional master data work.
You hold a Master's degree in a relevant field, are fluent in English and are willing to travel globally and work in a hybrid setup from Barcelona. Spanish is a plus.
You feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together move fast and be kind!


Why join us?


You join a company built around supply chain transformation rather than broad, generalist consulting.
You become part of our supply chain data community, with different growth paths depending on what you want to deepen: data analysis, data quality, data modelling, data architecture, dashboarding, or people and process focused work.
You work on international supply chain projects where you do not only analyse data, but also help structure, cleanse, model, integrate and visualize it.
You leverage your expertise in a pioneering role, with the full support of our international team of supply chain and data experts to drive Barcelona’s success.
You are part of a global network spanning Belgium, the USA, Switzerland, Ireland, the Netherlands, Australia and Singapore, working on impactful international projects.
You have opportunities to travel to client sites, making your work truly international and engaging across borders.
You work on data that directly supports supply chain decisions, transformation projects and the successful implementation of planning solutions.
You work in a flexible and hybrid environment, combining remote work, office presence and onsite client visits.
You benefit from a competitive salary package.


About us

At Bluecrux, we transform supply chains into smart, efficient value chains through a blend of expert consulting and cutting-edge technology. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we're committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

Within the Supply Chain Plan business unit, we have built up specific expertise in three main areas: Life sciences/pharma, CPG&CH and Chemicals&Industries. In these industries, we support a range of global leaders in their E2E planning transformation journey such as Bayer, Johnson&Johnson, BASF and Bridgestone.

During these E2E supply chain planning transformations, our experts support our customers in every step of their journey. We partner up to define a vision and review the operating model to create a strong and agile basis for the future.

The Plan business unit designs & implements our customers’ business transformation by defining the future organizational operating model, designing new ways of working & solutions advanced planning systems (APS), feeding their data factory, accelerating their setup towards agile S&OP or guiding them through their end-to-end supply chain planning. We do not work for them but rather with them, and we stand by their side the entire time. That is the only way to make changes stick and flourish.

Title: Staff Data Analyst - Ops & Compliance
Description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a Staff Data Analyst - Ops & Compliance to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will


Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.
Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools
Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May-June (reforecast).


🤔 What You Can Expect


A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.


➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.

Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.

🏅 About You


Compliance or regulated environment experience: You've worked analytically on KYC/KYB, AML, remediation, or similar regulatory/operational processes — and you know how to get credible with those stakeholders fast.
Self-service product mindset: You've designed dashboards and models for end-users to explore autonomously, adapting the same dataset from ops-level (daily SLA tracking) to exec-level (budget readouts).
Cross-functional stakeholder management: You've juggled competing analytical priorities across multiple teams — and you know how to scope clearly, push back when needed, and drive adoption.
Strong SQL and data modelling skills: You've built end-to-end transformation pipelines, enforced data quality, and made non-technical stakeholders trust your numbers.
AI-native workflow: You actively use AI tools to accelerate your analytics work — from data modelling to stakeholder communication — and you're genuinely curious about going further.
Language: Fluent in English.

Title: BUSINESS DATA ANALYST - GLOBAL DISTRIBUTION
Description:
En MANGO vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad.

Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. Nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo.

Tu Nuevo Puesto

Tu objetivo será contribuir a la mejora de la distribución comercial y la gestión de stocks a través del análisis de datos y la participación en proyectos transversales. Trabajarás con los equipos de negocio, técnicos y de sistemas para identificar oportunidades, convertirlas en propuestas concretas y acompañar su implementación y seguimiento.

Tus Principales Responsabilidades


Extraer, preparar y cruzar datos de distintas fuentes con autonomía, asegurando la calidad y consistencia de la información utilizada en los análisis.
Desarrollar y mantener indicadores, dashboards y herramientas de análisis que faciliten el seguimiento del negocio y la toma de decisiones.
Analizar el comportamiento de las ventas, los stocks y la distribución, y elaborar modelos analíticos y escenarios que permitan identificar oportunidades, priorizar iniciativas y evaluar su impacto.
Participar en la definición y revisión de criterios y reglas de negocio para mejorar la asignación de producto, la reposición y la gestión del inventario.
Participar en la gestión y seguimiento de proyectos transversales del área. Acompañar la implementación de mejoras y realizar el seguimiento de sus resultados mediante los indicadores definidos, contrastando el impacto real con los objetivos previstos.
Traducir las necesidades de negocio en requerimientos claros para los equipos técnicos y de sistemas, colaborando en la validación de las soluciones desarrolladas.
Preparar presentaciones, conclusiones y recomendaciones que comuniquen de forma clara los resultados de los análisis.
Contribuir a la mejora continua de procesos, herramientas y automatizaciones.


Sobre Ti


Formación en Ingeniería, ADE, Estadística, Economía u otras disciplinas con una sólida base cuantitativa y analítica.
+/- 4 años de experiencia en roles analíticos con exposición a negocio, preferiblemente en entornos de retail, distribución o gestión de stocks.
Dominio de SQL y capacidad para trabajar con autonomía en la extracción, transformación y análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos, en entornos como Databricks.
Nivel avanzado de Excel. Se valorará experiencia con herramientas de visualización como Power BI o Looker.
Conocimiento práctico de Python valorable.
Capacidad para interpretar los datos desde una perspectiva de negocio y convertir los resultados en conclusiones y propuestas de acción.
Capacidad de organización, planificación y seguimiento de tareas.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y gestión de stakeholders, para presentar información compleja de forma clara y colaborar con perfiles de negocio y técnicos.
Nivel medio/alto de inglés.


Tus Beneficios


Disfruta de un horario flexible y trabajo híbrido que se adapta a tus necesidades. En MANGO, apostamos por la conciliación de la vida profesional y personal.
En MANGO, el fin de semana empieza el viernes a mediodía. Ofrecemos horario intensivo los viernes y vísperas de festivos.
Planifica tus vacaciones según tus preferencias. En MANGO, valoramos tu tiempo y queremos que disfrutes de cada momento.
Como parte del equipo de MANGO, tendrás descuento en todas nuestras líneas, ¡para que estés siempre a la última!
Disfrutarás de My Mango Benefits, nuestra plataforma de beneficios, desde la que podrás adaptar tu compensación a tu estilo de vida con ventajas fiscales, además de acceso a un portal de descuentos en múltiples marcas y servicios.
Paquete de retribución flexible con ventajas fiscales: seguro médico, formación, catering y programa de guardería.
Transporte de empresa gratuito desde Barcelona y El Vallés.
En MANGO, invertimos en tu crecimiento personal y profesional. Accede a una oferta de formación variada, mentorías personalizadas, programas de desarrollo continuo y oportunidades de promoción interna que te impulsarán hacia el éxito. A nivel técnico, podrás formarte en el uso de diferentes plataformas tecnológicas, así como participar en workshops, meetups, comunidades de prácticas, team buildings y company meetings.
¡Piensa en grande! MANGO te ofrece oportunidades internacionales en más de 120 mercados para expandir tu horizonte y crecer junto con nosotros a nivel global.


En MANGO, creemos en una cultura inclusiva donde la creatividad y la innovación nos inspiran a llevar la moda más allá. Por ello, tenemos el compromiso de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades para todas las personas, valorando la autenticidad de cada individuo.

Title: Business Intelligence Developer
Description:
🤗 ¿Quiénes somos? 🤗




Edenred, empresa reconocida como una de las “100 mejores empresas para trabajar en España” en 2024 y certificada como Great Place to Work, nació llena de ilusión hace más de 60 años, siendo pioneros en el desarrollo de beneficios sociales para equipos y operando en la actualidad en 45 países, ofreciendo soluciones como plataforma digital a 60 millones de usuarios.




Desde nuestros inicios, hemos mantenido vivo un sueño que sigue presente en todas las decisiones de la compañía: generar conexiones de valor que fomenten el crecimiento de nuestros stakeholders y de la sociedad en general.




😊 Misión del puesto 😊




Como Business Intelligence Developer tu misión será diseñar, desarrollar y mantener soluciones de Business Intelligence que transformen los datos en información clara, fiable y accionable, facilitando la toma de decisiones estratégicas y operativas del negocio.




Actuarás como nexo entre los equipos de negocio y los datos, asegurando una correcta interpretación de la información y una experiencia de usuario óptima a través de soluciones de reporting y visualización de alto impacto.




En su día a día, el rol estará enfocado en:

Desarrollo de dashboards y reportes orientados a negocio
Análisis de datos y generación de insights clave
Diseño de visualizaciones intuitivas y centradas en el usuario
Garantizar la consistencia, calidad y correcto uso del dato




📚Tus principales responsabilidades📚




1. Business Intelligence & Reporting




Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards e informes interactivos orientados a negocio.
Traducir requerimientos funcionales en soluciones BI claras, eficientes y fáciles de consumir.
Aplicar principios de visualización de datos, UX/UI y data storytelling en dashboards y reportes.
Participar en la definición de KPIs y métricas de negocio, asegurando consistencia y alineación.
Optimizar el rendimiento de dashboards, modelos semánticos y consultas SQL / DAX.
Definir y mantener estándares de diseño y buenas prácticas de BI.




2. Análisis de datos




Analizar datos para identificar tendencias, desviaciones y oportunidades de mejora.
Apoyar a los equipos de negocio en la interpretación correcta de los datos.
Elaborar documentación funcional de dashboards, KPIs y lógicas de cálculo.
Actuar como punto de referencia en el uso correcto de indicadores e informes.




3. Gestión del dato (nivel BI)




Validar la calidad y consistencia del dato consumido en BI.
Gestionar incidencias de datos y coordinar con equipos de IT cuando sea necesario.
Asegurar una interpretación común de los KPIs y métricas entre usuarios.







🤓 Requisitos deseables 🤓




-Más de 3 años de experiencia en Business Intelligence, Análisis de datos o Controlling/ performance management.

-Experiencia práctica en entornos analíticos orientados a negocio.

-Dominio de inglés hablado y escrito (interacciones con sede y data community de otros business).

-Se valorará Grado en Administración de Empresas, Ciencia de Datos, Ingeniería informática, o Estadística.

-Imprescindible tener experiencia en :

Herramientas de Business Intelligence y visualización (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik u otras) y habilidades analíticas sólidas.
Databricks como plataforma de datos (uso de notebooks -SQL/Python-, consumo de datos desde Delta Lake, comprensión de arquitecturas Lakehouse).
Conocimientos sólidos en SQL y modelado de datos (modelo estrella, relaciones, métricas).
Experiencia en lenguajes analíticos como DAX (o equivalentes según herramienta BI) e integrando múltiples fuentes de datos.

-Es deseable que el/la candidata posea:

Conocimientos en Data Engineering básico (pipelines, optimización de queries).
Experiencia de storytelling con datos y presentaciones ejecutivas.
Conocimiento de herramientas de diseño (Figma, Adobe XD, similares).
Experiencia en entornos cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP) y en metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban).




🤗 ¿Qué Podemos ofrecerte? 🤗




Edenred está aquí para ofrecerte un montón de beneficios que te ayudarán a sentirte bien y a equilibrar tu vida laboral y personal. ¡Échales un vistazo ya que están pensados especialmente para ti y tu bienestar!




-Ticket Restaurant 11€/día de lunes a jueves entre septiembre y junio.

-Flexibilidad horaria en entrada y salida, además de jornada intensiva todos los viernes del año así como los meses de julio y agosto.

-Formato hibrido de trabajo: hasta 8 días de teletrabajo al mes.

-Office Day: día semanal en la oficina con desayuno, café y fruta incluida.

-Entorno dinámico y multidisciplinar.

-Actividades en días clave como voluntariados, Women & Pride week, cena de navidad, entre otras.




Y no menos importante, ¡un ambiente laboral de 10!




¿A qué esperas para que te podamos conocer?




Edenred se basa en la meritocracia. Vienes tal y como eres y contribuyes. De hecho, el Grupo Edenred reconoce, contrata y desarrolla todos los talentos y singularidades. Nos comprometemos a prevenir cualquier forma de discriminación y a ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades a todos nuestros candidatos, independientemente de su género y expresión de género, discapacidad, origen, creencias religiosas y orientación sexual o cualquier otro criterio.

Title: TÈCNIC/A ANALISTA DE NEGOCI
Description:
Ametller Origen som una empresa en expansió del sector alimentari que gestiona de forma integral el procés de producció i comercialització dels seus productes. Cultivem, elaborem i seleccionem els nostres productes per garantir sabor i qualitat des de l'origen.

El nostre propòsit és promoure un estil de vida més saludable i sostenible, facilitant l’accés a una alimentació més nutritiva, plaent i neta, amb un ferm compromís amb la societat i el medi ambient.

Vols formar part del nostre equip i unir-te a nosaltres per fer arribar el nostre propòsit a la comunitat?

Volem incorporar un/a Tècnic/a Analista de Negoci per actuar com a referent d’Analytics dins dels àmbits d’operacions i retail, transformant les necessitats del negoci en solucions analítiques útils, fiables i accionables que facilitin la presa de decisions, assegurin la qualitat de la informació i impulsin l’autonomia analítica del negoci.

Què faràs?


Produiràs, manteniràs i evolucionaràs els productes analítics del domini, incloent dashboards operatius, alertes proactives, monitoritzacions automàtiques i anàlisis recurrents, assegurant-ne l’ús, la qualitat, l’actualització i la retirada quan deixin d’aportar valor.
Traduiràs les necessitats del negoci en preguntes analítiques concretes, preparant briefings complets i assegurant que les peticions estan ben definides abans d’iniciar qualsevol solució o entregable.
Dissenyaràs i consolidaràs el model d’autoconsum analític del domini, facilitant que l’equip pugui resoldre les consultes habituals de manera autònoma a partir de dades certificades.
Resoldràs anàlisis ad hoc i consultes puntuals de l’àrea utilitzant la capa de dades existent i certificada, evitant dependències innecessàries de l’equip de Data per a consultes estàndard.
Especificaràs a l’equip de Data les necessitats de dades no disponibles, detallant què es necessita, amb quina finalitat i amb quin nivell de granularitat.
Executaràs el control de qualitat i la validació funcional dels nous models de dades lliurats per l’equip de Data, abans que la informació es publiqui com a capa certificada i es comparteixi com a dada oficial.

Title: Business Analyst, Account Health Support, Account Health Support
Description:
Description

As we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company, Amazon has reinvented how hundreds of millions of people shop online – providing customers with the opportunity to find and discover virtually anything they want to buy and providing millions of sellers with a platform for growing successful businesses. We are looking for an exceptional business analyst to help us develop new ways to build trust and loyalty with sellers, a crucial component of our flywheel

Sellers’ trust in Amazon is our top priority and in this role, you will be tasked with building that trust over time by diving deep into how we measure our progress and helping to identify and prioritize key areas of focus. Amazon’s growth requires leaders who move fast, have an entrepreneurial spirit to create new solutions, have an unrelenting tenacity to get things done, and are capable of breaking down and solving complex problems.

The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and be able to create and maintain efficient & automated processes. They know and love working with business intelligence tools, can model multidimensional datasets, and can partner effectively with business leaders to answer key business questions. They are analytical and creative, and don’t quit. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and with high opportunity for impact for those willing to roll up their sleeves and dive deep to achieve results.

Key job responsibilities


Work with team leadership to understand the customer needs and concerns as well as define solutions.
Translate basic business problem statements into analysis requirements. Work with internal customers to define best output based on expressed stakeholder needs.
Use analytical and statistical rigor to solve complex problems and drive business decisions.
Develop queries and visualizations for ad-hoc requests and projects, as well as ongoing reporting.
Write queries and output efficiently, and have in-depth knowledge of the data available in area of expertise.
Pull the data needed with standard query syntax; periodically identify more advanced methods of query optimization. Convert data to make it analysis-ready.
Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation.
Monitor and troubleshoot operational or data issues in the data pipelines
Review and audit existing ETL jobs and SQL queries.
Good communication and writing. Effectively communicates with both business and technical teams.


A day in the life


Partner with Business Stakeholders to automate metrics and dive data to drive decisions that will support Sellers on the Amazon Platform
Surface opportunities to drive process improvement, looking beyond the surface to understand what the data means for the team
Participate in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews with Global leadership spanning our six operations sites, from Arizona to Singapore.
Provide data insights to Operations Managers to help them understand root cause of defect drivers for the programs and specialists.


About The Team

Account Health Support exists to educate sellers on how to maintain there Account Health while selling on the Amazon platform. We provide support to these sellers to ensure they understand Amazon's policy and provide a delightful experience for our customers. The team creates a trustworthy selling experience to ensure that Selling Partners perceive Amazon as the safest and most effective store in which to sell their products worldwide.

Basic Qualifications


5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
Experience with SQL
Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
Be self-driven, and show ability to deliver on ambiguous projects with incomplete data.


Preferred Qualifications


5+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Description:
At Vueling, we connect people, places and opportunities ✈️

Driven by innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to sustainability, we are shaping the future of aviation while creating an environment where our people can grow, contribute, and make an impact.

Mission

The Flight Operations Analyst is responsible for analysing, monitoring and optimising flight operations performance, ensuring operational efficiency and compliance with aviation standards. The role supports Flight Operations Management through data analysis, KPI monitoring, operational reporting and continuous improvement initiatives, providing insights that contribute to better decision-making and crew engagement.

Tasks & Responsibilities


Monitor and report monthly operational KPIs for Flight Operations Management and the Director.
Prepare and analyse monthly diversion reports and related surveys.
Manage and analyse Return to Stand reports in collaboration with MEL and FCOM teams.
Control and report monthly headcount and FTE data.
Track crew seniority by base and analyse pilot flight hours on a weekly basis.
Analyse operational delays and provide reports directly to managers, chief pilots and senior leadership.
Participate in and support operational projects, surveys and improvement initiatives for Flight Operations leadership.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and databases to support performance monitoring and decision-making.
Manage crew base and detachment data and processes.
Maintain regular communication with pilots through operational notifications and updates.
Collaborate in the creation of the monthly Performance Newsletter, gathering operational insights and recommendations for flight crews.


Academic Background


Bachelor's degree in Aviation Management, Aviation Engineering, Business Administration, Economics or a related field.


Experience


Minimum 1 year of experience in operational environments, such as airport operations, airline operations, or analytical roles involving operational performance and reporting.


Skills


Strong analytical and numerical skills with high attention to detail and data accuracy.
Excellent problem-solving capabilities and ability to work under deadlines.
Strong teamwork and communication skills.
Advanced Excel skills, including macros, formulas and data analysis tools (mandatory).
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Word.

Place: El Prat de Llobregat, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
Revelyst – Adventure Sports Group Europe is a fast-growing action sports company that prides itself on attracting passionate and talented individuals. We are looking for a data-driven, analytical and commercially minded Amazon eCommerce Analyst & Demand Planner to join our team.

This role sits at the intersection of eCommerce, demand planning and commercial analytics, turning POS, inventory and sales data into clear forecasts, actionable insights and operational decisions. The position will support Amazon account management, demand planning and day-to-day business performance across EMEA.

The main tasks of the position are:

The Amazon eCommerce Analyst & Demand Planner will be responsible for analyzing commercial data, supporting forecasting activities, monitoring Amazon operational health and acting as a bridge between Sales, Planning and Operations.




Commercial Analytics & Insight Generation

• Build and maintain regular state-of-the-business dashboards using revenue, POS and inventory data

• Analyze sell-out, sell-in, rejections, stock cover and purchasing trends to support strategy development and decision-making

• Identify incremental sales opportunities and potential business risks through data analysis

• Deliver clear, data-backed recommendations to internal stakeholders

• Present findings and insights to senior executives and external customer teams when required

• Collaborate with Marketing, Finance and Product teams on third-party data to enrich commercial understanding




Demand Planning & Forecasting

• Support Sales and Demand Planning with long-range forecasting

• Integrate commercial signals into the S&OP process

• Work closely with the Wholesale Demand Planning team to align forecasts and monitor inventory shifts and risks

• Monitor stock cover and support the maintenance of optimal inventory levels

• Maintain the central planning database up to date by season

• Ensure planning data is accurate and available to support buy decisions and replenishment planning




Amazon Operational Health & Vendor Central

• Monitor and maintain Amazon account operational health on a daily basis

• Track key metrics including stock levels, inventory shifts and confirmation rates

• Maintain close communication with the Amazon Customer Success team regarding chargeback reports

• Regularly review Amazon reports and proactively flag potential risks

• Manage action items within Amazon Vendor Central

• Support operational tasks, ad hoc requests and recurring activities within Vendor Central




Cross-functional Collaboration & Process Improvement

• Act as the bridge between Sales, Planning and operational functions including Demand Planning, Supply Chain and Amazon Operations

• Ensure information flows accurately between business stakeholders and operational teams

• Proactively identify process gaps and recommend improvements to reduce friction and improve business performance

• Document process implementations

• Build easy-to-use KPI tracking tools so the Sales team can monitor territory performance




Position requirements:

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Supply Chain, Economics or a related field

• 2–4 years of experience in an eCommerce, data analytics, demand planning or commercial operations role

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query and XLOOKUP

• Working knowledge of SAP (SD/MM) for sales and inventory data

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Vendor Central

• Experience building dashboards and reporting tools

• Experience translating complex data into clear business insights

• Experience supporting Sales or Demand Planning functions




Competences:

• Strong accountability and drive for results

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

• Action-oriented and proactive approach

• Strong planning and organizational skills

• Ability to build effective relationships with cross-functional teams

• Customer-focused mindset

• Strong operational excellence

• Ability to work effectively with complex data and translate it into actionable insights




Preferred

• Experience with Power BI or equivalent dashboarding tools

• Familiarity with third-party data sources such as NPD or similar

• Background in eCommerce, retail or consumer goods

• Familiarity with action sports, outdoor or performance gear industry

• Experience working with cross-functional teams in an EMEA or international context

Utilizar herramientas de IA para acelerar procesos de desarrollo y análisis.

Experiencia mínima de 4-5 años como Data Analyst o roles similares.

Desarrollo con DAX.

Capacidad para comunicar resultados y presentar soluciones analíticas.

Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.

Title: Analista de Datos
Place: Santa Cruz de Bezana, Cantabria, Spain
Description:
En LISDATA transformamos datos en conocimiento útil para las empresas. Somos una ingeniería especializada en analítica avanzada, Industria 4.0, Big Data e Inteligencia Artificial, y trabajamos codo con codo con nuestros clientes para impulsar la evolución de su negocio.




Creemos que los mejores resultados llegan cuando las personas están en el centro. Por eso fomentamos un entorno cercano, donde el talento, el bienestar y el crecimiento profesional son una prioridad, algo que nos valió el Premio a la Calidad en el Empleo en Cantabria en 2022.




Buscamos incorporar Analistas de Datos con curiosidad, visión de negocio y ganas de seguir aprendiendo. Formarás parte de nuestro equipo ubicado en Cantabria, donde participarás en proyectos a medida de análisis de datos e Inteligencia Artificial.




¿Qué harás en LIS?




Colaborarás con el equipo de proyectos y con cliente para entender sus necesidades y traducirlas en preguntas que los datos puedan responder.
Extraerás, depurarás y prepararás datos de distintas fuentes mediante SQL y Python.
Realizarás análisis exploratorios y estadísticos para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades de mejora.
Diseñarás y desarrollarás dashboards e informes que faciliten la toma de decisiones.
Definirás y harás seguimiento de indicadores clave (KPIs) de los proyectos.
Comunicarás los resultados de forma clara a perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.




¿Qué valoramos de ti?




Imprescindible:

Conocimientos de SQL en bases de datos como SQL Server o PostgreSQL.
Programación en Python para análisis de datos (NumPy, Pandas) y visualización (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
Experiencia con herramientas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Qlik Sense o Tableau.




Valorable:

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
As a Senior Data Analyst on our Growth team, you will play a pivotal role in driving our marketing performance to new heights. You will collaborate closely with User Acquisition and Growth partners to analyze data, find opportunities, and deliver actionable insights. Your work will empower strategic business decisions and improve player experiences.

What You'll Do
Partner closely with UA and Growth collaborators to understand performance, investigate business questions, and provide actionable recommendations.
Lead analytical projects end-to-end, from problem definition and data exploration through to insights and collaborator communication.
Own and evolve the business logic and analytical requirements of Growth data models, ensuring they accurately represent how the business measures performance.
Act as a key collaborator with Data Engineering, translating business and analytical needs into clear data requirements and validating delivered solutions.
Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues, inconsistencies, and gaps across Growth reporting and underlying data models.
Build and maintain scalable reporting and analytical solutions, reducing repetitive manual analysis where possible.
Define and maintain key Growth metrics and measurement logic across areas such as spend, acquisition, revenue, attribution, and marketing performance.
Perform deep-dive analyses to understand performance drivers, find opportunities, and support investment decisions.
Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical collaborators, including senior leadership.
Provide technical mentorship and share standard methodologies with other analysts while contributing to consistent analytical standards across the team.
Work closely with Data Scientists on measurement, experimentation, and modeling projects by offering solid analytical and data foundations.


What We're Looking For

We are seeking an ambitious and seasoned Senior Data Analyst with a proven track record of delivering outstanding results. You should have:
4+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related role.
Strong experience independently delivering analytical projects and working directly with business collaborators.
Experience owning or contributing significantly to analytical data models, metric definitions, or reporting foundations.
Advanced SQL skills and strong experience working with large and complex datasets.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation and analytical workflows.
Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and analytical data structures.
Experience converting business requirements into data requirements and collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams.
Proficiency in a data visualization/BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.
Good understanding of statistical analysis and experimentation.
Familiarity with digital marketing data, attribution, and acquisition metrics is a strong plus.
A strong ownership approach, comfortable independently driving work through to completion.
A curious and analytical nature, always looking to investigate unexpected results and challenge assumptions.
Realistic and dedicated to identifying ways forward.
Strong attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy and reliability.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities in a fast paced business environment.
Strong collaboration skills, capable of working effectively across Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, and business teams.
Excellent communication skills, able to challenge constructively and build trust with technical and non-technical collaborators.
Willingness to assist in the technical growth of other analysts and help maintain high analytical standards throughout the team.


This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Murphy deploys AI agents for banks starting with the most straightforward business case: voice AI for debt collection. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and SMS to maximize results while preserving trust.

We’re live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry.

About The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst to turn every transaction into the reliable analytics. You'll work directly with the co-founders and will own the metrics, models and dashboards behind every decision we make.

What you'll do


Own the numbers. Define the KPIs every team runs on, and make sure everyone calculates them the same way.
Build the source of truth. Write the data models and dashboards that turn raw call, debt and payment data into answers people trust.
Automate invoicing. Turn billing every bank, in every currency, into a pipeline that runs itself.
Prove what works. Design and read the experiments that tell a real lift in recovery from noise.
Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the root cause of every number that looks off, and fix it at the source.


Who you are


Highly analytical, and precise. You've built metrics and models a business actually ran on.
You're fluent in SQL and Python.
You own outcomes, and you never settle. You don't stop at the chart — you chase the number until it changes a decision.
You have a STEM degree, and you were top of your class. You're technical, you're rigorous with numbers, and you have a strong philosophy of a champion.
AI-native, ruthless on quality. You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default. You know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously.
You don't need a collections or fintech background. We'd rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can't ship — you'll pick up the data, the domain and the regulation cold, fast.


🤝 What we offer

📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential.

💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark.

🧩 Real ownership — Murphy's numbers are yours to define and defend.

⛳️ Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact.

👏🏻 The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it.

🍱 Healthy meals: No more boring tupperware – enjoy daily meals with Nora Foods. We cover 50% of each order!

💳 Cobee card: Flexible compensation for transport and restaurants, so you can make the most of your net salary.

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office in Poblenou, surrounded by a thriving tech scene, and 2 days of remote work. But if there’s one thing that defines us, it’s flexibility: we trust you to organize your time and space in the way that helps you do your best work.

Our Process

We believe that hiring is a two-way street: while we get to know you, you also deserve the chance to understand who we are, how we work, and what makes Murphy AI special. Here’s what you can expect:

1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You

A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive

You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case

A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ Coffee at the Office with the Founders

Finally, you’ll join us in our Barcelona office for a relaxed coffee with the founders and the Hiring Manager. It’s the perfect opportunity to experience our culture firsthand and meet more of the team who could soon be your colleagues.

👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.

Title: Sr Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Location: Madrid, Spain

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


3+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have


Experience with advanced or predictive analytics using Python, R, or similar programming languages.


Why PMI?

At PMI, you'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world, and contribute to the transformation of a global organization.

We offer the opportunity to learn, innovate, grow your career, and make an impact from day one.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We believe diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Relocation support and visa sponsorship are not provided. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Spain to be considered for this role.

Title: SENIOR DATA ANALYST
Description:
Empresa líder en su sector, busca a un/a profesional con experiencia como Data Analyst.




Tu misión será convertir los datos en decisiones de producto y negocio, ayudando a los equipos a entender cómo interactúan los clientes con nuestros activos digitales y dónde existen oportunidades de mejora.




Trabajarás dentro de un entorno orientado a producto, colaborando estrechamente con Product Managers, Engineering Managers y equipos de negocio para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento, optimización y mejora de la experiencia de cliente.




Serás una referencia en analítica digital y de producto, ayudando a la organización a comprender qué está ocurriendo, por qué está ocurriendo y qué acciones deben tomarse.




Además, impulsarás el uso responsable y eficiente de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para acelerar análisis, mejorar procesos de trabajo y aumentar la capacidad de generación de insights, siempre desde una perspectiva crítica y basada en evidencias.




Funciones:




Detectar de forma proactiva anomalías, cambios de tendencia o caídas en KPIs clave, identificando sus posibles causas y proponiendo acciones correctivas.
Transformar datos complejos en insights accionables que ayuden a priorizar decisiones de producto y negocio.
Analizar el comportamiento de usuarios para identificar oportunidades de mejora en conversión, engagement, retención y experiencia digital.
Trabajar estrechamente con Product Managers y equipos tecnológicos para definir métricas de éxito, validar hipótesis y medir el impacto de iniciativas.
Diseñar y evolucionar frameworks de medición digital que permitan entender el customer journey de forma consistente a través de web, app y otros puntos de contacto.
Profundizar en el análisis de funnels, navegación, comportamiento de usuarios y patrones de conversión para detectar fricciones y oportunidades de optimización.
Participar en la definición y mejora de estrategias de atribución y medición, garantizando la calidad y fiabilidad de los datos.
Liderar análisis ad hoc de alto impacto para responder preguntas estratégicas del negocio.
Contribuir a la evolución de la cultura Data Driven de la organización, ayudando a otros equipos a interpretar correctamente los datos y utilizarlos en la toma de decisiones.
Identificar oportunidades para aplicar Inteligencia Artificial y automatización en procesos analíticos, siempre con criterio, entendiendo sus limitaciones y validando la calidad de los resultados obtenidos.




Experiencia y conocimientos técnicos:




Experiencia sólida en analítica digital y product analytics dentro de entornos eCommerce, marketplace, producto digital o negocios online.
Dominio avanzado de SQL para la extracción, transformación y análisis de datos.
Experiencia con herramientas de analítica digital como GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Adobe Analytics o similares.
Conocimiento profundo de medición web y app, definición de eventos, tracking, customer journey y modelos de atribución.
Experiencia analizando funnels de conversión, comportamiento de usuarios, retención, engagement y adopción de funcionalidades.
Experiencia trabajando con herramientas de visualización y reporting como Power BI, Looker, Tableau o similares.
Capacidad para explotar múltiples fuentes de datos y conectar señales de comportamiento procedentes de diferentes sistemas.
Valorable experiencia en entornos cloud y plataformas analíticas modernas (AWS, Athena, BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.).
Experiencia en entornos de experimentación digital, A/B Testing y análisis de impacto.




Mentalidad analítica

Capacidad para detectar rápidamente anomalías en métricas y entender qué preguntas realizar para encontrar la causa raíz.
Capacidad para convertir datos en recomendaciones concretas y priorizables.
Curiosidad constante por entender el comportamiento de usuarios.
Orientación a impacto, no únicamente a generación de informes.




Beneficios de compañía:

Retribución flexible.
% de empleado por formar parte de la compañía.
Teletrabajo hibrido.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Analyst to join our Claims Team.

This team is present for our customers when they need us most.

As a Data Analyst for our Claims Team, you will be more than just a "report generator." You will be a strategic partner, acting as the bridge between raw data and operational excellence. Your mission is to take full ownership of our claims insights to optimize the most critical moment for our customers.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


You will become a "go-to" person for the Claims team. You won't just provide data; you will interpret it, providing actionable insights and recommending specific business moves to improve efficiency.
We are looking for someone to take the lead on ETL processes. You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines to ensure our claims datasets are robust, scalable, and accurate.
You will design high-impact Tableau dashboards that are both visually impeccable and highly functional. Your goal is to tell a clear story that allows stakeholders to make informed decisions at a glance.
You will collaborate closely with Pricing, Product, and Engineering to ensure a 360-degree view of the business, aligning claims performance with our overall growth strategy.
You will identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, freeing up the team to focus on high-value decision-making.


What We’re Looking For


Strong experience in data manipulation and extraction using SQL (MySQL, Redshift, or PostgreSQL).
Familiarity with building and maintaining ETL pipelines. You know how to transform raw data into structured, clean datasets.
2-3 years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a fast-paced environment (Consulting, Fintech, or Insurtech).
Proven track record of creating advanced models and dashboards in Tableau or similar BI tools.
Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or Business Administration).
Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish.


Nice-to-have


Ownership & Initiative: You don't wait for instructions; you identify gaps and propose solutions.
Communication & Influence: You can translate complex technical findings into clear business recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability: You thrive in a dynamic, ever-changing environment and can pivot your focus as business needs evolve.


€32,000 - €35,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵Competitive compensation: we offer a performance-based bonus up to 5.000€ for this role.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. Plus, for up to 30 days per year, work from anywhere.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst - User Acquisition (Remote)
Description:
Who We Are (Mode.Inc)

Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities.

Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be the analytical partner to our User Acquisition team. You'll own the measurement of how we acquire users across our portfolio of mobile apps and web properties — from attribution and channel performance to cohort LTV and payback — and turn that into clear recommendations on where to spend the next dollar.

The ideal candidate has exceptional analytical skills, strong SQL and Python skills, deep familiarity with mobile app marketing data, and can bring rigor to data quality, analysis and storytelling.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain common datasets and data pipelines that strengthen self-service analytics and enable data-driven decision making across the organization
Improve data quality, accuracy, reliability, and documentation to strengthen self-service analytics
Own UA performance measurement across paid channels (e.g., Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin, Unity), including CPI/CAC, ROAS, retention, and payback by channel, campaign, geo, and creative
Build and maintain predictive LTV models and cohort curves that let the UA team make bid and budget decisions on early signals
Reconcile and validate data across MMPs, ad networks, and internal event data, and investigate discrepancies in attribution, installs, and revenue
Analyze web-to-app and web funnel performance, from landing page to install to first reward or engagement, and identify where users drop off
Design and read incrementality tests, geo-holdouts, and creative or landing-page A/B tests to measure true lift beyond last-touch attribution
Monitor traffic quality and flag anomalies, including fraud, low-quality sources, and post-install behavior that doesn't match expectations
Partner with the UA team on budget allocation and channel mix scenarios, and translate findings into clear spend recommendations


What You Bring to the Team


Analytical excellence to dissect complex, ambiguous problems and uncover actionable insights
Solid SQL and Python programming skills, and experience working with large-scale production data
Business acumen to translate data and analysis into business impact
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate in a highly cross-functional environment
4+ years in analytics, with at least 2 years supporting user acquisition or performance marketing for mobile apps
Hands-on experience with at least one MMP (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, or Branch) and an understanding of attribution windows, re-engagement, and postbacks
Experience building dashboards, LTV/payback models and cohort analyses
Familiarity with growth marketing concepts such as: A/B Testing, Causal analysis, Incrementality, Inferential statistics, MMM etc, iOS SKAN & incoming privacy changes
Nice to have: experience with Big Data tools (Redshift/Spark/Airflow), experiment design, predictive modeling, log analysis, AI, or experience in tech or startup environments


Alignment with Our Core Values:


Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.


You'll Thrive Here If You Are


Analytical
Pragmatic
Curious
Communicative
Action-Driven
Collaborative


Why Join Mode Mobile


High ownership and autonomy across business units
Direct influence on a sizable UA budget allocation across a portfolio of apps.
Strong partners across engineering, product, growth, and content
Opportunities to shape Mode's analytics function and data culture
A fast-moving, supportive, global remote environment


We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms


Allow OKRs to Guide Us
Assume Positive Intent
Agree to Disagree & Commit
Set New Precedents
Accomplish More with Less
Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
Speak Up
Be Resourceful
Follow the 80/20 Rule


What We Are Offering


We are a 100% remote-first, global company.
A competitive compensation package.
We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full-time team members).
We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people.
Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
Bonusly - We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full-time team members).

Description:

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
