Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What you will get to do


Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs
A proactive mindset — you don't wait to be asked; you spot something unusual and you dig in
Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)
Strong stakeholder management skills; you can communicate findings clearly to fraud operations, product managers, engineers, and senior leadership — and you know how to influence decisions with data across all of them.
Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams where priorities shift quickly.
Proficiency with a spreadsheet tool (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, or any other alternative)
Enjoy autonomy and a flat structure: we have millions of customers and a flat hierarchy so any individual can have an outsized impact
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field


Experience with the following would be a plus


Data governance
Python or any other scripting language
Git or any other version control tool


What we can offer you


Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.


What to expect in the hiring process


A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
Technical take-home task (SQL test).
Technical Interview with hiring manager.
A behavioural interview with the Head of Data Analytics/Science and Fraud Team.


Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Data team at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics. The Analytics pillar is split into two teams: Product Analytics, working closely with our Product teams, and Revenue Analytics, partnering directly with the Business Unit leads in the Revenue org.

The Revenue Analytics function sits at the intersection of growth, customer acquisition, lifecycle management and commercial steering, as part of the Data Analytics team. You'll join the Revenue Analytics team, led by Saghar, our Analytics Manager, who heads a team of four data analysts and you'd be the fifth. This structure means you'll spend less time fixing broken pipelines and more time uncovering high-value insights

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What’s in it for you?


Direct Business Impact: Your work will directly shape how BU Managers and Country GMs steer revenue, churn, and growth decisions across markets, with clear visibility to senior leadership.
End-to-End Business Intelligence: From acquisition and activation to churn, retention, and revenue quality, you will own the analytical narrative for your BU scope, spanning marketing performance, product adoption, and commercial health.
Local Market Influence: You will partner closely with BU Managers and local marketing teams to understand country-specific dynamics and translate data into practical commercial decisions.
Strategic Growth Partnership: You will help shape budget allocation, campaign optimisation, funnel improvements and lifecycle opportunities based on robust analytical evidence.
A Mature Stack: Work with a modern data stack including Snowflake, dbt, Python and Omni, supported by a dedicated Analytics Engineering team.
A hybrid work policy: Enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.
Modern, centrally located offices: Work from modern office spaces in prime city locations.
An international environment: Join a diverse team with colleagues from across Europe.
Mobility across locations: Opportunity to work from our offices in Madrid, Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam or Berlin.


Your Responsibilities Will Include


Business KPI Definition & Governance: Establish, define and maintain the core KPI framework for your BU scope, including revenue metrics, churn rate, activation, retention, payback, LTV and customer-quality metrics.
Steering Dashboards: Design and deliver actionable dashboards for BU Managers and Country GMs, enabling reliable performance steering across Germany and Spain.
Data Modelling & Collection: Build robust, scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad-hoc marketing analytics needs.
Project & Stakeholder Management: Lead analytical projects end-to-end, managing timelines, priorities and senior stakeholder expectations across local BUs, Marketing and Data.
Funnel & Conversion Analysis: Own the analytical view of the customer journey from first touch to activation, paying customer and retained user, identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Customer Lifecycle Analytics: Analyse onboarding, activation, retention and lifecycle campaigns, helping local teams improve customer engagement and long-term revenue quality.
Performance Marketing Analytics: Analyse paid and organic acquisition performance across channels, campaigns, audiences and markets, helping teams understand where growth is efficient and where optimisation is needed.
Experimentation & Incrementality: Support the design, measurement and interpretation of marketing experiments, including A/B tests, landing-page tests, lifecycle tests and channel tests.
Cross-functional Connectivity: Bridge insights across Revenue, Product, Marketing, Finance and Customer Success, ensuring a unified view of customer acquisition, value creation and retention.


📍 Job located in Berlin or Madrid, with possibility of two remote working days per week

About You


Experience: 5+ years in Data Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Growth Analytics or Revenue Analytics, ideally in a SaaS, fintech, subscription, marketplace or digital product environment.
Technical Excellence: Expert-level SQL and solid experience with dbt (modelling, testing, and documentation).
Business & Revenue Analytics Expertise: Strong understanding of revenue metrics (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, payback), customer lifecycle and funnel analytics and commercial KPI frameworks. Marketing analytics experience is a strong plus.
Analytical Breadth: Comfortable working across forecasting, LTV modelling, funnel analysis, and operational KPI frameworks.
Communication: Ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable recommendations for senior non-technical stakeholders.
Language: Fluent in English. German is strongly preferred for the German market scope; Spanish would be beneficial for the Spain market scope.
Nice to have: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Hightouch, Census, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads or similar.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Technical Call (60’): Discussion with Julian (Head of Data Analytics)

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation + a technical SQL assessment. (75’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Meet the team (30')

Description:

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Senior Data Analyst - Finance

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Reporting team and we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Treasury domain!

Our data mission is to develop and maintain Ebury’s Data Platform and serve it to the whole company. This platform is the backbone of Ebury: it supports internal decision making, allows us to monitor our Treasury positions and risks, comply with regulatory reporting obligations and enables commercial opportunities globally.

The Data team works closely with Treasury, Product and Tech teams to coordinate and implement data analysis initiatives helping the Cash management, ALM and Treasury Reporting teams. Some of the projects we are currently working on include: MtM valuations reconciliation with our Treasury reporting system to ensure completeness and accuracy in our Financial statements, cash operational charges data analysis to reduce Treasury costs, liquidity data analysis to help ALM team manage daily liquidity obligations, and building AI agentic workflows to automate routine data operations and decision support, and many many more!

As part of the team you will


Work closely with the rest of the Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineering, Treasury and Product teams
Be responsible for modelling data in our collaborative data platform to perform critical Treasury data analysis and build reports and reconciliations for the Treasury domain
Manage end-to-end treasury solutions across all jurisdictions of the company from requirements gathering, building optimised data models and delivering the reports to our treasury stakeholders and auditors
Maintain and build dashboards and visualisations on the data platform using our BI tools for Treasury teams to monitor reporting and controls


What we’re looking for


4+ years of experience in Data/Business Analytics - applied to Treasury or Finance is a plus!
Advanced SQL skills - must be able to read and write complex SQL queries
Experience with our modern data stack tools (a plus!) We use dbt, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, DataStudio), Sigma
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail
The ability to manage, organise and present data in a clear, concise and actionable format
Experience working with Python is a plus
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and demanding work environment
Track record of working autonomously with time management skills
Fluency in English
Financial Services and Capital Markets Experience (FX, Payments, Money Markets, Treasury Management, etc) is a good plus!


What Ebury offers you


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

Title: Data & Insight Analyst Mid
Description:
A Housfy busquem un/a Data Analyst que ens ajudi a convertir les dades en decisions estratègiques, millorant l'experiència dels nostres clients i impulsant el creixement del negoci.




Volem incorporar algú que aporti insight, doni suport en la presa de decisions estratègiques i contribueixi a generar un impacte real en el negoci. A més, l'equip de Data és al capdavant de la implementació d'automatitzacions basades en IA a tota la companyia, de manera que tindràs un paper clau en aquesta transformació.




Què esperem de tu?

Col·laborar amb equips clau del negoci (Màrqueting, Operacions i Producte) per entendre els seus reptes i proporcionar dades i insights que ajudin a obtenir millors resultats.
Treballar de manera autònoma, amb una actitud proactiva i orientada a l'acció, identificant oportunitats i afrontant nous reptes.
Donar suport a la implementació d'automatitzacions basades en intel·ligència artificial per reduir processos manuals i millorar l'eficiència.
Impulsar i optimitzar l'estratègia de cross-selling de la companyia, transformant les dades en audiències accionables.
Analitzar el funnel de conversió i ajudar els equips a prendre decisions basades en dades.
Participar en l'evolució i el desenvolupament de la nostra infraestructura de dades i de les eines de visualització.
Transformar preguntes de negoci i hipòtesis en insights accionables que contribueixin al creixement de Housfy.




Què busquem?

Mínim 3 anys d'experiència com a Data Analyst o en una posició similar.
Domini d'SQL per consultar i analitzar grans volums de dades.
Coneixements en automatització de processos i aplicació d'intel·ligència artificial per millorar l'eficiència (es valorarà molt positivament).
Experiència avançada amb eines de visualització de dades.
Capacitat per entendre les necessitats del negoci i comunicar informació complexa de manera clara a perfils tant tècnics com no tècnics.
Nivell professional de català, castellà i anglès.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Data Analyst

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our team. You will be leveraging data to generate impactful insights for strategic purposes. This is a pivotal position to bring the business to the next level, you will support one of our business domain teams using analytics to drive better decisions at Perk.

What you will do:


Work with other Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists and Engineers in our team to generate advanced analysis that answers key business questions and unlocks opportunities.
Explore data from different sources, turning it into information, information into insight and insight into decisions
Design and develop metrics, dashboards, experiments and analyses to track and assess the impact of new initiatives and features.
Develop data frameworks and products to drive insights and behavioural analysis.


What you need:


2+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in data analytics or data science role, including relevant tools, techniques and technology
Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken, in English


You will need to prove the following:


You are a Master using SQL for data querying, transformation and modelling - experience with dbt is a strong plus.
Experience with statistical concepts and packages (Python / R)
Experience with data visualisation and BI tools (Looker)
Data storytelling and stakeholder management experience
The desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction, alongside highly engaged individuals.


AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

What makes Cognizant Netcentric a great fit for you?

At Cognizant Netcentric, we create memorable digital experiences for the world’s leading brands. We are a diverse, global community of 1,500+ Adobe experts working across countries, cultures, and technologies.




Our inclusive culture blends the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the stability, resources, and learning opportunities of a global organisation.




With Holacracy at our core, every individual is empowered to make an impact.




Overview:




We are looking for a Data Analyst to support fast-paced AI-driven initiatives, such as digital assistants, voice bots and other next-gen support tools. These roles combine a strong foundation in Data Analytics (70%) with an affinity for Data Science (30%) and will help in defining success metrics, improving data quality, reporting, and generating insights that influence strategic decisions. The ideal candidate brings a deep curiosity for user behavior, proficiency in product analytics, and a customer-first mindset that drives actionable insights.




Key Responsibilities:

Provide accurate and relevant data analysis to support informed business decisions.
Determine and prioritize the data requirements necessary to address business challenges and objectives.
Source, evaluate, and integrate new data sources to enhance analysis and insights.
Analysis, Insights gathering and recommendations for actions
Ensure that the data used for analysis is accurate, complete, and readily accessible.
Create clear and impactful visualizations, dashboards, and reports to communicate data insights effectively
Present and explain data findings to stakeholders in a way that is understandable and actionable.
Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to track progress against business goals
Design and execute A/B tests and apply statistical methods to support data-driven decision-making.




Requirements:

+3 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, ideally with exposure to AI/ML use cases.
Knowledge of Tableau and Databricks.
Ability and willingness to understand the business context and “why” behind technical features.
Hands-on mindset, comfortable with day-to-day operational work and proactive engagement.
Strong communicator able to bridge business and technical stakeholders.
Experience with Product Analytics is a big plus.
Some knowledge of LLMs, chatbots, and AI customer service solutions is a plus.
Open to occasional travel across Europe.




Preferred Profile:

Someone with a strong analytical foundation, curiosity for AI and a customer-first mindset.
Comfortable in cross-functional, agile teams, ideally experienced with customer-facing products.
Experience working in nearshore teams for enterprise clients is advantageous




At Cognizant Netcentric you get:

Permanent contract
30 working days of vacation
Flexible working hours
Recognition bonus system
Private health insurance
Apple work equipment
WFH equipment + welcome package
WFH monthly expenses compensation
Access to different courses
Adobe certification
Sponsored gym membership
Tax-free benefits (ticket restaurant, kindergarten and transport)
A dynamic and international team
Everyone has a voice; we are a Holacracy organisation

Our doors are wide open to all those who meet our high standards, and we cherish the distinct individuality and unique perspectives in our teams.




We firmly believe that a diverse and equitable workforce is the catalyst for groundbreaking innovation, boundless creativity, and seamless collaboration. As a Data Analyst, you will enable our product and business segments in the Financial Empowerment domain, specifically Investments, to make data-driven decisions. You will monitor, measure and analyse the effectiveness of your product teams' initiatives, helping to drive the strategy of your business segment. You will apply robust analytical approaches, including experimentation and causal inference methods where appropriate, to understand the impact of product and business decisions on customer and business outcomes. You are here to establish a data mindset and thereby foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. You will work in a cross-functional setup, collaborating closely with other analysts, engineers, designers, and product managers.

In This Role, You Will


Help us set the right goals: Develop clear and measurable targets based on an initiatives’ scope. Improve our overall forecasting and goal setting capabilities.
Handle stakeholders: Be an internal go-to-person for your teams when it comes to data related questions.

Contribute to self-serve data platform: Help building the right analytics foundations ,by pairing up with technical peers, so our product teams can interact with data and extract the right insights themselves.
Provide monitoring tools: Build the dashboards your team looks at every week to make sure they are impacting our company OKRs.
Improve data literacy of organisation: Educate teams to become independent when it comes to data access and understanding function led training and team wide workshops to foster data driven culture.

Support some of the following product & business team initiatives (not limited to):
Support your team in discovery of new product ideas, identifying user friction points and business opportunities.
Evaluate your teams’ continuous releases making sure they are delivering on business goals via experimental or observational methods.
Collaborate with UX researchers to combine qualitative and quantitative research for better product hypotheses.
During product development you make sure all data needed for future evaluation is being captured through set up of tracking events or as part of the backend service.
Drive the quantitative analysis on your segment, being responsible for the insights and business discovery on the team.

Background

What you need to be successful:


3+ years of experience, ideally within the Product or Analytics field.
1+ years of experience in the Investments or Wealth domain


Skills


Strong understanding of statistical methods used in the analysis of experimental and observational data (e.g. causal inference)
Strong problem solving skills and is comfortable doing exploratory data analysis that generates insights and “so whats”
Highly experienced with SQL and Python/R for analytics
Experience working with one or more common data visualisation tools (Tableau, Metabase, Looker, Superset, etc)
Good presentation skills and communication skills.
Experience with Experimentation (e.g. AB testing, multivariate etc)


What’s In It For You


Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most innovative banks 🚀.
Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.


Who we are?

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

Founded in 2013, N26 now has 7 million customers in 24 markets. We employ more than 1,500 employees across 3 office locations in Berlin, Vienna and Barcelona.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

THE WORLD OF UBISOFT

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

Job Description

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.



Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.*



Your daily adventure:



Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.
Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.
Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.
Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.
Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.
Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.
Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.
Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.
Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends.
Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.



Qualifications

YOUR SKILLS



Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.
5+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.
Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.
Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).
Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.
Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.
Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.
Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.
Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.



Nice to Have:



Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.
Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).
Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).
Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.
Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.
Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.



Additional Information

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)



Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery free of taxes).
Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday.
5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
Life Insurance with AXA.
Office Gym open from 7 AM to 8 PM
Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
Language training for English, Spanish, and French.
Professional development training & programs, based upon request.
Ubisoft games are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).



Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

Title: Senior Game Data Analyst - Paper.io 2
Description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position can be onsite (Paris) or full remote within CET time ±3h.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io 2.

With Paper.io2, we’re building an iconic game that players will never forget!

We're a small team of excellent people who take care of everything from ideas to testing, and we intend to grow while maintaining our high standards.

Role


Autonomously take ownership of the A/B testing cycle on Paper.io 2, validating feature values, refining key parameters, and optimizing monetization to drive core KPIs.
Lead analysis of large, complex datasets to uncover player behaviors and growth opportunities.
Translate data insights into clear, actionable recommendations that shape game design and the product roadmap.
Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and developers to embed data-driven decisions throughout the game lifecycle.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that keep the team aligned on critical metrics.


Profile


4+ years in analytical roles within gaming, comfortable working with product teams.
Skilled in SQL and either R or Python; experience with complex, large datasets.
Strong grasp of A/B testing and statistical analysis methods.
Autonomous and pragmatic problem solver with a sharp analytical mind and attention to detail.
Thrives in fast-paced live-ops/product-driven environments with rapid iteration.
Creative thinker who challenges assumptions and sees beyond the obvious.
Player-first mindset with genuine interest in games and player behavior.
Excellent communicator who turns data into compelling, actionable stories.
Collaborative team player who adapts quickly to change and ambiguity.
AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work.


Benefits


Best-in-class compensation
Other benefits based on your country of residence

Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.

Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.

Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.
Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.

Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.

Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.

Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.

Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

Our platform combines content discovery and advertising technology in one solution, helping leading TV brands unlock greater value. Titan OS powers devices from major brands including Philips, AOC and JVC, reaching millions of viewers across Europe and LATAM. Titan OS is also powering free premium FAST Channels on selected SONY Android TVs.

Over the last two years, Titan OS has grown revenue 10x and attracted leading investors, including Highland Europe and Mangrove.

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role overview:

We are looking for a BI Analyst with a wide cross-section of skills, ability and experience. In this role, you will bring data to life through engaging visualizations and compelling insights that help business teams make confident decisions. You will partner with teams across the business to understand their strategic goals and translate them into actionable KPIs and data requirements. Working closely with Data Engineering, you will help define and deliver the data needed to track these metrics effectively.

You will apply your numerical and statistical expertise to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities within the data, turning your findings into clear recommendations for business teams and Senior Management. You will also help shape how data is used across the organization, driving a more data-driven and data-democratic culture.

Key responsibilities:


Building engaging and intuitive BI dashboards and data visualizations
Accurately capture the data requirements that support the delivery of business objectives
Translate these requirements to the Data Engineering / Science teams and be responsible for their delivery
Proactively bring insights to the attention of the business teams with a high degree of focus on driving revenue and growth opportunities
Become a trusted partner to the business teams you work with. You should be seen as a knowledge peer, with subject-matter expertise in data
Bring new and interesting ideas on how to build data storytelling capabilities
KPI development and tracking - we own the measurement of the business


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


At least 6 years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Product Owner or Data Scientist
A strong numerical background with an MS/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a science-related discipline
High proficiency in Python and Dbt-SQLMesh
Ability to create tables and develop schemas that function efficiently, are optimized and scalable
Experience with statistical methodologies and A/B (hypothesis) testing is a huge plus
Hands-on experience using BI data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Open Source, etc)
A data storytelle, that can present data in a compelling and intuitive way
Fantastic communication and interpersonal skills


Benefits

Reasons to apply:


Centrally located office in the heart of Barcelona, with public transportation nearby
Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions


If you're excited about this position, don't hesitate to apply. We're waiting for you to join us! And if you want to know more about us, follow us on LinkedIn!

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Junior Data Analyst

📍 Madrid (Hybrid) | 🕒 Full-time | Permanent




About FERO

At FERO, we’re reinventing checkout for eCommerce.

Our Smart Checkout adapts in real time to each shopper, helping merchants increase conversion, improve payment performance, and unlock significant revenue growth. We work with ambitious eCommerce brands across Europe and are growing rapidly.




About the role

We’re looking for a Junior Data Analyst for our Go-To-Market (GTM) team to support the ongoing improvement of our lead generation and data workflows.




This role focuses on operating and maintaining our existing pipeline for processing data from multiple sources, ensuring data quality, and delivering clean, usable data to the GTM team.




You’ll be working closely with the data team and leadership to drive FERO to new heights. The work you do will directly impact how efficiently leads are processed and activated across the GTM team.




You don’t need to know every tool listed below; we value people who are curious, reliable, and able to learn quickly.


What You’ll Do
Operate and maintain the lead processing workflow (lead sources → data cleaning → CRM → GTM team)
Work with tools like Apollo, Wappalyzer, and similar platforms for lead management
Clean, transform, enrich, and validate data before uploading to our CRM
Maintain and improve API integrations and data enrichment processes
Help automate manual processes to make workflows more consistent and scalable
Monitor the pipeline and troubleshoot issues when they arise
Assist with GTM KPIs and reporting to support sales team improvement
Collaborate with the GTM team to improve data quality and workflow performance

What We’re Looking For




Core skills:

Python (experience in ETL and scripting; pandas and NumPy proficiency highly valued)
SQL (basic to intermediate level; PostgreSQL or MySQL preferred)
Data visualization with popular tools (Tableau, Data Studio, Power BI, etc.)
Experience with HubSpot or other CRMs
Familiarity with LLMs and AI agents (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cursor, etc.)
Familiarity with web scraping
Experience with Jupyter notebooks 
Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Drive)
High level of English (written and spoken)




Nice to have:

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Familiarity with basic automation techniques and bash scripting




*You don’t need to meet every requirement. If you’re comfortable with the basics and willing to learn, we encourage you to apply.


Who You Are
Organized and detail-oriented
Proactive and able to work independently or as part of a team
Curious and motivated to learn
Comfortable working cross-functionally and collaborating across teams

﻿

What You’ll Gain
Hands-on experience with real GTM and data workflows
Exposure to teams across the company, from Product to Platform
Practical skills in automation, data pipelines, and CRM systems
Close collaboration with senior engineers and sales leadership
Opportunities to improve and scale systems, not just maintain them
Room to grow and learn new technologies




What we offer

Permanent contract.
Private health insurance (partially covered).
Hybrid work (3 days office / 2 remote).
Office in a central location in Madrid.




🧭 Hiring process

1. Screening call.

2. Interview with the Hiring Manager.

3. Final conversation.




⚡ Ready to make an impact with data?

If you’re excited about working with real data, improving workflows, exploring new technologies, and helping a fast-growing fintech scale, we’d love to hear from you.




Join FERO and help us turn better data into better business opportunities!

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a Data Analyst to join the Office of Adversary Strategy. As a Data Analyst in this organization, you have the privilege of working with various types of cybersecurity data to support our larger mission of stopping breaches from a purposefully adversarial mindset.

We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to join our team and support the ability to make data-informed decisions across our portfolio. In this role, you will analyze large-scale security telemetry, threat intelligence feeds, and detection data to uncover patterns, improve operations, and support strategic initiatives. You'll work cross-functionally with various product and engineering teams to transform raw security data into actionable insights.

If you are a hands-on data nerd who loves to run queries all day and wants to operate at scale, apply & let's talk!

What You'll Do:


Analyze large volumes of security event data, endpoint telemetry, and threat intelligence feeds to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging threats
Design and maintain dashboards and reports that track key security metrics
Translate complex security data findings into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Build and maintain data pipelines and reporting workflows using SQL, Python, Logscale, or similar tools
Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data quality, integrity, and accessibility
Contribute to the development of KPIs and metrics frameworks for measuring security product performance and adoption
Stay current on cybersecurity trends, adversary behaviors, and industry best practices to inform analysis


What You'll Need:


Curiosity and a deep desire for continuous learning
Education: Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
Experience: 3-5 years of experience in data analysis, preferably within cybersecurity, IT, or related technical domains
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in querying large, complex, datasets, in particular graph databases
Experience with tools like Python or R for data analysis and automation
Familiarity with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar)
Experience working with large-scale, high-velocity datasets (logs, streaming telemetry, SIEM data)
Bonus: Understanding of security concepts (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK framework, security operations experience)
Analytical Skills:
Strong statistical analysis and quantitative reasoning skills
Ability to translate ambiguous business/security questions into structured analyses
Communication Skills:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

Market leader in compensation and equity awards

Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Growth)
Description:
⭐ Who we are




Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology.




Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.




⭐ Role Overview




The Growth Enablement Team is the connective tissue of our Growth organization: we don't optimize a single funnel stage, we build the foundations that let every Growth squad (Acquisition, Activation & Retention, Sales, and Partnerships) move faster, measure better, and experiment with confidence.

As a Senior Growth Data Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of marketing technology, data engineering, and growth analytics, spearheading Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), advanced data modeling, and campaign performance insights that directly shape multi-channel marketing investment and revenue growth.




You'll own advanced analytics frameworks end-to-end, mentor peers, and set the standard for data quality across the growth org.




⭐ How will you make an impact?

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM): You design, calibrate, and maintain Marketing Mix Models to quantify cross-channel marketing performance and guide long-term media spend allocation.
Growth data modelling: You architect scalable data models and analytical schemas that integrate multi-channel marketing, web, and product telemetry into unified growth datasets. You have expertise in the technological stack with BigQuery as the warehouse, DBT for production-grade modelling, RudderStack for event streaming, and Omni as the self-serve BI layer.
Campaign performance & insight generation: You conduct deep-dive exploratory analytics across acquisition channels (paid search, paid social, organic) to surface high-leverage growth opportunities.
AI-enabled analytics and agentic automation: You actively use AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting workflows, and improve insight generation speed across the growth org. You contribute to Lodgify's AI Enablement programme by identifying and deploying analytics automation opportunities.
CRM and lifecycle analytics: You design and implement measurement and incrementality frameworks for event-driven lifecycle workflows, evaluating their short-, mid-, and long-term impact on customer activation, retention, and lifetime value.
GEO and AI search measurement: You ****design measurement frameworks for AI search visibility, tracking share of voice in LLM answer engines and attributing traffic contribution from GEO channels where traditional UTM attribution is structurally insufficient.
Data storytelling & executive presentations: You synthesise complex quantitative findings into clear visual artefacts and strategic narratives for marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Attribution and measurement: You own Lodgify's full measurement stack, spanning MMM as the strategic budget allocation layer, incrementally and geo-lift testing to validate true channel impact, and privacy-first server-side event tracking as the data collection standard. You design measurement approaches for AI search and GEO channels where UTM-based attribution is structurally insufficient
Strategic cross-functional alignment: You partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to align growth analytics with core unit economics like CAC and LTV.
Data governance & analytics standards: You establish data documentation, reporting standards, and visualisation guidelines to raise overall analytical quality across the growth organisation.




⭐ What makes you a great fit:

Presentation and Influencing: Crafts compelling presentations that connect technical or functional insights to business outcomes, ensuring clarity and resonance across departments. Uses storytelling and analogies to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus without formal authority. Persuades through evidence-backed recommendations while addressing potential concerns upfront. Shapes direction by influencing decisions in cross-functional initiatives through clear, confident communication.
Data-Driven Mindset: Synthesises complex datasets into concise insights that guide decision makers, e.g., highlighting trends, anomalies, and risks. Uses multiple data sources (quantitative & qualitative) to tell a coherent story, and distinguishes between correlation and causation. Applies strong judgment in interpreting incomplete or noisy data, and articulates limitations. Coaches others in data visualization and storytelling, raising the team’s overall data literacy.
Business Acumen: Translates strategic goals into operational decisions and trade-offs for own work. Anticipates business challenges by integrating customer insights, market trends, and internal data. Builds a solid understanding of how different departments contribute to commercial success. Advocates for initiatives with clearly articulated business impact.
Problem Solving: Anticipates problems before they escalate and proactively mitigates risks. Develops creative, workable solutions to complex, cross-functional challenges. Balances trade-offs between resource constraints, stakeholder needs, and long-term business goals. Critically analyses multiple sources of information, validating credibility before making decisions. Guides colleagues on structured problem-solving techniques and decision-making frameworks.
Stakeholder Management: Anticipates stakeholder concerns and proactively addresses them in planning and delivery. Navigates complex or conflicting stakeholder priorities by facilitating compromise grounded in data and shared outcomes. Builds long-term stakeholder trust through consistent, transparent communication and follow-through. Educates stakeholders on technical or operational constraints to manage expectations and build mutual understanding.
Analytics Expertise. Proven experience with marketing analytics, deep knowledge of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and multi-touch attribution to evaluate and optimise growth campaigns.




Why you’ll love us:

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.




What's in it for you?*

🏠 Remote Flexibility: The freedom to work from home any day that works for you.

🌴 Time to Recharge: 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August..

💊 Alan Health Insurance: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.

😋 Meal Perk: €150/month allowance on your Alan card + 50% off Ametller Origen prepared dishes at the office.

💸 Tax-Free Savings: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for extra meal costs (up to €70/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).

🖥️ Home Office Gear: We provide a table, ergonomic chair, and monitor for your home setup.

🇪🇸 Language Learning: Free Spanish classes.

🤑 Referrals: Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.

🌟 Social Life: Daily office breakfast and monthly team events

🎯 Dynamic Hub: A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.

*Benefits offered may differ based on the type of contract that is issued




So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

Title: Data Analyst (Performance & Commercial Excellence)
Description:
¿Te apasiona el análisis de datos y disfrutas transformando información en decisiones que generan impacto real en el negocio? ¿Te gustaría contribuir a la evolución de una compañía internacional líder en salud bucodental?




En Dentaid buscamos incorporar un/a Data Analyst | Performance & Commercial Excellence para nuestras oficinas centrales en Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona).




🦷 ¿Quiénes somos?

En Dentaid trabajamos con un propósito claro: promover y mejorar la salud bucal de las personas a lo largo de toda su vida.




Somos una compañía internacional especializada en salud bucodental, comprometida con la investigación, la innovación y el desarrollo de soluciones basadas en la evidencia científica.




Como parte del área de Center of Excellence, contribuirás a impulsar una cultura orientada al dato, desarrollando soluciones analíticas que permitan optimizar la toma de decisiones, mejorar la ejecución comercial y generar nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento para el negocio.




🎯 Tu misión

Transformar datos operativos y comerciales en información fiable, automatizada y accionable, proporcionando visibilidad sobre el desempeño del negocio y facilitando la toma de decisiones basada en datos.




🚀 ¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Diseñar y mantener dashboards e informes automatizados para el seguimiento de la actividad comercial y los principales indicadores de negocio.
Definir, documentar y asegurar la correcta aplicación de KPIs y métricas junto con las áreas propietarias del proceso.
Analizar indicadores de productividad, actividad, cobertura, rutas, campañas, acuerdos comerciales y resultados de negocio.
Desarrollar herramientas y funcionalidades que faciliten la preparación de visitas y la priorización de acciones comerciales.
Identificar patrones, desviaciones, riesgos y oportunidades de mejora a través del análisis de datos.
Elaborar reporting recurrente para equipos comerciales y dirección, garantizando la fiabilidad y consistencia de la información.
Crear alertas, segmentaciones y listas de acción que ayuden a mejorar la ejecución comercial.
Colaborar de forma transversal con los equipos de Comercial, Marketing, Finanzas, Supply Chain, CRM e IT.
Impulsar la gobernanza, calidad y trazabilidad de los datos utilizados en la organización.
Trabajar junto a IT Corporativa para industrializar soluciones analíticas y garantizar su sostenibilidad y escalabilidad.




🧩 ¿Qué buscamos en ti?

Grado universitario en ADE, Economía, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Data Science o disciplinas afines.
Experiencia de entre 1 y 3 años en posiciones relacionadas con Business Intelligence, Sales Analytics, Commercial Excellence o Reporting.
Dominio de Power BI y Excel avanzado.
Conocimientos de SQL para análisis y explotación de datos.
Valorable experiencia con Python y herramientas de automatización.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos, visualización y control de calidad de la información.
Nivel profesional de inglés.
Capacidad analítica, orientación a resultados y habilidad para convertir datos en recomendaciones accionables.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y visualización de información.
Proactividad, autonomía y orientación a la mejora continua.




✨ ¿Qué te ofrecemos?

En Dentaid encontrarás:

La oportunidad de participar en proyectos estratégicos con impacto directo en la toma de decisiones del negocio.
Un entorno dinámico, colaborativo e innovador, donde el dato juega un papel clave en la transformación de la organización.
Colaboración transversal con diferentes áreas nacionales e internacionales.
Desarrollo profesional en una compañía internacional líder en salud bucodental.
31 días laborables de vacaciones.

Modalidad de trabajo híbrida.
Retribución flexible (seguro médico, transporte, formación, etc.).
Beneficios y descuentos para empleados/as.

Si te apasiona descubrir insights a partir de los datos, impulsar decisiones basadas en evidencia y participar en proyectos con impacto real en el negocio, queremos conocerte. 👉 ¡Inscríbete!

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Data team at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics. The Analytics pillar is split into two teams: Product Analytics, working closely with our Product teams, and Revenue Analytics, partnering directly with the Business Unit leads in the Revenue org.

The Revenue Analytics function sits at the intersection of growth, customer acquisition, lifecycle management and commercial steering, as part of the Data Analytics team. You'll join the Revenue Analytics team, led by Saghar, our Analytics Manager, who heads a team of four data analysts and you'd be the fifth. This structure means you'll spend less time fixing broken pipelines and more time uncovering high-value insights

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What’s in it for you?


Direct Business Impact: Your work will directly shape how BU Managers and Country GMs steer revenue, churn, and growth decisions across markets, with clear visibility to senior leadership.
End-to-End Business Intelligence: From acquisition and activation to churn, retention, and revenue quality, you will own the analytical narrative for your BU scope, spanning marketing performance, product adoption, and commercial health.
Local Market Influence: You will partner closely with BU Managers and local marketing teams to understand country-specific dynamics and translate data into practical commercial decisions.
Strategic Growth Partnership: You will help shape budget allocation, campaign optimisation, funnel improvements and lifecycle opportunities based on robust analytical evidence.
A Mature Stack: Work with a modern data stack including Snowflake, dbt, Python and Omni, supported by a dedicated Analytics Engineering team.
A hybrid work policy: Enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.
Modern, centrally located offices: Work from modern office spaces in prime city locations.
An international environment: Join a diverse team with colleagues from across Europe.
Mobility across locations: Opportunity to work from our offices in Madrid, Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam or Berlin.


Your Responsibilities Will Include


Business KPI Definition & Governance: Establish, define and maintain the core KPI framework for your BU scope, including revenue metrics, churn rate, activation, retention, payback, LTV and customer-quality metrics.
Steering Dashboards: Design and deliver actionable dashboards for BU Managers and Country GMs, enabling reliable performance steering across Germany and Spain.
Data Modelling & Collection: Build robust, scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad-hoc marketing analytics needs.
Project & Stakeholder Management: Lead analytical projects end-to-end, managing timelines, priorities and senior stakeholder expectations across local BUs, Marketing and Data.
Funnel & Conversion Analysis: Own the analytical view of the customer journey from first touch to activation, paying customer and retained user, identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Customer Lifecycle Analytics: Analyse onboarding, activation, retention and lifecycle campaigns, helping local teams improve customer engagement and long-term revenue quality.
Performance Marketing Analytics: Analyse paid and organic acquisition performance across channels, campaigns, audiences and markets, helping teams understand where growth is efficient and where optimisation is needed.
Experimentation & Incrementality: Support the design, measurement and interpretation of marketing experiments, including A/B tests, landing-page tests, lifecycle tests and channel tests.
Cross-functional Connectivity: Bridge insights across Revenue, Product, Marketing, Finance and Customer Success, ensuring a unified view of customer acquisition, value creation and retention.


📍 Job located in Berlin or Madrid, with possibility of two remote working days per week

About You


Experience: 5+ years in Data Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Growth Analytics or Revenue Analytics, ideally in a SaaS, fintech, subscription, marketplace or digital product environment.
Technical Excellence: Expert-level SQL and solid experience with dbt (modelling, testing, and documentation).
Business & Revenue Analytics Expertise: Strong understanding of revenue metrics (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, payback), customer lifecycle and funnel analytics and commercial KPI frameworks. Marketing analytics experience is a strong plus.
Analytical Breadth: Comfortable working across forecasting, LTV modelling, funnel analysis, and operational KPI frameworks.
Communication: Ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable recommendations for senior non-technical stakeholders.
Language: Fluent in English. German is strongly preferred for the German market scope; Spanish would be beneficial for the Spain market scope.
Nice to have: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Hightouch, Census, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads or similar.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Technical Call (60’): Discussion with Julian (Head of Data Analytics)

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation + a technical SQL assessment. (75’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Meet the team (30')

Title: Sr. Data Analyst - Monetization (Remote)
Description:
Who We Are (Mode.Inc)

Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities.

Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be the analytical partner to our Monetization team. You'll own how we measure and grow revenue across our portfolio of mobile apps and web properties, spanning subscriptions, in-app purchases, advertising, and partner offers, and turn that into clear recommendations on pricing, packaging, and revenue mix. The ideal candidate has exceptional SQL and Python skills, hands-on experience with consumer subscription apps, and the rigor to design pricing experiments that hold up.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain common datasets and data pipelines that strengthen self-service analytics and enable data-driven decision making across the organization
Improve data quality, accuracy, reliability, and documentation to strengthen self-service analytics
Own revenue and monetization metrics across the portfolio, including ARPU/ARPDAU, LTV, trial-to-paid conversion, renewal and churn rates, refunds, and revenue mix by source
Design and analyze pricing, packaging, and paywall experiments (price points, trial length, plan structure, paywall placement and copy), and read results with statistical rigor
Build subscription cohort and LTV models that inform pricing decisions and feed back into UA bidding and payback targets
Analyze ad monetization performance, including eCPM, fill rate, impressions per user, and mediation/bidding setup, and balance ad revenue against retention and user experience
Measure the economics of partner offers and rewards, including revenue earned vs. rewards paid out, to keep the rewards model profitable
Reconcile revenue data across app stores, subscription platforms, ad networks, and internal systems, and investigate discrepancies
Partner with Monetization, Product, and GMs on revenue forecasting, opportunity sizing, and roadmap prioritization
Communicate analytical findings through clear, compelling narratives to drive alignment, inform prioritization, and deliver measurable business impact


What You Bring to the Team


Analytical excellence to dissect complex, ambiguous problems and uncover actionable insights
Solid SQL and Python programming skills, and experience working with large-scale production data
Business acumen to translate data and analysis into business impact
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate in a highly cross-functional environment
4+ years in analytics, preferred background in monetization, pricing, or revenue analytics for consumer subscription apps & games
Experience with LTV modeling and revenue forecasting on subscription and ad monetized apps/games
Track record of designing and interpreting pricing or paywall A/B tests, including pitfalls like novelty effects, long conversion windows, and LTV vs. short-term conversion tradeoffs
Familiarity with app store subscription mechanics (App Store/Google Play billing, trials, grace periods, renewals, refunds) and subscription platforms (e.g., RevenueCat, Superwall, Adapty)
Nice to have: experience with ad mediation experience (AppLovin MAX, ironSource/Unity LevelPlay, AdMob), web checkout or web-to-app payments, rewards or loyalty program economics, Big Data tools (Redshift/Spark/Airflow), dashboarding tools (Looker, Tableau), experiment design, predictive modeling, log analysis, AI, or experience in tech or startup environments


Alignment with Our Core Values:


Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.


You'll Thrive Here If You Are


Analytical
Pragmatic
Curious
Communicative
Action-Driven
Collaborative

High ownership and autonomy across business units
Direct impact on product, revenue, and user experiences
Strong partners across engineering, product, growth, and content
Opportunities to shape Mode's analytics function and data culture
A fast-moving, supportive, global remote environment


We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms


Allow OKRs to Guide Us
Assume Positive Intent
Agree to Disagree & Commit
Set New Precedents
Accomplish More with Less
Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
Speak Up
Be Resourceful
Follow the 80/20 Rule


What We Are Offering


We are a 100% remote-first, global company.
A competitive compensation package.
We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full-time team members).
We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people.
Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
Bonusly - We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full-time team members).
