Title: Senior Data Analyst - Finance
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Senior Data Analyst - Finance

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Reporting team and we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Treasury domain!

Our data mission is to develop and maintain Ebury’s Data Platform and serve it to the whole company. This platform is the backbone of Ebury: it supports internal decision making, allows us to monitor our Treasury positions and risks, comply with regulatory reporting obligations and enables commercial opportunities globally.

The Data team works closely with Treasury, Product and Tech teams to coordinate and implement data analysis initiatives helping the Cash management, ALM and Treasury Reporting teams. Some of the projects we are currently working on include: MtM valuations reconciliation with our Treasury reporting system to ensure completeness and accuracy in our Financial statements, cash operational charges data analysis to reduce Treasury costs, liquidity data analysis to help ALM team manage daily liquidity obligations, and building AI agentic workflows to automate routine data operations and decision support, and many many more!

As part of the team you will


Work closely with the rest of the Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineering, Treasury and Product teams
Be responsible for modelling data in our collaborative data platform to perform critical Treasury data analysis and build reports and reconciliations for the Treasury domain
Manage end-to-end treasury solutions across all jurisdictions of the company from requirements gathering, building optimised data models and delivering the reports to our treasury stakeholders and auditors
Maintain and build dashboards and visualisations on the data platform using our BI tools for Treasury teams to monitor reporting and controls


What we’re looking for


4+ years of experience in Data/Business Analytics - applied to Treasury or Finance is a plus!
Advanced SQL skills - must be able to read and write complex SQL queries
Experience with our modern data stack tools (a plus!) We use dbt, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, DataStudio), Sigma
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail
The ability to manage, organise and present data in a clear, concise and actionable format
Experience working with Python is a plus
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and demanding work environment
Track record of working autonomously with time management skills
Fluency in English
Financial Services and Capital Markets Experience (FX, Payments, Money Markets, Treasury Management, etc) is a good plus!


What Ebury offers you


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

Title: DATA ANALYST - EXPERIENCIA DE CLIENTE
Description:
Descripción del puesto:

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

Buscamos un Data Analyst para impulsar el desarrollo de la capa informacional del banco y aportar valor directo al negocio y a la dirección. Su misión será transformar datos - estructurados y no estructurados - en conocimiento útil que permita entender mejor el negocio, el mercado y nuestros clientes, así como identificar oportunidades de mejora y crecimiento.

La persona seleccionada formará parte de un equipo transversal y tendrá un rol clave como analista end‑to‑end, combinando análisis ad‑hoc, automatización de procesos, definición de KPIs, construcción de dashboards y participación activa en la migración de nuestros procesos y proyectos al entorno cloud.

Este rol es ideal para alguien con iniciativa, fuerte capacidad analítica, curiosidad y ganas de asumir un papel amplio y de impacto dentro del equipo.

 

Sus responsabilidades incluyen:

 

Gestión de la relación con los clientes (dirección y áreas de negocio)

Interlocución habitual con dirección y áreas de negocio para entender necesidades y traducirlas en soluciones basadas en datos.
Priorización y planificación de los proyectos y peticiones recurrentes.
Gestión de expectativas, seguimiento y comunicación de resultados.

 

Realización de proyectos en los que se aborda el ciclo completo de análisis de información

Toma de requerimientos de información de negocio
Exploración de datos en Datapool y/o fuentes externas. Desde la búsqueda hasta el tratamiento de los datos hasta generar la información necesaria
Propuesta y generación de KPIs
Construcción de los informes / análisis para presentar la información
Comunicación de resultados a los clientes
Diseño, elaboración, mantenimiento y automatización los procesos para seguimientos recurrentes o peticiones puntuales.

 

Para realizar estas funciones, será necesario:

Tener conocimientos técnicos para llevar a cabo los informes que se requieran desde negocio
Tener cualidades analíticas que permitan entender la lógica de negocio y proponer nuevas ideas o estrategias que ayuden a impulsarlo
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales, así como creatividad y atención a los detalles en la visualización y comunicación de información.
Requisitos mínimos
Licenciatura en carreras de ciencias o ingenierías.
Fuertes capacidades de análisis y gestión de datos, con uso de herramientas de análisis y explotación de Bases de datos: alto nivel en SQL, fluidez en Data Discovery y Análisis Estadísticos, Python, GIT, Airflow.
Formación en lenguajes de programación.
Generación de dashboards con herramientas de visualización como QlikSense, Looker, etc.
Nivel avanzado herramientas de ofimática (Excel, Power Point, etc).

 

Se valorará positivamente:

Experiencia trabajando o analizando experiencia de cliente (NPS, touchpoints, etc.)
Experiencia previa en Google Cloud o en otras plataformas cloud (AWS, etc.).
Experiencia previa en Banca en departamentos de analítica/BI.

 

Competencias Clave

 

Gestión de grandes volúmenes de datos
Gestión de proyectos de información (relación con clientes y proveedores)
Capacidad de traducir requerimientos de negocio en especificaciones técnicas
Persona resolutiva, con entusiasmo y compromiso, colaborativa
Perfil flexible, con capacidad de adaptación al cambio
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales
Orientación al negocio y a la experiencia de cliente
Definición y seguimiento de KPI’s comerciales

 

¿Qué ofrecemos?
Formar parte del Banco más innovador en Europa Occidental, según los premios The Innovators de la revista estadounidense Global Finance.
Programa de onboarding y acompañamiento personalizado para tu desarrollo profesional.
Itinerario formativo individual con acceso a nuestra plataforma online, que ofrece un extenso catálogo de recursos de autoaprendizaje para fomentar tu crecimiento continuo.
Dispondrás de un seguro de salud completo totalmente gratuito para ti. Además, quedarás adherido al Plan de Pensiones, al que CaixaBank realizará aportaciones pensando ya en tu futuro.
Retribución flexible aplicada a transporte, formación, idiomas, guardería, entre otros.
Medidas de flexibilidad (trabajo en remoto, flexibilidad entrada)
Contamos con la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar.

Title: Senior Game Data Analyst - Paper.io 2
Description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position can be onsite (Paris) or full remote within CET time ±3h.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io 2.

With Paper.io2, we’re building an iconic game that players will never forget!

We're a small team of excellent people who take care of everything from ideas to testing, and we intend to grow while maintaining our high standards.

Role


Autonomously take ownership of the A/B testing cycle on Paper.io 2, validating feature values, refining key parameters, and optimizing monetization to drive core KPIs.
Lead analysis of large, complex datasets to uncover player behaviors and growth opportunities.
Translate data insights into clear, actionable recommendations that shape game design and the product roadmap.
Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and developers to embed data-driven decisions throughout the game lifecycle.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that keep the team aligned on critical metrics.


Profile


4+ years in analytical roles within gaming, comfortable working with product teams.
Skilled in SQL and either R or Python; experience with complex, large datasets.
Strong grasp of A/B testing and statistical analysis methods.
Autonomous and pragmatic problem solver with a sharp analytical mind and attention to detail.
Thrives in fast-paced live-ops/product-driven environments with rapid iteration.
Creative thinker who challenges assumptions and sees beyond the obvious.
Player-first mindset with genuine interest in games and player behavior.
Excellent communicator who turns data into compelling, actionable stories.
Collaborative team player who adapts quickly to change and ambiguity.
AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work.


Benefits


Best-in-class compensation
Other benefits based on your country of residence

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

THE WORLD OF UBISOFT

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

Job Description

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.



Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.*



Your daily adventure:



Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.
Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.
Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.
Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.
Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.
Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.
Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.
Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.
Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends.
Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.



Qualifications

YOUR SKILLS



Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.
5+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.
Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.
Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).
Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.
Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.
Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.
Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.
Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.



Nice to Have:



Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.
Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).
Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).
Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.
Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.
Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.



Additional Information

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)



Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery free of taxes).
Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday.
5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
Life Insurance with AXA.
Office Gym open from 7 AM to 8 PM
Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
Language training for English, Spanish, and French.
Professional development training & programs, based upon request.
Ubisoft games are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).



Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - B2B
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team

Preply's B2B segment is a growing vertical, and this is a newly created role to strengthen its analytics capabilities. You will own B2B analytics projects, such as LTV, retention analysis and B2B reporting, from problem definition to recommendation, with a day-to-day focus on retention, renewals and customer value. You will work alongside the Staff Data Analyst and Data manager for B2B, who leads company-level and cross-domain questions. You'll partner across Product, Ops, Engineering, Sales, Account Management and RevOps, and occasionally contribute to company-level questions when they touch B2B influencing B2B roadmap and strategy.

About The Role

This is an analytics role at the intersection of product, business and finance, focused on what drives long-term B2B growth, retention and unit economics, and on turning that into decisions teams and leadership act on. You will work directly with Directors and VPs on B2B trade-offs, and your analysis is expected to change what gets built, priced or prioritised.

Getting there means building the trusted data layer first. In the first 6–12 months you will review and fix B2B metrics and data quality, improve reporting so teams can self-serve, and deliver the analyses behind the year's priority decisions. By month 12, success looks like a B2B metric set leadership uses without caveats and a renewal-risk view the Account Management team acts on.

What You Will Be Doing


Own retention, renewals and customer value analytics for B2B: lead cohort, renewal and customer-activity analyses that answer priority business questions, and turn findings into concrete pricing, product or lifecycle recommendations.
Develop the analytical frameworks B2B teams and leadership use to evaluate trade-offs and spot opportunities for growth, retention and expansion.
Build impact models and scenario analyses for priority B2B initiatives, supporting planning and decisions with clear assumptions, trade-offs and limitations.
Own LTV/CAC for B2B and the metrics behind it (NRR, GRR, CAC, CAC payback): build the model, keep it honest, and make sure the business understands what it can and cannot say.
Define and review B2B metrics with business stakeholders: purpose, calculation logic, data quality and edge cases. Document agreed definitions and drive consistent use across teams.
Maintain the trusted B2B data layer: build and maintain analytical models in dbt and Looker, and investigate data-quality issues with RevOps, Salesforce owners and Analytics Engineering, validating how they affect reporting and analysis.
Partner with business and product teams to define hypotheses, prioritise experiments and agree how success will be measured. Analyse results and explain what the evidence supports and where uncertainty remains, including when a clean experiment isn't possible.
Decide what should be self-serve and build only what changes behaviour: dashboards and reports stakeholders use independently, validated with them.
Prioritise analytical work based on business impact and align on clear commitments, partnering with stakeholders across Product, Ops, Engineering, Sales, Account Management and RevOps to understand business needs and turn insights into actions. Share knowledge and support other analysts.


What You Need To Succeed


You can point to a specific decision (a pricing change, a resourcing call, a roadmap cut) that happened because of your analysis, and explain how you took it from an unclear business question to a validated recommendation and how you assessed the result afterwards.
You understand B2B or account-based business models, including acquisition, contracts, renewal, retention and expansion, and you are fluent in NRR, GRR, CAC and CAC payback. Subscription or marketplace experience counts if you can apply it to B2B questions.
Experience defining or reviewing business metrics, investigating data-quality issues and agreeing calculation logic with stakeholders.
You have built an LTV, cohort or revenue forecast model yourself, not only interpreted one someone else built, and you can explain its assumptions and where it breaks.
Strong SQL and solid data-modelling experience. You can independently build, maintain and validate analytical models, and you review others' SQL and dbt rather than waiting for review.
Applied statistics for customer behaviour, retention and experiments. You distinguish association from causation, explain uncertainty and measurement limits, and know what to do when you can't randomise: pre/post with controls, matched cohorts, difference-in-differences, or an honest decision-grade approximation.
Strong critical thinking, stakeholder management and communication: you clarify the business need behind a request, challenge assumptions constructively, and agree priorities based on business value. You explain findings, assumptions and limitations clearly to different audiences, including Directors and VPs, and propose practical next steps.
Experience translating business questions into useful dashboards and reports with a BI tool, and validating them with users using storytelling with data principles.


Nice to have


Direct experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise businesses.
Hands-on dbt in production.
Experience improving analytics practices: documentation, data-quality checks, self-service reporting, KPI frameworks.
Experience with Looker.
Master's or PhD in a quantitative field.


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: Data Analyst III (Remote)
Description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a Data Analyst to join the Office of Adversary Strategy. As a Data Analyst in this organization, you have the privilege of working with various types of cybersecurity data to support our larger mission of stopping breaches from a purposefully adversarial mindset.

We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to join our team and support the ability to make data-informed decisions across our portfolio. In this role, you will analyze large-scale security telemetry, threat intelligence feeds, and detection data to uncover patterns, improve operations, and support strategic initiatives. You'll work cross-functionally with various product and engineering teams to transform raw security data into actionable insights.

If you are a hands-on data nerd who loves to run queries all day and wants to operate at scale, apply & let's talk!

What You'll Do:


Analyze large volumes of security event data, endpoint telemetry, and threat intelligence feeds to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging threats
Design and maintain dashboards and reports that track key security metrics
Translate complex security data findings into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Build and maintain data pipelines and reporting workflows using SQL, Python, Logscale, or similar tools
Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data quality, integrity, and accessibility
Contribute to the development of KPIs and metrics frameworks for measuring security product performance and adoption
Stay current on cybersecurity trends, adversary behaviors, and industry best practices to inform analysis


What You'll Need:


Curiosity and a deep desire for continuous learning
Education: Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
Experience: 3-5 years of experience in data analysis, preferably within cybersecurity, IT, or related technical domains
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in querying large, complex, datasets, in particular graph databases
Experience with tools like Python or R for data analysis and automation
Familiarity with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar)
Experience working with large-scale, high-velocity datasets (logs, streaming telemetry, SIEM data)
Bonus: Understanding of security concepts (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK framework, security operations experience)
Analytical Skills:
Strong statistical analysis and quantitative reasoning skills
Ability to translate ambiguous business/security questions into structured analyses
Communication Skills:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

Market leader in compensation and equity awards
Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
Paid parental and adoption leaves
Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Growth)
Description:
⭐ Who we are




Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology.




Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.




⭐ Role Overview




The Growth Enablement Team is the connective tissue of our Growth organization: we don't optimize a single funnel stage, we build the foundations that let every Growth squad (Acquisition, Activation & Retention, Sales, and Partnerships) move faster, measure better, and experiment with confidence.

As a Senior Growth Data Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of marketing technology, data engineering, and growth analytics, spearheading Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), advanced data modeling, and campaign performance insights that directly shape multi-channel marketing investment and revenue growth.




You'll own advanced analytics frameworks end-to-end, mentor peers, and set the standard for data quality across the growth org.




⭐ How will you make an impact?

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM): You design, calibrate, and maintain Marketing Mix Models to quantify cross-channel marketing performance and guide long-term media spend allocation.
Growth data modelling: You architect scalable data models and analytical schemas that integrate multi-channel marketing, web, and product telemetry into unified growth datasets. You have expertise in the technological stack with BigQuery as the warehouse, DBT for production-grade modelling, RudderStack for event streaming, and Omni as the self-serve BI layer.
Campaign performance & insight generation: You conduct deep-dive exploratory analytics across acquisition channels (paid search, paid social, organic) to surface high-leverage growth opportunities.
AI-enabled analytics and agentic automation: You actively use AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting workflows, and improve insight generation speed across the growth org. You contribute to Lodgify's AI Enablement programme by identifying and deploying analytics automation opportunities.
CRM and lifecycle analytics: You design and implement measurement and incrementality frameworks for event-driven lifecycle workflows, evaluating their short-, mid-, and long-term impact on customer activation, retention, and lifetime value.
GEO and AI search measurement: You ****design measurement frameworks for AI search visibility, tracking share of voice in LLM answer engines and attributing traffic contribution from GEO channels where traditional UTM attribution is structurally insufficient.
Data storytelling & executive presentations: You synthesise complex quantitative findings into clear visual artefacts and strategic narratives for marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Attribution and measurement: You own Lodgify's full measurement stack, spanning MMM as the strategic budget allocation layer, incrementally and geo-lift testing to validate true channel impact, and privacy-first server-side event tracking as the data collection standard. You design measurement approaches for AI search and GEO channels where UTM-based attribution is structurally insufficient
Strategic cross-functional alignment: You partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to align growth analytics with core unit economics like CAC and LTV.
Data governance & analytics standards: You establish data documentation, reporting standards, and visualisation guidelines to raise overall analytical quality across the growth organisation.




⭐ What makes you a great fit:

Presentation and Influencing: Crafts compelling presentations that connect technical or functional insights to business outcomes, ensuring clarity and resonance across departments. Uses storytelling and analogies to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus without formal authority. Persuades through evidence-backed recommendations while addressing potential concerns upfront. Shapes direction by influencing decisions in cross-functional initiatives through clear, confident communication.
Data-Driven Mindset: Synthesises complex datasets into concise insights that guide decision makers, e.g., highlighting trends, anomalies, and risks. Uses multiple data sources (quantitative & qualitative) to tell a coherent story, and distinguishes between correlation and causation. Applies strong judgment in interpreting incomplete or noisy data, and articulates limitations. Coaches others in data visualization and storytelling, raising the team’s overall data literacy.
Business Acumen: Translates strategic goals into operational decisions and trade-offs for own work. Anticipates business challenges by integrating customer insights, market trends, and internal data. Builds a solid understanding of how different departments contribute to commercial success. Advocates for initiatives with clearly articulated business impact.
Problem Solving: Anticipates problems before they escalate and proactively mitigates risks. Develops creative, workable solutions to complex, cross-functional challenges. Balances trade-offs between resource constraints, stakeholder needs, and long-term business goals. Critically analyses multiple sources of information, validating credibility before making decisions. Guides colleagues on structured problem-solving techniques and decision-making frameworks.
Stakeholder Management: Anticipates stakeholder concerns and proactively addresses them in planning and delivery. Navigates complex or conflicting stakeholder priorities by facilitating compromise grounded in data and shared outcomes. Builds long-term stakeholder trust through consistent, transparent communication and follow-through. Educates stakeholders on technical or operational constraints to manage expectations and build mutual understanding.
Analytics Expertise. Proven experience with marketing analytics, deep knowledge of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and multi-touch attribution to evaluate and optimise growth campaigns.




Why you’ll love us:

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.




What's in it for you?*

🏠 Remote Flexibility: The freedom to work from home any day that works for you.

🌴 Time to Recharge: 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August..

💊 Alan Health Insurance: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.

😋 Meal Perk: €150/month allowance on your Alan card + 50% off Ametller Origen prepared dishes at the office.

💸 Tax-Free Savings: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for extra meal costs (up to €70/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).

🖥️ Home Office Gear: We provide a table, ergonomic chair, and monitor for your home setup.

🇪🇸 Language Learning: Free Spanish classes.

🤑 Referrals: Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.

🌟 Social Life: Daily office breakfast and monthly team events

🎯 Dynamic Hub: A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.

*Benefits offered may differ based on the type of contract that is issued




So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

Title: Data Analyst - Everyday Banking
Description:
Summary

We are seeking an organised and self-motivated Data Analyst to work embedded in our Everyday Banking team, to help shape the development of one of the world's leading FinTech products.

About The Opportunity

As a Data Analyst (Product) you will enable our product and business segments (Cards, Payments in the Everyday Banking domain to make data-driven decisions. You will monitor, measure and analyse the effectiveness of your product teams’ initiatives, as well as help drive the strategy of your business segment. You are here to establish a data-mindset and thereby to foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. You will work in a cross functional setup, working closely with other analysts, engineers, designers, and product managers.

In This Role, You Will


Help us set the right goals: Develop clear and measurable targets based on an initiatives’ scope. Improve our overall forecasting and goal setting capabilities.
Handle stakeholders: Be an internal go-to-person for your teams when it comes to data related questions.
Evaluate initiatives: Support Product experimentation & A/B testing initiatives; design test plans, obtain cross-functional alignment, execute robust analysis, and deliver actionable insights. Share these learnings through clear documentation and concise and empathic communication.
Contribute to self-serve data platform: Help building the right analytics foundations ,by pairing up with technical peers, so our product and business teams can interact with data and extract the right insights themselves.
Provide monitoring tools: Build the dashboards your team looks at every week to make sure they are impacting our company OKRs.
Improve data literacy of organisation: Educate teams to become independent when it comes to data access and understanding function led training and team wide workshops to foster data driven culture.
Be part of our data-community: Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations.
Support some of the following product & business team initiatives (not limited to):
You support your team in discovery of new product ideas, identifying user friction points, business opportunities and defining success metrics and targets.
Evaluate your teams’ continuous releases making sure they are delivering on business goals via experimental or observational methods.
Collaborate with UX researchers to combine qualitative and quantitative research for better product hypotheses.
During product development you make sure all data needed for future evaluation is being captured through set up of tracking events or as part of the backend service.
Design, conduct and analyze A/B tests
Drive the quantitative analysis on your segment, being responsible for the insights and business discovery on the team.

Background

What you need to be successful:

3+ years of experience, ideally within the Product or Analytics field.

Skills


Strong understanding of statistical methods used in the analysis of experimental and observational data
Strong problem solving skills and is comfortable doing exploratory data analysis that generates insights and “so whats”
Highly experienced with SQL and Python/R for analytics
Experience working with one or more common data visualisation tools (Tableau, Metabase, Looker, Superset, etc)
Good presentation skills and communication skills.
Experience with A/B Testing & Product Analytics
Having experience with cards y/or payments domains in high growth startups would be a big plus
Having experience in quantitative research would be a plus
Having experience in fintech would be a plus
Having experience with AI Analytics would be a plus

Devoteam es una consultora europea líder especializada en estrategia digital, plataformas tecnológicas, ciberseguridad y transformación empresarial a través de la tecnología.

La tecnología forma parte de nuestro ADN, y creemos que actúa como catalizador de un cambio positivo, al tiempo que mantenemos un equilibrio que nos permite ofrecer a nuestra cartera de clientes herramientas tecnológicas de primer nivel, pero siempre con el trato personalizado y la profesionalidad de un equipo que les acompaña en cada paso del camino.

Desde hace más de 30 años, Devoteam se ha comprometido a poner la tecnología al servicio de las personas. Contamos con más de 11 000 empleados en todo el grupo, repartidos por 25 países de Europa, Oriente Medio y África.

Job Description

Buscamos un/a Data Analyst Senior para incorporarse a un proyecto de larga duración (mínimo 2 años) en un importante cliente referente del Sector de las Telecomunicaciones.

En este rol serás el nexo entre la ingeniería de datos y el negocio, encargándote de estructurar grandes volúmenes de información en Google Cloud Platform, garantizar la calidad del dato y construir la capa semántica de visualización para la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Tus funciones principales:


Consultoría SQL & GCP: Realizar consultas complejas en BigQuery para extraer, limpiar y estructurar grandes datasets del sector telecom.
Capa Semántica y Visualización: Diseñar y mantener la capa semántica en Looker y construir dashboards interactivos e intuitivos en Looker Studio.
Modelado de Negocio & Forecast: Crear modelos analíticos y predicciones alimentados directamente desde BigQuery o Looker.
Optimización y Calidad del Dato: Definir y estructurar tablas optimizadas en BigQuery, asegurando la gobernanza, precisión e integridad de los datos consumidos en Looker o Excel.
Análisis Avanzado: Realizar manipulaciones de datos y análisis estadísticos apoyándote en Excel y consultas SQL avanzadas.
Experiencia: Mínimo 4-5 años trabajando como Data Analyst Senior o Analytics Engineer.
SQL & BigQuery: Dominio avanzado de SQL e historial trabajando con arquitecturas en BigQuery (GCP).
Ecosistema Looker: Experiencia sólida construyendo la capa semántica en Looker y diseñando cuadros de mando en Looker Studio.
Modelado: Habilidad demostrable en modelado de negocio, forecasting y manipulación avanzada en Excel.
Ubicación y Disponibilidad:
Residencia en Valencia: Modelo híbrido (2-3 días/semana en oficina).
Valorable: Experiencia previa previa dentro del sector de Telecomunicaciones.

Title: Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
It’s time for boarding! Join our team as a Data Analyst and play a key role in transforming data into meaningful insights that drive informed decision-making across the organization. You will help create transparency, improve processes, and support our digital transformation by developing reliable reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions while ensuring high data quality and consistency.




River Advice is the world’s leading independent manager of river vessels. Under the umbrella of UNITED WATERWAYS, the group—with over 4,000 employees—represents a fleet of more than 100 passenger and event vessels on Europe’s inland waterways. With a broad range of services—from shipowning, crew, nautical, and technical management to hospitality & catering, safety & security, ship financing, charter brokerage, insurance management, new-build and refit support, and ship ICT—we support our clients in all areas of passenger inland waterway shipping.




Your responsibilities:

Analyze, prepare, and interpret data from various business and IT systems to create meaningful insights and decision-making support
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and KPIs to support management and business departments
Translate business requirements into data-driven analyses, models, and actionable recommendations
Ensure high data quality through monitoring, validation, and continuous improvement of data structures and datasets
Identify and resolve data gaps, inconsistencies, and quality issues in collaboration with relevant teams
Support the implementation of data governance principles, standards, and responsible handling of sensitive data
Develop, optimize, and maintain business intelligence solutions, dashboards, and analytical views
Improve and automate reporting and analysis processes to increase efficiency and transparency
Collaborate with IT, business departments, and external partners to integrate data sources and enhance reporting capabilities




Your profile:

Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Administration, Finance, or a comparable qualification
Several years of experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, controlling, or a similar analytical role
Experience in developing dashboards, reports, KPIs, data models, and management analyses
Strong knowledge of data analysis, data preparation, visualization, reporting tools (e.g., Power BI), Microsoft Excel, SQL, and database concepts, Python and R
Experience in translating business requirements into reporting solutions and collaborating with business stakeholders, IT teams, and data owners
Knowledge of data quality, data governance, data protection, and confidentiality requirements
Business-fluent communication skills in English, German is a plus
Structured, accurate, and independent way of working with a strong attention to detail
Strong analytical and conceptual thinking with a passion for numbers, data, and process optimization
Ability to communicate complex data and insights clearly to different stakeholder groups
High sense of responsibility and reliability when handling confidential and sensitive information
Ability to manage multiple priorities, reporting requirements, and stakeholders in parallel
Interest in digital transformation, automation, business intelligence, and continuous improvement




What to expect at River Advice:

An interesting, varied, and independent role with a high degree of autonomy in a fascinating, dynamic industry
Long-term career opportunities within the UNITED WATERWAYS Group
A supportive, experienced team
A thorough introduction to the job




We offer you a thorough introduction to the role and a diverse range of responsibilities in a dynamic industry, office space in the beautiful city of Porto, long-term career development opportunities within the UNITED WATERWAYS Group, and a supportive, international, and experienced team at an expanding company.




Do you think you’re the person we’re looking for? If so, we look forward to having you join our team and help us navigate Europe’s waterways!




We look forward to receiving your complete application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Intro

Euronext is the leading pan-European exchange, connecting local economies to global markets. With a strong presence across Europe, Euronext offers a diverse range of services including trading, clearing, and listing.

By leveraging cutting-edge technology, Euronext ensures efficient and secure trading experiences for our clients by provides them a dynamic platform for trading equities, derivatives, commodities and more.

Data therefore plays a crucial role in our operations, driving informed decision-making to support our operations and enhance our services. Join us and be part of a team that is shaping the future of financial markets through innovation and data-driven insights.

Job Description

We are looking for a business Data Analyst to join our Statistics and Analytics team based in Porto.

As part of a team at the intersection of data and business, you will work with stakeholders across Euronext to turn data into actionable insights. You will help teams better understand market activity, customer behaviour and business performance, while contributing to innovative analytics solutions that support growth and operational excellence.

Leveraging Euronext's extensive market data assets and other internal data sources, you will conduct analysis, develop reporting solutions, and contribute to the delivery of value-added analytics services. You will combine a strong analytical mindset with a client-oriented approach to understand stakeholders' challenges and proactively propose data-driven solutions.

You will play an active role in the continuous improvement of our analytics ecosystem by automating processes, enhancing data self-service capabilities and exploring innovative ways to deliver insights through modern technologies, including AI-powered tools.

The role also includes responsibilities in key operational processes, notably supporting billing related activities, ensuring accuracy, reliability and appropriate controls in business-critical workflows.

How You'll Make An Impact


Deliver high-quality statistics, reports, analysis and bespoke studies that support business decisions across Euronext.
Transform complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for a variety of stakeholders.
Partner with business teams to understand their challenges and identify opportunities where data can create value.
Develop, maintain and improve dashboards, reporting solutions, and self-service analytics tools.
Support key business processes, including billing activities, ensuring robust controls and auditability.
Work with large and diverse datasets, including market and business data, to answer strategic and operational questions.
Explore and leverage AI-powered and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance analytics capabilities and develop innovative services.
Collaborate closely with fellow analysts to share knowledge, challenge assumptions and continuously raise the team's standards and impact.


Mindset & ways of working

You'll Thrive In This Role If You


Are genuinely curious and need understanding how businesses operate before acting.
Approach problems with an analytical and solution-oriented mindset.
Combine rigor, attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills and enjoy working with a variety of stakeholders.
Are proactive and comfortable challenging the status quo in a constructive way.
Have a strong sense of organization and can effectively prioritize competing demands.
Adapt quickly to changing priorities and remain effective under pressure.
Show enthusiasm for learning, innovation and the application of new technologies, including AI.


Technical Skills

You have strong hands-on experience with:


SQL
Python and Pandas data analytics library, including development environments such as Jupyter Notebooks or Visual Studio


The Following Would Be Considered An Advantage


Dataiku
Power BI
AI tools


Experience & Qualifications

We're looking for someone with:


3 to 5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence or a related field.
Proven experience partnering directly with business stakeholders and supporting decision-making through data-driven insights.
Experience working with financial data, ideally within financial services, capital markets or a comparable data-intensive environment.
Demonstrated ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience designing, developing or maintaining reporting solutions, dashboards and self-service analytics tools.
Experience working with large and diverse datasets while ensuring high standards of data quality and reliability.
Excellent written and spoken English. You'll be interacting daily with people from all over Europe.


Working With Us Means


A vibrant international and diverse team where you'll collaborate with a network of 2,200+ talents across Europe, USA and Asia.
A collaborative and inclusive work environment that fosters professional growth with flexible career paths, learning and development opportunities
An agile, innovative and dynamic company where you can make an impact
Wellbeing program, equal opportunities, work environment open to diversity in all its forms.


Apply by submitting a CV in English.

Unity


We respect and value the people we work with
We are unified through a common purpose
We embrace diversity and strive for inclusion


Integrity


We value transparency, communicate honestly and share information openly
We act with integrity in everything we do

We value the unique talents of all our people, who come from diverse backgrounds with different personal experiences and points of view and we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect.

Title: Data Analyst - Operations (m/f/d)
HTML:
Chemical Industry | Data Analyst – Operations


Your new Company


Elementis, a Global Specialty Chemicals company with a heritage dating back over 175 years, employs around 1 000 people and operates across multiple continents, serving customers worldwide. Specializing in advanced materials and formulation technologies, Elementis delivers high-performance solutions across personal care, coatings, and industrial and consumer applications.


Elementis’ diverse teams collaborate seamlessly across geographies and functions, combining scientific expertise with a strong culture of innovation, integrity, and sustainability to deliver outstanding value to their customers.


Your new Role


The Data Analyst – Operations transforms complex Datasets into clear, actionable insights that support decision making across the organization. Working within a Matrix structure and closely aligned with Supply Chain, Procurement, and Manufacturing functions, this person partners with business stakeholders to understand priorities, interpret operational Data, and deliver high-quality analysis, reporting, dashboards, and presentations.


This person reports to the Business Data Manager, and will collaborate closely with Operations stakeholders, Business Leaders, Technical Specialists, and Data Governance teams to support operational performance management, improve reporting capabilities, and strengthen Data-driven decision making across the business.


The Data Analyst – Operations will:

  • Partner with Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Logistics stakeholders to understand business priorities and deliver Data-driven insights that support operational and strategic decision-making;
  • Produce and support operational reporting and performance analysis across Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Inventory, and Demand Planning functions, identifying trends, risks, opportunities, and deviations from plan;
  • Support functional performance cycles (including manufacturing reviews, procurement analysis, demand consensus, supply reviews, OTIF, backorders, SLA performance, inventory reporting, and other business-critical reporting activities);
  • Manage operational Master Data, ensuring accurate creation, maintenance, validation, archiving, and compliance with Data governance standards across suppliers, raw materials, inventory, and Supply Chain Data;
  • Act as a subject matter expert for operational reporting tools and solutions (including OTIF reporting and Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations);
  • Perform analysis on suppliers, raw materials, production, transport, inventory, logistics, and Supply Chain alternatives to support business optimization and decision-making;
  • Support SKU lifecycle management, portfolio rationalization, and product deprecation activities in collaboration with Supply Chain and Strategic Marketing teams;
  • Promote self-service reporting capabilities through training, user support, and best-practice guidance while driving improvements in Data quality, analytical capabilities, reporting processes, and business tools;
  • Support operational projects and continuous improvement initiatives focused on process standardization, automation, inventory optimization, cost reduction, and operational efficiency.


A typical day will include analyzing operational performance, maintaining dashboards, producing manufacturing, procurement, and Supply Chain reports, supporting inventory and demand planning activities, validating Data quality, supporting operational users, and delivering insights that support key business decisions.


Please consider that this role requires availability for occasional travel to other company sites, approximately once per year.


What you will need to succeed


As a Data Analyst – Operations, you will need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Management, or another analytical or business-related field;
  • +3 years of experience within an International Manufacturing or Industrial environment;
  • +3 years of experience in analytical or support roles within Sales, Commercial, or related business functions;
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports, and Data visualizations that deliver actionable business insights;
  • Experience working within Matrix Organizations and collaborating with Cross-Functional Teams (would be a plus);
  • Experience supporting Manufacturing reporting, Procurement analysis, Supply Chain performance monitoring, logistics reporting, inventory management, and demand planning;
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills (including advanced Data collection, cleansing, validation, and reporting capabilities);
  • Advanced Excel skills (including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, advanced functions, and graphs);
  • Experience with project management tools;
  • Knowledge of Python, SQL, and SharePoint management (would be a plus);
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced international environment;
  • Excellent communication skills – Fluency in English.


What the Company can offer you


Have the opportunity to join a cross-functional team in an international company with a multicultural working environment!

Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.



Responsibilities



Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.



Education



Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.



Experience



Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.

Compliance

Governance, Risk and Control

Analytics and reporting

IT Tools and application

Cost and budget control

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Business Acumen

Contract Management

Management of change application

Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled professional to join our Squad Data RUN – Data Entreprise, dedicated to ensuring the achievement of business objectives and the effective management of daily operations, including incident resolution and necessary evolutions. This role is pivotal in supporting the transformation of our Data product and requires a strong technical background in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and data transformations tools (ETL/ELT).

Our team focuses on developing and maintaining internal corporate tools utilizing a robust technical stack that includes the BPCE SI cloud ecosystem, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Linux, Python, Power BI, Composer, and SSIS. We employ various methods and tools to enhance our workflow, including Jira and Confluence for project management, Clarity for resource planning, PowerDesigner and DataGalaxy for data modeling, and Dataplex for data management. Our testing processes are supported by Jira Xray, and we adhere to the Agile framework within the BPCE Tempo ecosystem to ensure efficient and adaptive project delivery.

Main Responsibilities


Integrate into the Performance and Run team, collaborating closely with BPCE-SI business units to guarantee the stability of existing systems.
Manage incidents effectively, ensuring minimal impact on operations while implementing necessary system evolutions.
Develop specific components in the context of construction projects, contributing to the overall enhancement of our data capabilities.
Employ Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly BigQuery and Composer, to optimize data management and analysis.
Utilize Power BI for reporting and visualization, alongside data integration tools such as SSIS to ensure seamless data flow.
Work under the supervision of a squad lead to ensure optimal coordination and successful project execution.
Engage in proactive communication with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into technical requirements.


Qualifications

Hard Skills:


Proficiency in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) with a strong understanding of data management and integration practices.
Expertise in Power BI and data integration tools such as SSIS.
Knowledge of programming languages, particularly Python and SQL, for data analysis and manipulation.
Experience working in Agile environments, including participation in daily stand-ups and iterative development practices.
French proficiency is mandatory (B2 level, minimum).


Soft Skills


Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with business units.
Demonstrated ability to understand and prioritize user requirements effectively.
Strong problem-solving skills for effective incident management and minimizing operational impact.
Proactive communication with business stakeholders to understand needs and translate them into technical requirements.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are committed to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Our presence in Portugal

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

Title: Data Analyst | Business Intelligence
HTML:
Procuramos um profissional com forte capacidade analítica, orientação para dados e interesse pelo negócio, capaz de transformar informação complexa em análises e soluções simples, fiáveis e acionáveis para suporte à tomada de decisão.



Missão

  • Analisar, transformar e disponibilizar informação de suporte à gestão e ao negócio de cobrança de portagens;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores, análises e soluções de Business Intelligence para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Contribuir para a automatização, melhoria contínua e evolução dos processos de tratamento, análise e reporting de dados.

Principais Atividades

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e soluções de análise de dados, nomeadamente em Power BI;
  • Recolha, tratamento, validação e análise de dados provenientes de diferentes fontes e sistemas;
  • Desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de KPIs e indicadores de desempenho do negócio de cobrança de portagens;
  • Realização de análises ad-hoc, estudos e exploração de dados para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de modelos de dados, métricas e soluções de reporting;
  • Identificação e implementação de oportunidades de automatização e optimização dos processos de tratamento e disponibilização de informação;
  • Análise de tendências, desvios e comportamentos, identificando insights e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e fiabilidade dos dados e da informação disponibilizada;
  • Colaboração com as áreas de negócio e equipas técnicas na definição de requisitos e desenvolvimento de soluções;
  • Contribuição para a evolução das ferramentas, processos e metodologias de Data & Analytics.


Principais Requisitos

  • Licenciatura em Engenharia, Gestão ou áreas equivalentes;
  • Experiência profissional mínima de 2 anos em Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting ou funções similares;
  • Bons conhecimentos de Microsoft Excel;
  • Bons conhecimentos de Power BI, Power Query e DAX;
  • Conhecimentos de SAP / SAP BW serão valorizados;
  • Conhecimentos de Python serão valorizados;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Rigor, sentido crítico e orientação para a qualidade;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipa;
  • Autonomia, capacidade de aprendizagem e interesse por novas tecnologias e ferramentas de dados.


Se estiver interessado/a nesta oportunidade e reunir as qualificações exigidas, poderá submeter a sua candidatura no nosso site Pessoas & Carreiras.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Mutual Respect, Empathy, Innovation, and Professional Pride. Do you see yourself within these values?




Founded in 2006 with the mission "To Challenge Complexity", Closer Consulting is a Data Science company specializing in Business Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence.

Developing projects in the most diverse industries – Banking, Telecommunications, Healthcare, Retail, Energy, Insurance, and Aviation, among others –, we have created an environment where the brightest enquiring minds feel at home, providing our people with the means, opportunities and support they need to thrive and innovate.




We seek a Senior Data Analyst willing to accept new challenges in our Closer team in a hybrid model (Porto):




🔹 Your main responsibilities:




Engineering & ETL: Develop, optimize, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, clean, and transform data from heterogeneous sources (databases, APIs, files, and cloud environments).
Modeling & Optimization: Model and optimize databases in SQL Server by writing complex queries, stored procedures, and efficient views to support business analytics.
Quality & Performance: Proactively ensure data integrity, consistency, and quality throughout the pipeline, guaranteeing high solution performance.
Governance & Documentation: Document business rules, transformations, and data validation criteria.
Business Alignment: Translate functional requirements and business needs into robust data models and clear KPIs.
Innovation & Cloud: Explore and implement modern data solutions using cloud ecosystems (Azure / Microsoft Fabric).




🔹 What We’re Looking For (Mandatory Requirements):




4 to 5 years of experience in similar roles.
Solid proficiency in SQL Server and SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services).
Proven experience with ETL processes and data warehouse architectures.
Knowledge and experience with Azure / Microsoft Fabric.
Strong ability to identify, diagnose, and resolve data issues and performance tuning.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact easily with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Problem-solving orientation and strong organizational skills.




🔹 We Also Value (Differentiating Factors):




Experience developing reports and dashboards in Power BI and knowledge of DAX.
Professional experience or knowledge in the automotive sector.
Good command of English (spoken and written).
Interest and curiosity in Artificial Intelligence applied to business.
Familiarity with collaborative work tools and version control: GitHub, Jira, and Confluence.




🔹 We believe we are the ones to, by:




Providing a multidisciplinary Team.
Giving a home office kit with everything you need to perform remotely.
Ensuring a career plan alongside professional growth.
Providing you with a custom training plan.
Helping you reach happiness.




🔹 Oh… and by the way, we also have:




Several challenging complex projects.
Stimulating teams and leaders.
World-class Clients and Partners.




If you believe in this match as much as we do, send us your CV to margarida.novais@closer.pt and reach the closer side of life.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
act digital is a multinational company present in 12 countries, which combines local agility and global expertise to act as a strategic partner for our clients in delivering customized and scalable solutions.

In Portugal, we have around 120 clients and a team of over 400 people, working on projects in sectors as diverse as Banking, Insurance, Transport, Aviation and Energy.




We are looking for a Financial Data Analyst to join an international team in the financial sector. The role involves managing and ensuring the quality of financial data, supporting business processes, and interacting with internal stakeholders and market data providers.

Manage workflows, third parties, and portfolios in the data repository, ensuring accuracy and compliance with client requests.
Collect and validate financial data from providers (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, Morning Star) and ensure timely availability for business applications.
Perform data quality and integrity controls, contributing to continuous improvement of processes and reporting.
Support stakeholders by delivering accurate reports and ensuring alignment with operational risk and regulatory frameworks.

Skills – Must Have:

Proven experience in data management (ideally financial/asset data).
Strong Excel skills.
Understanding of data quality control and related processes.
Professional level English (C1).

Skills – Nice to Have:

Experience with market data providers (Bloomberg, Reuters, Morning Star).
Knowledge of asset management / financial markets and Middle Office processes.
Familiarity with data-related regulatory frameworks and operational risk concepts.
Awareness of Agile culture.
French (B2)

Working model:

Hybrid working model (2 times per week at the office)
