Today, Sodexo is a global leader in Food and Services, supporting people at every moment of life, at work, in schools, hospitals and communities. With 426,000 colleagues across 43 countries, we serve 80 million consumers every day, generating €24.1 billion in revenues. Our growth goes hand in hand with social and environmental responsibility, driven by our purpose: to create a better everyday for everyone and build a better life for all.


About Sodexo Business Services (SBS)


Portugal is no exception! Eight years ago, we established Sodexo Business Services (SBS), our shared service center. Here, you will have the opportunity to join various Financial teams such as Record to Report, Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, Financial Analysis, and Master Data, supporting European markets and ensuring business growth.


Join Us!

We are looking for talented professionals to be part of our team, bringing unique skills and perspectives to help us grow even further.


Performance & Reporting Analyst


⚙What will you do?


  • Gather and consolidate data from multiple sources (e.g. ERP, ticketing tools, operational trackers) into a single source of truth.
  • Design, maintain and enhance performance dashboards, scorecards and KPI reports (SLA, OLA, productivity, quality, cost) via Power Bi Data visualization tool
  • Support Performance and service quality analysis in collaboration with Service Performance Leads.
  • Ensure data quality, consistency of definitions, and adherence to the approved KPI taxonomy.
  • Respond to ad-hoc analytics requests from Service Line leaders, Finance and Governance forums.
  • Document data processing decisions and summarize data quality in technical memos.
  • Continuously enhance technical skills and explore new technologies to stay current with industry advancements.


🤙 What you'll need to succeed?

  • 3+ years’ experience in data analytics or performance reporting in a services/GBS environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of Power BI, Excel - Power Query, experience with ERP or ticketing tools is required.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform - Fabric, Power Automate & Power Apps
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into data models and analytics solutions that deliver valued business insights.
  • Resourceful problem solver that demonstrates high learning agility and adaptability in fast-paced environments
  • Prior experience working in a data-driven environment and contributing to decision-making through analytics.
  • Fluent in English (French is a plus)


🎉 What we have to offer you?

  • Hybrid working model;
  • Flexible working hours;
  • Health & Life Insurance;
  • Meal allowance paid in Meal Card;
  • Additional Days off: extra vacation day, employee’s birthday, volunteering day;
  • Opportunity to grow professionally inside the Company;
  • Possibility to participate in multicultural projects;
  • Several internal activities aiming to promote our team´s wellbeing.


📩 Apply now! Send your CV to Recruitment.SBS.Portugal@sodexo.com with the job title in the subject line. Explore all our career opportunities here: Sodexo Careers.


Learn more about Sodexo: YouTube - Sodexo.


Diversity & Inclusion Statement


Sodexo is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit.


🔒 Data Privacy:


We respect your privacy. Your personal data will be used exclusively for recruitment purposes, processed under GDPR regulations, and treated confidentially. For further details, contact privacy.sbs@sodexo.com.

Title: Senior HR Data Analyst (f/m/div)
Description:
#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone’s life

Your steady execution, creative problem-solving, and commitment to quality create a foundation that allows innovation to happen and success to grow.

As a Senior HR Data Analyst in our Corporate Functions team, you ensure processes run efficiently, you bring clarity, and dependable support to the heart of the company.

Are you in?

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

As a Senior HR Data Analyst, you will support HR and business teams by developing and maintaining data solutions, ensuring high-quality HR data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Develop new self-service data solutions, such as Certified Data Sources, Dashboards, or List Reports
Own and handle existing solutions, namely by monitoring data quality, troubleshooting and bug-fixing, enhancing and maintaining features throughout life cycle
Enable and support end-users and proactively manage all involved stakeholders and relevant communication flows
Trend-scout and consult HR Business Partners, Process Owners, and Functions on HR data-related matters
Support HR and business in taking better, faster, fact-based decisions, further driving HR transformation


Your profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to engage and inspire others through data. You communicate complex topics in a simple and compelling way, partner effectively with stakeholders at all levels, and build trusted relationships through your professional judgment, credibility, and reliable approach.


A degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Information Technology, Data Science / Analytics or similar fields of studies
3-5 years of analytics working experience - previous experience in Human Resources is a plus
Strong stakeholder management, strong attention to detail, and a high degree of customer-orientation - preferably in global organizations
Excellent Business Intelligence (BI) software proficiency – preferably Tableau and/or Power Bi - covering both data flows and visualization
Analytical and conceptual skills, combined with hands-on spirit and an independent working style
Team player working with cross-functional colleagues from business over analytics to IT
Fluency in English (mandatory) – knowledge of German is an advantage


Please send us your CV in English.

Title: BI & Reporting Analyst
HTML:
AVELEDA | A Aveleda é uma empresa de vinhos com mais de 150 anos de história, afirmando-se como um dos maiores produtores e exportadores de vinhos em Portugal. Produz vinhos em 5 regiões: Douro, Vinhos Verdes, Bairrada, Lisboa e Algarve e está presente em mais de 80 países com marcas líder em vários mercados. No seu portfolio, encontram-se grandes marcas como Casal Garcia, Aveleda, Adega Velha, Quinta Vale D. Maria, Quinta D'Aguieira, Villa Alvor e Mandriola de Lisboa.

Para além do vinho, a Aveleda aposta no turismo, aproveitando o potencial da sua envolvente natural, da sua longa história e dos seus jardins e vinhas, um referencial do legado desta casa e desta família.


MISSÃO

Assegurar o desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de Business Intelligence, Reporting e integração de dados, transformando informação dispersa em conhecimento útil para o negócio, apoiando as diferentes áreas da empresa na tomada de decisão.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Integrar a equipa de IT – Suporte Aplicacional, colaborando no desenvolvimento de soluções de reporting e análise de informação;
  • Desenvolver, otimizar e manter o Data Warehouse e as soluções de Business Intelligence;
  • Desenvolver e manter relatórios de gestão e dashboards, garantindo informação fiável e acessível;
  • Trabalhar na extração, transformação e integração de dados provenientes de diferentes sistemas;
  • Analisar necessidades das áreas de negócio e propor soluções práticas, eficientes e inovadoras;
  • Participar em projetos de integração entre sistemas e automatização de processos;
  • Apoiar a evolução do ecossistema de dados e reporting da empresa.


QUEM PROCURAMOS?

  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano em funções semelhantes;
  • Formação superior em Informática, Engenharia Informática ou área similar;
  • Experiência profissional em funções de BI, Reporting, Desenvolvimento ou suporte aplicacional;
  • Bons conhecimentos de bases de dados, modelação de dados, SQL e algoritmia;
  • Conhecimentos de Excel Avançado e Power Query;
  • Conhecimentos de linguagens e tecnologias Web, nomeadamente: .NET, C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS e XML;
  • Gosto por programação, análise e resolução de problemas;
  • Conhecimentos de redes informáticas serão valorizados;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipa, comunicar com diferentes áreas e compreender as necessidades do negócio;
  • Perfil proativo, autónomo, curioso e orientado para a melhoria contínua.


IDENTIFICAÇÃO COM OS VALORES AVELEDA:

  • Ética | Excelência | Paixão


Aveleda, Onde os Sonhos se Cultivam.

Title: Data & Operations Performance Specialist
Description:
A VitalAire é uma empresa do Grupo Air Liquide com mais de 35 anos de experiência nos Cuidados Respiratórios Domiciliários em Portugal, especializada em tratamentos domiciliários de Oxigenoterapia, Ventiloterapia, Aerossolterapia e Aspiração de Secreções. A VitalAire trabalha diariamente em parceria com médicos e profissionais de saúde, cuidando de milhares de pacientes no seu domicílio e contribuindo para melhorar a sua qualidade de vida. A equipa VitalAire proporciona um serviço domiciliário de qualidade, reconhecido pelos seus pacientes e respetivos profissionais de saúde.




Sobre a Função




És apaixonado por dados, otimização de processos e melhoria contínua? Procuras transformar números em decisões estratégicas que fazem a diferença?

Nesta função, serás o motor analítico da operação. O seu papel principal será extrair, estruturar e analisar dados operacionais, desenvolvendo dashboards e mapas de gestão automatizados que ajudem as lideranças e a Direção a tomar as melhores decisões baseadas em factos fiáveis.




Principais Responsabilidades




Análise & Decisão: Extrair, estruturar e analisar bases de dados complexas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, desvios e otimizações operacionais.
Dashboards & Reporting: Criar e automatizar mapas de gestão e dashboards para acompanhamento da atividade no CareCenter e Operações.
Melhoria Contínua: Colaborar diretamente com as equipas de Operational Excellence, fornecendo dados estruturados e acompanhando os planos de ação.
Data Quality: Auditar e validar rigorosamente a informação nos sistemas internos (ex.: SAP) para garantir integridade e precisão.
Suporte Administrativo e Operacional: Apoiar na gestão de requisições de compra, seguimento de encomendas/fornecedores e comunicações estratégicas a pacientes.




Perfil:




Formação Académica: Licenciatura em Gestão, Economia, Engenharia, Data Analytics, Informática de Gestão ou área equivalente com forte vertente quantitativa.

Soft Skills: Forte espírito de equipa, facilidade de relacionamento interpessoal e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo. Raciocínio lógico-matemático, elevada capacidade analítica, rigor metódico, proatividade e um mindset orientado para a automação e resolução de problemas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos: Domínio de ferramentas como Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI e sistemas ERP/CRM (ex.: SAP, Salesforce).

Línguas: Português e Inglês fluente.




As nossas Diferenças fazem a nossa Performance




Na Air Liquide temos o compromisso de construir um local de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo que abrace a diversidade dos nossos colaboradores, clientes, pacientes, partes interessadas da comunidade e culturas em todo o mundo.

Acolhemos e consideramos as inscrições de todos os candidatos qualificados, independentemente de sua formação. Acreditamos firmemente que uma organização diversa abre oportunidades para as pessoas expressarem o seu talento, tanto individual como coletivamente, e ajuda a promover a nossa capacidade de inovar vivendo os nossos valores, agindo para o nosso sucesso e criando um ambiente envolvente num mundo em mudança.

Title: Sr Specialist GPS DPM & Solutions
Description:
Who Are We

adidas Porto provides globally unified services to adidas employees, consumers and other users, based on standardized and automated solutions across different functions and markets. We leverage state of the art technology and encourage a human-centric and innovative mindset to continually raise the bar of the user experience. This is enabling us to drive operational efficiency, improved agility and better decision-making whilst reducing complexity in adidas.

Our mandate is to be the foundation for an agile and efficient company. This is our role to support adidas mission of being the best sports brand in the world.

We embrace diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and seek to create a workforce which reflects our consumers and communities. We champion individual uniqueness and cultivate a culture of belonging, so that everyone can create at their best.

Purpose & Overall Relevance For The Organization

The Global Product Supply Digital Process Management & Solutions reporting team is looking for a Senior Specialist Reporting Analytics to support the development and delivery of operational reporting solutions, analyze reporting issues, and contribute to self-service analytics through Power BI. The role combines hands-on reporting development, data analysis, problem solving, and stakeholder support. Working within established reporting processes and data products, the role collaborates with business users and central Supply Chain Management analytics teams to deliver reliable and effective reporting solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain operational Power BI reports and dashboards using existing data products, semantic models, and SQL queries against Databricks tables and views.
Support business stakeholders in gathering and clarifying reporting requirements and contribute to the translation of defined business needs into practical reporting and analytics solutions, with guidance from more senior team members for complex or ambiguous requirements.
Analyze and troubleshoot reporting and data issues, perform initial root cause analysis, and resolve issues within own area of support, seeking guidance or escalating more complex issues as appropriate.
Support the intake and coordination of reporting requests by gathering relevant information, clarifying requirements, and tracking progress in collaboration with more senior team members.
Provide support to Power Users and business users on Power BI reports, data interpretation, and established reporting practices, helping to promote self-service analytics.
Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting solutions, data quality, report performance, and Power BI development standards across Supply Planning operational teams.
Support user acceptance testing (UAT), including test execution, issue documentation, and coordination of feedback.


Key Relationships


Global Supply Planning
Global Sourcing
Global Tech, Global Data Domain
Supply Chain Intelligence
Market SCM


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Power BI Development: Practical experience developing and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards.
Data & Technical Skills: Basic SQL skills with the ability to query, analyze, and validate data from Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms. Ability to investigate data and reporting issues and identify potential causes.
Business Analysis: Ability to understand business requirements and processes and translate them into clear reporting requirements and practical solutions, with support where requirements are complex or ambiguous.
Problem Solving: Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues systematically, resolve straightforward problems independently, and know when to seek support or escalate.
Stakeholder Engagement: Good communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and technical teams. Able to explain reporting and data topics clearly to non-technical users.
Collaboration & Delivery: Experience working in cross-functional teams and contributing to the delivery of reporting enhancements. Ability to support UAT, document issues, and follow established delivery processes.
Organisation & Adaptability: Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities, work independently on defined activities, and deliver high-quality outcomes while following established processes, standards, and development practices.
Fluent in English (written & spoken)


Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications


Four-year degree from college or university required with emphasis in Supply Chain Management, Business analytics, Business administration or Information Systems preferred.
2+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including DAX.
Basic to intermediate experience writing SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from enterprise data platforms (e.g., Databricks).
Understanding of supply chain planning processes and ERP systems (e.g., SAP or SAP IBP) is preffered.

Title: Merchandising & Retail Performance Analyst
Description:
Sobre o Darvvin Group

O Darvvin Group desenvolve negócios nas áreas de retalho de moda, marcas próprias e consultoria. Através de conceitos como The Feeting Room e Labels of Tomorrow, reúne marcas independentes e contemporâneas, combinando uma seleção de produto diferenciadora com uma abordagem focada na inovação e no desempenho comercial.




A oportunidade

Procuramos um(a) Merchandising & Retail Performance Analyst com forte capacidade analítica, pensamento estratégico e sentido comercial. A sua missão será transformar dados de vendas, inventário e performance em insights e recomendações que permitam à equipa de Buying tomar melhores decisões sobre assortments, quantidades, alocação, reposição e estratégias de produto.

O objetivo é garantir o produto certo, na quantidade certa, no canal certo e no momento certo, maximizando vendas, margem e produtividade do inventário.


Principais responsabilidades
Análise de performance e inteligência comercial
Analisar resultados por loja, canal, marca, categoria, coleção e SKU, identificando tendências, oportunidades e riscos.
Acompanhar indicadores como sell-through, rotação e cobertura de stock, ruturas, margem bruta, vendas a preço integral e produtividade do inventário.
Produzir análises regulares, dashboards e recomendações claras e acionáveis para as equipas de Buying e Gestão.

2. Suporte estratégico ao Buying e planeamento de produto

Apoiar decisões de compra com base em histórico, comportamento da procura, performance de marcas e projeções de venda.
Recomendar melhorias de sortido, profundidade de compra, reposição, transferências e estratégias de markdown.
Avaliar desempenho de marcas e fornecedores, antecipar desvios face aos objetivos e acompanhar o efeito das decisões implementadas.

3. Otimização de inventário omnicanal

Avaliar a distribuição de stock entre diferentes lojas e canais e propor alocações que maximizem disponibilidade e rentabilidade.
Identificar excesso de stock, slow movers e oportunidades de redistribuição, equilibrando nível de serviço e capital investido.
Trabalhar em articulação com Operações para assegurar a implementação e a medição das recomendações.

4. Business intelligence e melhoria contínua

Desenvolver ferramentas de reporting e garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados de vendas e inventário.
Colaborar com as equipas de tecnologia em iniciativas de forecasting, automação e otimização de inventário.
Aplicar pensamento crítico e análise de cenários à identificação de oportunidades de melhoria comercial.

Perfil pretendido
Formação superior em Gestão, Economia, Engenharia, Business Analytics ou área quantitativa relevante.
3 a 5 anos de experiência em análise de negócio, planeamento comercial, merchandising, gestão de inventário ou funções analíticas comparáveis.

A oportunidade

Procuramos um(a) Merchandising & Retail Performance Analyst com forte capacidade analítica, pensamento estratégico e sentido comercial. A sua missão será transformar dados de vendas, inventário e performance em insights e recomendações que permitam à equipa de Buying tomar melhores decisões sobre assortments, quantidades, alocação, reposição e estratégias de produto.

O objetivo é garantir o produto certo, na quantidade certa, no canal certo e no momento certo, maximizando vendas, margem e produtividade do inventário.

  1. Análise de performance e inteligência comercial
  • Analisar resultados por loja, canal, marca, categoria, coleção e SKU, identificando tendências, oportunidades e riscos.
  • Acompanhar indicadores como sell-through, rotação e cobertura de stock, ruturas, margem bruta, vendas a preço integral e produtividade do inventário.

  • Apoiar decisões de compra com base em histórico, comportamento da procura, performance de marcas e projeções de venda.

Business Analyst | E-Commerce




A Parfois procura um Business Analyst para integrar a equipa de Analytics & Strategy do E-Commerce. A função tem como objetivo apoiar as decisões de negócio do canal online através da análise: perceber o que está a acontecer, porquê, e o que fazer a seguir.

É uma função com contacto com diferentes áreas do E-Commerce, das vendas ao investimento em média e ao planeamento.

Procuramos alguém com raciocínio rápido, sentido crítico e que não aceita um número sem perceber de onde vem.




Principais responsabilidades

· Desenvolver análises de apoio à tomada de decisão no E-Commerce, com recomendações claras para as equipas de negócio.

· Analisar a performance dos diferentes canais de aquisição e retenção (paid media, orgânico, CRM, marketplaces) e o seu contributo para as vendas.

· Apoiar a equipa de Paid Media com simulações de investimento, cenários de realocação entre mercados e canais, e estudos de elasticidade (quanto cresce a venda quando o investimento aumenta).

Title: Global People Analytics Specialist
Description:
COFCO International is a global agri-business with a clear vision, strong values and a positive culture, focused on being a leader in the global grains, oilseeds and sugar supply chains. We provide the food the world needs in a responsible way. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we are ambitious, with the right structures and culture to meet the world's increasing and changing needs. With 12,000+ people in 35 countries, our global portfolio includes assets across the Americas, Europe, Africa, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We trade with over 50 nations, while providing farmers unique direct access to the growing Chinese market.

You will support to drive the evolution of global People Analytics capabilities through the design of scalable analytics products, advanced workforce and compensation analytics, and predictive insights that enable proactive business decisions. Championing the globalization and standardization of people processes, methodologies, and reporting frameworks, ensuring consistent, data-driven decision-making, operational excellence, and strategic workforce outcomes across the organization.

Responsibilities

People Analytics & Workforce Insights


Develop and maintain global people analytics dashboards, reports, and KPIs to provide actionable workforce insights.
Analyze workforce trends, including headcount, turnover, hiring, talent movement, diversity, and organizational effectiveness.
Translate complex people data into meaningful recommendations that support HR and business decision-making.
Deliver executive-level reporting and presentations for senior leadership and key stakeholders.


Compensation Planning & Analytics


Support global compensation planning processes through data analysis, modeling, and reporting.
Provide insights on compensation trends, salary positioning, pay equity, and workforce cost management.
Develop analytics and reporting frameworks to support annual compensation reviews and reward-related decisions.


Technology, Automation & Data Governance


Leverage HR technologies, analytics tools, and automation solutions to improve reporting efficiency and user experience.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance through strong governance practices and controls.
Collaborate with HRIS and technology teams to optimize data structures, reporting capabilities, and system performance.
Drive the standardization and globalization of people analytics, workforce planning, and compensation planning processes across the organization.


What does it take to be successfull in this role:


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Human Resources, Business Administration, Statistics, Finance, or a related field.
Advanced certification in People Analytics or Workforce Planning is a plus.
3+ years of experience in HR analytics, workforce planning, or compensation analysis.
Strong knowledge of HR data visualization tools (Power BI, SAC for Planning, SAP SuccessFactors People Analytics).
Data Analytics & Visualization: Ability to develop HR dashboards and reports for decision-making.
Technology Proficiency: Experience using SAP SuccessFactors, SAC for Planning, and Power BI.
Problem-Solving & Initiative: Ability to analyze complex HR data and provide insights.
Stakeholder Communication: Ability to collaborate with HR, Finance, and IT teams.
Process Improvement Focus: Experience in automating HR analytics and workforce planning.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and data integrity.
HR Data Governance & Compliance: Ensuring data accuracy and regulatory adherence.
Predictive Analytics & Workforce Insights: Using data-driven methods to anticipate workforce trends.


COFCO International is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice to know how COFCO collects and processes your personal data during your job application.

Quanteam, founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, is a consulting firm specialized in Banking and Financial Services. With more than 1200 consultants across 10 countries, we combine business and IT expertise to support leading institutions in transformation projects.

Profile raw data to understand its structure, identify business rules, and detect anomalies.

Title: Data Engineer & Analyst
Description:
Snapshot of your day

At Siemens Energy, we are building the next-generation HR Data Platform - a global foundation for data consolidation, governance, and analytics. We are looking for a hybrid Data Engineer & Analyst who can bridge the gap between raw data infrastructure and business intelligence.

In this role, you will own the full data lifecycle: from maintaining the consolidation layer and pipelines of our HR Data Hub to designing the final reporting solutions that empower strategic workforce decisions. You will ensure our data is not only technically sound but also accessible and insightful for business stakeholders.

How You’ll Make a Difference


Data Pipeline & Transformation Management: Design and maintain the transformation layer (using dbt and SQL) for the Internal Platform, ensuring raw data is effectively consolidated and modeled for downstream use
Analytics & Dashboarding: Develop and optimize dashboards (PowerBI) to provide key insights for HR and Operations units, directly supporting strategic business decisions
Data Quality & Governance: Act as a guardian for data integrity by implementing governance practices and monitoring data quality patterns to find and fix common issues in structured and unstructured data
Legacy Migration & Optimization: Lead or support migration projects to move legacy data pipelines to modern cloud infrastructure, aiming to eliminate technical debt, reduce costs, and restore stakeholder trust
Process Automation: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive data processing and reporting tasks (using Python or SQL procedures), reducing manual handling time for the HR team
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Establish clear documentation for data models and processes, creating a central knowledge base to ensure continuity and team alignment



What You Bring


Hybrid Experience: Proven cross-industry experience acting as both a Data Engineer and Data Analyst, with the ability to navigate complex pipelines and deliver business-facing insights
Core Engineering Stack: Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and Python for data manipulation, along with experience in modern Data Warehousing (Snowflake)
Transformation & Visualization: Proficiency with dbt for data transformation and major visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar)
Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to troubleshooting, with experience in navigating complex or legacy data environments and driving infrastructure improvements
Communication: Fluent in English (C2 level preferred) with the ability to translate technical data concepts into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders
Education: Background in Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field



About The Team

You will be working within the Human Resources function – People Systems and Services, a truly global and diverse team of specialists with an open mindset, responsible for guaranteeing operational performance and budget alignment of HR Systems & Services, ensuring, and maintaining fit-for-purpose HR systems and processes, safeguarding end-to-end delivery while promoting Siemens Energy digital transformation. You will get all the trust and empowerment to be successful.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits


Competitive salary and meal allowance
Fair compensation for international work
Health insurance coverage
Remote work permitted within the country
Additional 5 “Pontes” days off and Birthday off if it falls on a weekday, when not abroad (only applies for Portugal)
Among others



https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

Title: Product Analytics Team Lead
Description:
HEY THERE

You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.

Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.

You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:


Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next
Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on
Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up
Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it
Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before
Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool
Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions


YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:


You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course
You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself
Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways
You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through
You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data
When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it


Bonus points for:


Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)
A strong statistics background
Dagster or Airflow for scheduling
Data catalogues like DataHub


OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we run in production:


Warehouse: Snowflake
Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster
Experimentation: GrowthBook
Self-service analytics: Omni
ML workflows: Prefect
GenAI: Claude


If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.

WHY US?


An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating
A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year
30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you
A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!
A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement
A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks
Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development
A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:


Your CV in English
Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

Set and maintain standards for CRM usage, pipeline management, data quality, commercial reporting and recurring operational processes.

Monitor process effectiveness and data quality, and flag recurring issues or operational risks that affect commercial visibility or execution.




Operations and continuous improvement

Design and drive improvements to commercial processes, dashboards, workflows, templates, controls and ways of working.
Lead the implementation and adoption of significant changes to commercial systems, tools and processes.
Coordinate with internal teams and other support functions to keep commercial operations running smoothly.
Identify gaps in systems, process, capability or resources, and define the improvement, investment, recruitment or development actions needed.




Team leadership

Lead the Commercial Analytics and Operations team and be accountable for its people, performance and delivery.
Turn Business Development and company priorities into operational plans, team objectives, reporting requirements and expected outcomes.
Allocate and rebalance workload across recurring operations, reporting cycles, system activities and improvement initiatives.

Promote operational discipline, accountability, knowledge sharing and consistent use of commercial systems and processes.

7+ years of professional experience in Commercial Operations, Analytics, CRM with a solid grasp of pipeline management, CRM governance, commercial reporting, analytics and data quality.

A degree in business, analytics, economics, life sciences or a related field, or equivalent professional experience in commercial operations or business analytics.
Analytical capability to interpret commercial data, spot trends and turn them into actionable insight.
Ability to lead complex analysis while keeping effective oversight of operational delivery.
Working knowledge of CRM systems, spreadsheets, databases, reporting tools and other commercial systems.
Ability to build clear, concise executive presentations in PowerPoint that turn complex commercial data into a compelling narrative for senior leadership.
Process design and continuous improvement skills.
People leadership and a track record of developing others.
Planning and resource management across competing priorities, reporting cycles and improvement initiatives.
Sound judgement and problem solving across complex systems, process, reporting and data matters.
Strong stakeholder management across Business Development and other internal functions.
Good understanding of FJBio services and the biotechnology services environment.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Experience with HubSpot and PowerBI.




Travel Requirements

Travel may be required for client meetings, relationship reviews, governance interactions, stakeholder engagement, business development activities or company meetings.




We Offer

Integration in a highly motivated team
Working in an international environment
Employee benefits package
Career development

Title: AI FinOps & Platform Cost Analyst [F/M/X]
Description:
Job Description

As part of Mantu’s continued growth and digital transformation, we are looking for an AI FinOps & Platform Cost Analyst to join our IT team.

Reporting to the Data & AI Manager, you will help establish and operate Mantu’s AI FinOps capability. Your role will sit at the intersection of IT operations, data analytics, AI platform management, and financial governance.

You will provide visibility into AI and LLM consumption, build the data foundations and dashboards required to monitor usage and costs, and help the organisation optimise the performance, scalability, and commercial value of its AI platforms.

You will work closely with the Data & AI, IT, Finance, Procurement, Security, and business teams to ensure that AI services are used efficiently, sustainably, and in line with Mantu’s technical and commercial objectives.

Your missions



Build dashboard-level visibility into AI platform spend (e.g., Dust, Claude), identifying which agents and use cases drive costs
Develop predictive consumption models that go beyond linear extrapolation, enabling accurate forecasting of AI/LLM costs
Report monthly on cost, consumption trends, and risk exposure to relevant stakeholders
Identify and shift workloads off premium models where not justified, optimizing spend by aligning tasks with appropriate model tiers
Track model pricing evolution and reassess cost/quality tradeoffs as new models are released
Monitor consumption against contracted thresholds and flag commercial risks proactively
Support contract negotiation and renewal discussions with AI platform vendors in collaboration with Procurement and the AI team
Build and continuously refine Mantu’s AI cost model, incorporating external advisory input and documenting methodology for future client-facing offers[doc1]



Your profile

You have a strong interest in the intersection of IT, data, artificial intelligence, cloud platforms, and cost optimisation. You are comfortable working with technical teams and translating complex usage data into clear recommendations for business and financial stakeholders.



Experience in IT, data analytics, cloud operations, platform engineering, FinOps, or AI operations.
Experience with modeling, Python or SQL for data extraction, and generative AI tools
Academic background: Master’s degree in management, engineering, or a related field
English fluent. French is a plus.
Experience with cloud or SaaS FinOps practices
Experience building and maintaining cost dashboards or models
Familiarity with AI/LLM commercial models, including token or credit-based pricing, tiered contracts, and overage rates
You demonstrate the ability to build and defend cost/value models to non-technical stakeholders
You demonstrate comfort working with high-variance, unpredictable cost data and understanding of budget and vendor contracts
You demonstrate strong analytical and communication skills, and the ability to translate technical usage into actionable cost insights



Remuneration

Gross Annual Salary (GAS): EUR 22,000 - EUR 40,000 (basic salary only, the variable component will be detailed in the offer)

What We Offer



An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities
An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities
A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules
A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)
At Mantu, sustainability is part of everything we do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and make a tangible impact. Every day, our teams bring our ESG commitments to life, from reducing our footprint to driving positive change within our communities. Through our WeCare Together program, you’ll be empowered to design and lead projects that create real social or environmental impact, with the company’s full support.



Mantu is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics

Who are we?

Mantu is an independent international consulting player, founded in 2007. Bringing together expert and complementary brands, Mantu stands out for the breadth of its spectrum, responding to all business transformation challenges.

Its activities are divided into four practices:

Leadership & Advocacy, Technology, Brand Strategy & Experiences and Total Talent Management.

A wide range of skills, all serving a single mission: connecting and powering companies with leading teams and technology to succeed faster and sustainably. 

From its headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland, Mantu relies on a community of 12,000 talented people in more than 60 countries on 5 continents and has a turnover of 1billion euros.

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



The HR Reporting and Analytics Manager is responsible for managing HR data and analytics to deliver actionable insights that support strategic business decisions.
This role ensures the accuracy, security, and accessibility of HR data across systems, collaborates with key stakeholders to align reporting capabilities with business needs, and drives continuous improvement in data reporting, visualization, and analytics.



Responsibilities



Oversee the collection, organization, and validation of HR data across multiple platforms to ensure accuracy and integrity. Develop and maintain HR dashboards, reports, and analytics tools that provide high-quality, actionable insights to support decision-making at all levels.
Partner with HR leadership and the HRIS team to align reporting and analytics strategies with broader HR and business goals, ensuring that reporting capabilities meet evolving organizational needs and support workforce planning, performance metrics, and other strategic initiatives.
Work closely with IT, Digital, and HR teams to enhance data integration, improve reporting processes, and ensure data accessibility. Act as the primary liaison for data analytics-related initiatives, promoting a data-driven culture within HR.
Identify and implement improvements to reporting and analytics processes, leveraging new tools, technology, and best practices to enhance data-driven decision-making across HR functions. Drive the adoption of advanced analytics techniques to anticipate trends and support predictive insights.
Ensure all HR data management and reporting practices adhere to internal governance standards, regulatory requirements, and data privacy regulations, and other applicable laws.
Lead and mentor HR Reporting and Analytics team, ensuring effective task assignment, skills development and alignment with team and business goals. Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and professional growth within the team.



Education



Bachelor’s degree in HR, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.



Experience



Proven experience in HR reporting, data analytics, and data management within a corporate environment.
Strong knowledge of HR systems (such as SAP SuccessFactors), data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and data governance practices.
Demonstrated ability to interpret complex data, communicate insights effectively, and align reporting strategies with business objectives.
Excellent leadership and project management skills, with a focus on driving results and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Tools and data governance

Compliance

Analytics and reporting

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Data Management

HR Acumen

Risk Management

Innovation

Title: Analytics Engineer Mid
Description:
As a Mid-Level Analytics Engineer, you will support the development of Körber’s marketing analytics and reporting capabilities in a modern, AI-driven environment. Working closely with the data team, you will complete defined tasks in Databricks, contribute to AI agents that let users ask natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, and support selected reporting work in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric when needed. The role combines hands-on implementation with ad hoc analysis. You will need to understand relevant business logic so that your work is accurate, useful, and aligned with the intended reporting outcome. Our technology environment includes Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, AI/ML services, and a central data lake.

Your role in our team


Implement SQL queries, data models, and reporting components in Databricks based on defined requirements.
Contribute to AI agents for natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, including prompt design, retrieval, testing, and evaluation.
Perform ad hoc analyses and data checks, applying relevant business logic and documenting assumptions and results.
Support the migration of selected reporting use cases from Power BI to Databricks and occasionally maintain or enhance reports in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric.
Identify data quality issues, follow team standards for documentation and development, and collaborate with the data team to resolve open questions.


Your profile


Practical experience with SQL and Databricks or a similar cloud data platform.
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, agent evaluation, or similar AI application patterns.
Genuine interest in AI, with the motivation to learn, experiment, and develop further in AI-assisted analytics.
Understanding of data analysis fundamentals and the ability to apply business logic to marketing, website, campaign, or CRM data.
Familiarity with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, including reports, datasets, or data models, to support occasional reporting tasks.
Reliable and collaborative working style, with the ability to complete assigned tasks, ask effective questions, and communicate clearly within the data team.


We offer you


Possibility of Working from Home – we care about results not locations;
Training Budget for each employee – we care about the growth of our people;
Private Health Insurance – we care about health on and off working hours;
3 Additional Vacation Days – we care about free time;
Fresh fruits – we care about your daily dose of vitamins;
Fresh coffee, tea or water – we care about boosting your day.
A home for passionate people who innovate, collaborate and love what they do;
An environment where the team thinks and acts entrepreneurial;
An international and dynamic working atmosphere with cross-functional teams;
The opportunity to take more responsibility and develop your career.

Description:
Job Posting Title

Master Data Analyst

Legal Entity

GKN Automotive Portugal Limitada (Portugal)

Job Description Summary

This role will be responsible for the setup, administration and maintenance of master data records utilised across the business processes. They will manage Master Data processes relevant to the Finance, Procurement and Sales workstreams. Furthermore, they follow the department standards and documentation to ensure the desired level of data quality.

Job Description

Join Our Team as a Master Data Analyst

Location: Porto – Hipercentro Areosa Business Park

Work model: Hybrid (3 days/week in office)

About Dauch (GKN Automotive)

GKN Automotive is a world-leading global automotive technology company at the forefront of innovation. Its origins date back to 1759 and for the last 70 years it has been putting key technologies into series production.

We are the trusted partner for most of the world’s automotive companies, specializing in developing, building, and supplying market-leading drive systems and advanced ePowertrain technologies.

GKN Automotive is part of Dauch Corporation, a global leader in conventional, all-wheel, and electrified driveline systems. We design, develop, and manufacture advanced technologies for over 90% of the world’s car manufacturers, driving innovation and performance across the mobility sector.

What You’ll Do


Ensure adherence to Data Governance standards and naming conventions.
Manage Supplier, Customer and Finance Master Data.
Support business consistency by following group guidelines and MDM quality standards.
Ensure highest degree of data quality (e.g., identify mismatches, eliminate duplicates).
Maintain and administer master records used across business processes:
Supplier Master Data: Creation, changes, inactivation/blocking/activation across purchasing tools, ERPs, and related applications.
Customer Master Data: Creation, changes, inactivation/activation.
Finance Master Data: Maintain Chart of Accounts, Cost centers, Project data.

Required Skills And Education


Bachelor's degree (Management, Economics and Finance preferred but not mandatory)
Working with ERPs (preferred)
Analytical Processes
Attention to Detail
Language Skills (English)
Multi-tasking
Prioritizing
Teamwork


About Dauch

Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries - GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward. Maintain and improve data applications that optimize various business processes

Ensure data quality, reliability, and freshness through testing, monitoring, and validation
Design and maintain standardized business metrics and KPIs to analyze trends, identify issues, and measure performance across key company activities
Optimize data warehouse pipelines and processes to efficiently handle large-scale datasets for a product used by 2+ billion users worldwide

University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience with a strong data focus

Hands-on experience delivering data handling and analysis projects
Familiarity with modern software engineering practices applied to data, including testing, modularity, and code reviews
Strong problem-solving skills and high motivation to tackle complex challenges collaboratively
Ability to communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders
Fluency in English with strong communication skills

Hands-on experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks

Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or Tableau
Experience working with version control systems like Git

Title: Sr Specialist GPS DPM & Solutions
Description:
Who Are We

adidas Porto provides globally unified services to adidas employees, consumers and other users, based on standardized and automated solutions across different functions and markets. We leverage state of the art technology and encourage a human-centric and innovative mindset to continually raise the bar of the user experience. This is enabling us to drive operational efficiency, improved agility and better decision-making whilst reducing complexity in adidas.

Our mandate is to be the foundation for an agile and efficient company. This is our role to support adidas mission of being the best sports brand in the world.

We embrace diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and seek to create a workforce which reflects our consumers and communities. We champion individual uniqueness and cultivate a culture of belonging, so that everyone can create at their best.

Purpose & Overall Relevance For The Organization

The Global Product Supply Digital Process Management & Solutions reporting team is looking for a Senior Specialist Reporting Analytics to support the development and delivery of operational reporting solutions, analyze reporting issues, and contribute to self-service analytics through Power BI. The role combines hands-on reporting development, data analysis, problem solving, and stakeholder support. Working within established reporting processes and data products, the role collaborates with business users and central Supply Chain Management analytics teams to deliver reliable and effective reporting solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain operational Power BI reports and dashboards using existing data products, semantic models, and SQL queries against Databricks tables and views.
Support business stakeholders in gathering and clarifying reporting requirements and contribute to the translation of defined business needs into practical reporting and analytics solutions, with guidance from more senior team members for complex or ambiguous requirements.
Analyze and troubleshoot reporting and data issues, perform initial root cause analysis, and resolve issues within own area of support, seeking guidance or escalating more complex issues as appropriate.
Support the intake and coordination of reporting requests by gathering relevant information, clarifying requirements, and tracking progress in collaboration with more senior team members.
Provide support to Power Users and business users on Power BI reports, data interpretation, and established reporting practices, helping to promote self-service analytics.
Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting solutions, data quality, report performance, and Power BI development standards across Supply Planning operational teams.
Support user acceptance testing (UAT), including test execution, issue documentation, and coordination of feedback.


Key Relationships


Global Supply Planning
Global Sourcing
Global Tech, Global Data Domain
Supply Chain Intelligence
Market SCM


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Power BI Development: Practical experience developing and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards.
Data & Technical Skills: Basic SQL skills with the ability to query, analyze, and validate data from Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms. Ability to investigate data and reporting issues and identify potential causes.
Business Analysis: Ability to understand business requirements and processes and translate them into clear reporting requirements and practical solutions, with support where requirements are complex or ambiguous.
Problem Solving: Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues systematically, resolve straightforward problems independently, and know when to seek support or escalate.
Stakeholder Engagement: Good communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and technical teams. Able to explain reporting and data topics clearly to non-technical users.
Collaboration & Delivery: Experience working in cross-functional teams and contributing to the delivery of reporting enhancements. Ability to support UAT, document issues, and follow established delivery processes.
Organisation & Adaptability: Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities, work independently on defined activities, and deliver high-quality outcomes while following established processes, standards, and development practices.
Fluent in English (written & spoken)


Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications


Four-year degree from college or university required with emphasis in Supply Chain Management, Business analytics, Business administration or Information Systems preferred.
2+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including DAX.
Basic to intermediate experience writing SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from enterprise data platforms (e.g., Databricks).
Understanding of supply chain planning processes and ERP systems (e.g., SAP or SAP IBP) is preffered.

Title: Merchandising & Retail Performance Analyst
Description:
Sobre o Darvvin Group

O Darvvin Group desenvolve negócios nas áreas de retalho de moda, marcas próprias e consultoria. Através de conceitos como The Feeting Room e Labels of Tomorrow, reúne marcas independentes e contemporâneas, combinando uma seleção de produto diferenciadora com uma abordagem focada na inovação e no desempenho comercial.




A oportunidade

Procuramos um(a) Merchandising & Retail Performance Analyst com forte capacidade analítica, pensamento estratégico e sentido comercial. A sua missão será transformar dados de vendas, inventário e performance em insights e recomendações que permitam à equipa de Buying tomar melhores decisões sobre assortments, quantidades, alocação, reposição e estratégias de produto.

O objetivo é garantir o produto certo, na quantidade certa, no canal certo e no momento certo, maximizando vendas, margem e produtividade do inventário.


Principais responsabilidades
Análise de performance e inteligência comercial
Analisar resultados por loja, canal, marca, categoria, coleção e SKU, identificando tendências, oportunidades e riscos.
Acompanhar indicadores como sell-through, rotação e cobertura de stock, ruturas, margem bruta, vendas a preço integral e produtividade do inventário.
Produzir análises regulares, dashboards e recomendações claras e acionáveis para as equipas de Buying e Gestão.

2. Suporte estratégico ao Buying e planeamento de produto

Apoiar decisões de compra com base em histórico, comportamento da procura, performance de marcas e projeções de venda.
Recomendar melhorias de sortido, profundidade de compra, reposição, transferências e estratégias de markdown.
Avaliar desempenho de marcas e fornecedores, antecipar desvios face aos objetivos e acompanhar o efeito das decisões implementadas.

3. Otimização de inventário omnicanal

Avaliar a distribuição de stock entre diferentes lojas e canais e propor alocações que maximizem disponibilidade e rentabilidade.
Identificar excesso de stock, slow movers e oportunidades de redistribuição, equilibrando nível de serviço e capital investido.
Trabalhar em articulação com Operações para assegurar a implementação e a medição das recomendações.

4. Business intelligence e melhoria contínua

Desenvolver ferramentas de reporting e garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados de vendas e inventário.
Colaborar com as equipas de tecnologia em iniciativas de forecasting, automação e otimização de inventário.
Aplicar pensamento crítico e análise de cenários à identificação de oportunidades de melhoria comercial.

Perfil pretendido
Formação superior em Gestão, Economia, Engenharia, Business Analytics ou área quantitativa relevante.
3 a 5 anos de experiência em análise de negócio, planeamento comercial, merchandising, gestão de inventário ou funções analíticas comparáveis.
Capacidade analítica muito elevada, raciocínio estruturado e forte aptidão para análise estratégica e resolução de problemas.
Domínio avançado de Excel e capacidade de transformar conjuntos de dados complexos em conclusões e propostas concretas.
Boa compreensão de indicadores comerciais, rentabilidade e trade-offs entre vendas, margem e stock.
Autonomia, rigor, proatividade e capacidade de comunicar recomendações a interlocutores não técnicos.
Português fluente e bom domínio de inglês. Não é necessária experiência prévia em moda.




Competências valorizadas (nice to have)

·      Experiência com ERP Primavera, especialmente em contextos de retalho e inventário.

·      Conhecimentos de Power BI, ferramentas de BI ou plataformas de reporting.

·      Experiência em forecasting, análise estatística, modelos de alocação de stock ou automação.

Description:
M/F




Business Analyst | E-Commerce




A Parfois procura um Business Analyst para integrar a equipa de Analytics & Strategy do E-Commerce. A função tem como objetivo apoiar as decisões de negócio do canal online através da análise: perceber o que está a acontecer, porquê, e o que fazer a seguir.

É uma função com contacto com diferentes áreas do E-Commerce, das vendas ao investimento em média e ao planeamento.

Procuramos alguém com raciocínio rápido, sentido crítico e que não aceita um número sem perceber de onde vem.




Principais responsabilidades

· Desenvolver análises de apoio à tomada de decisão no E-Commerce, com recomendações claras para as equipas de negócio.

· Analisar a performance dos diferentes canais de aquisição e retenção (paid media, orgânico, CRM, marketplaces) e o seu contributo para as vendas.

· Apoiar a equipa de Paid Media com simulações de investimento, cenários de realocação entre mercados e canais, e estudos de elasticidade (quanto cresce a venda quando o investimento aumenta).

· Construir forecasts, business plans e cálculos de apoio à decisão, por exemplo para a abertura de novos mercados ou marketplaces, políticas de portes ou campanhas promocionais.

· Acompanhar indicadores de vendas, tráfego e conversão por mercado e canal, identificando tendências, desvios e oportunidades.

· Apoiar o desenvolvimento de dashboards e a automatização de reporting, assegurando a consistência e a qualidade dos dados.

· Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipas de Paid Media, Marketing, Marketplaces e Controlo de Gestão.




Requisitos

· 2 a 3 anos de experiência em análise de negócio ou de dados, idealmente em E-Commerce, retalho ou marketing digital.

· Conhecimentos de SQL (escrever e adaptar queries de forma autónoma).

· Excel avançado.

· Bons conhecimentos de inglês e espanhol.

· Capacidade de estruturar um problema de negócio, relacionar dados e comunicar conclusões de forma clara.

· Perfil analítico, rigoroso e autónomo, com curiosidade e orientação para resultados.







Valorizamos

· Experiência em paid media (Google Ads, Meta Ads) e GA4.

· Experiência com ferramentas de visualização, como Power BI ou Looker Studio.

· Experiência em business cases ou modelos financeiros.

· Experiência em moda ou retalho.

Title: Global People Analytics Specialist
Description:
COFCO International is a global agri-business with a clear vision, strong values and a positive culture, focused on being a leader in the global grains, oilseeds and sugar supply chains. We provide the food the world needs in a responsible way. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we are ambitious, with the right structures and culture to meet the world's increasing and changing needs. With 12,000+ people in 35 countries, our global portfolio includes assets across the Americas, Europe, Africa, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We trade with over 50 nations, while providing farmers unique direct access to the growing Chinese market.

You will support to drive the evolution of global People Analytics capabilities through the design of scalable analytics products, advanced workforce and compensation analytics, and predictive insights that enable proactive business decisions. Championing the globalization and standardization of people processes, methodologies, and reporting frameworks, ensuring consistent, data-driven decision-making, operational excellence, and strategic workforce outcomes across the organization.

Responsibilities

People Analytics & Workforce Insights


Develop and maintain global people analytics dashboards, reports, and KPIs to provide actionable workforce insights.
Analyze workforce trends, including headcount, turnover, hiring, talent movement, diversity, and organizational effectiveness.
Translate complex people data into meaningful recommendations that support HR and business decision-making.
Deliver executive-level reporting and presentations for senior leadership and key stakeholders.


Compensation Planning & Analytics


Support global compensation planning processes through data analysis, modeling, and reporting.
Provide insights on compensation trends, salary positioning, pay equity, and workforce cost management.
Develop analytics and reporting frameworks to support annual compensation reviews and reward-related decisions.


Technology, Automation & Data Governance


Leverage HR technologies, analytics tools, and automation solutions to improve reporting efficiency and user experience.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance through strong governance practices and controls.
Collaborate with HRIS and technology teams to optimize data structures, reporting capabilities, and system performance.
Drive the standardization and globalization of people analytics, workforce planning, and compensation planning processes across the organization.


What does it take to be successfull in this role:


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Human Resources, Business Administration, Statistics, Finance, or a related field.
Advanced certification in People Analytics or Workforce Planning is a plus.
3+ years of experience in HR analytics, workforce planning, or compensation analysis.
Strong knowledge of HR data visualization tools (Power BI, SAC for Planning, SAP SuccessFactors People Analytics).
Data Analytics & Visualization: Ability to develop HR dashboards and reports for decision-making.
Technology Proficiency: Experience using SAP SuccessFactors, SAC for Planning, and Power BI.
Problem-Solving & Initiative: Ability to analyze complex HR data and provide insights.
Stakeholder Communication: Ability to collaborate with HR, Finance, and IT teams.
Process Improvement Focus: Experience in automating HR analytics and workforce planning.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and data integrity.
HR Data Governance & Compliance: Ensuring data accuracy and regulatory adherence.
Predictive Analytics & Workforce Insights: Using data-driven methods to anticipate workforce trends.


COFCO International is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Data Engineer & Analyst
Description:
Snapshot of your day

At Siemens Energy, we are building the next-generation HR Data Platform - a global foundation for data consolidation, governance, and analytics. We are looking for a hybrid Data Engineer & Analyst who can bridge the gap between raw data infrastructure and business intelligence.

In this role, you will own the full data lifecycle: from maintaining the consolidation layer and pipelines of our HR Data Hub to designing the final reporting solutions that empower strategic workforce decisions. You will ensure our data is not only technically sound but also accessible and insightful for business stakeholders.

How You’ll Make a Difference


Data Pipeline & Transformation Management: Design and maintain the transformation layer (using dbt and SQL) for the Internal Platform, ensuring raw data is effectively consolidated and modeled for downstream use
Analytics & Dashboarding: Develop and optimize dashboards (PowerBI) to provide key insights for HR and Operations units, directly supporting strategic business decisions
Data Quality & Governance: Act as a guardian for data integrity by implementing governance practices and monitoring data quality patterns to find and fix common issues in structured and unstructured data
Legacy Migration & Optimization: Lead or support migration projects to move legacy data pipelines to modern cloud infrastructure, aiming to eliminate technical debt, reduce costs, and restore stakeholder trust
Process Automation: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive data processing and reporting tasks (using Python or SQL procedures), reducing manual handling time for the HR team
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Establish clear documentation for data models and processes, creating a central knowledge base to ensure continuity and team alignment



What You Bring


Hybrid Experience: Proven cross-industry experience acting as both a Data Engineer and Data Analyst, with the ability to navigate complex pipelines and deliver business-facing insights
Core Engineering Stack: Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and Python for data manipulation, along with experience in modern Data Warehousing (Snowflake)
Transformation & Visualization: Proficiency with dbt for data transformation and major visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar)
Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to troubleshooting, with experience in navigating complex or legacy data environments and driving infrastructure improvements
Communication: Fluent in English (C2 level preferred) with the ability to translate technical data concepts into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders
Education: Background in Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field



About The Team

You will be working within the Human Resources function – People Systems and Services, a truly global and diverse team of specialists with an open mindset, responsible for guaranteeing operational performance and budget alignment of HR Systems & Services, ensuring, and maintaining fit-for-purpose HR systems and processes, safeguarding end-to-end delivery while promoting Siemens Energy digital transformation. You will get all the trust and empowerment to be successful.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits


Competitive salary and meal allowance
Fair compensation for international work
Health insurance coverage
Remote work permitted within the country
Additional 5 “Pontes” days off and Birthday off if it falls on a weekday, when not abroad (only applies for Portugal)
Among others

Title: Analytics Engineer Mid
Description:
As a Mid-Level Analytics Engineer, you will support the development of Körber’s marketing analytics and reporting capabilities in a modern, AI-driven environment. Working closely with the data team, you will complete defined tasks in Databricks, contribute to AI agents that let users ask natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, and support selected reporting work in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric when needed. The role combines hands-on implementation with ad hoc analysis. You will need to understand relevant business logic so that your work is accurate, useful, and aligned with the intended reporting outcome. Our technology environment includes Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, AI/ML services, and a central data lake.

Your role in our team


Implement SQL queries, data models, and reporting components in Databricks based on defined requirements.
Contribute to AI agents for natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, including prompt design, retrieval, testing, and evaluation.
Perform ad hoc analyses and data checks, applying relevant business logic and documenting assumptions and results.
Support the migration of selected reporting use cases from Power BI to Databricks and occasionally maintain or enhance reports in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric.
Identify data quality issues, follow team standards for documentation and development, and collaborate with the data team to resolve open questions.


Your profile


Practical experience with SQL and Databricks or a similar cloud data platform.
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, agent evaluation, or similar AI application patterns.
Genuine interest in AI, with the motivation to learn, experiment, and develop further in AI-assisted analytics.
Understanding of data analysis fundamentals and the ability to apply business logic to marketing, website, campaign, or CRM data.
Familiarity with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, including reports, datasets, or data models, to support occasional reporting tasks.
Reliable and collaborative working style, with the ability to complete assigned tasks, ask effective questions, and communicate clearly within the data team.


We offer you


Possibility of Working from Home – we care about results not locations;
Training Budget for each employee – we care about the growth of our people;
Private Health Insurance – we care about health on and off working hours;
3 Additional Vacation Days – we care about free time;
Fresh fruits – we care about your daily dose of vitamins;
Fresh coffee, tea or water – we care about boosting your day.
A home for passionate people who innovate, collaborate and love what they do;
An environment where the team thinks and acts entrepreneurial;
An international and dynamic working atmosphere with cross-functional teams;
The opportunity to take more responsibility and develop your career.


Recruitment Team

For questions please contact us via Koerbercampusporto.recruitment@koerber.com Please apply exclusively via the “Apply now” button.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity, and any other protected status.

This position is covered by the Collective Labour Agreement (Contrato Coletivo de Trabalho da FETESE).

Title: CRM Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a CRM Analyst with 2-3 years of experience to join our Digital Commerce team in our Digital Campus in Porto.

Who We Are

We are Metyis, a forward-thinking, global company that develops and delivers solutions around Big Data, Digital Commerce, Marketing and Design and provides Advisory services. We have offices in 15 locations with a talent pool of 1000+ employees and more than 50 nationalities, dedicated to creating long-lasting impact and growth for our business partners and clients.

Together with HUGO BOSS, our esteemed business partner, we have embarked on a joint venture and created the HUGO BOSS Digital Campus, dedicated to increasing the data analytics, eCommerce and technology capabilities of the company and boosting digital sales. The HUGO BOSS Digital Campus employees will help create a state-of-the-art data architecture infrastructure, advanced business analytics, and the development and enhancement of HUGO BOSS’ eCommerce platform and services.

This collaborative environment will provide the capabilities required for HUGO BOSS to maximise data usage and support its growth trajectory towards becoming the leading premium tech-driven fashion platform worldwide.

What We Offer


Develop your professional career by shaping personalized, customer-centric experiences across omnichannel touchpoints.
Accelerate digital transformation and business growth through omnichannel marketing expertise, advanced technology, and data-driven strategies.
Drive customer engagement, conversion, and lifetime value by designing, scaling, and optimizing personalized customer journeys.



What You Will Do


Be responsible for steering CRM strategy and execution in assigned markets to drive member base growth, retention, and loyalty.
Drive business success across multiple markets by combining strategic thinking, market expertise and CRM knowledge.
Acts as the main CRM contact for local markets, building strong relationships with Retail and Marketing.
Translates business objectives into CRM goals, KPIs, and reporting, enabling markets to manage their own performance.
Monitors market performance (daily/weekly/monthly), conducts KPI analyses, and leads regular review meetings.
Provides consulting on CRM tools, analytical models, campaigns, and outreach processes, ensuring correct implementation.
Owns CRM training and internal communication (training materials, CRM University, news formats), in alignment with global teams.
Leads market execution of Global Commerce Engagement projects (market collaboration, training concepts).



What You’ll Bring


2-3 years of experience in CRM, customer loyalty, or customer experience, ideally in retail or fashion/luxury.
Strong analytical skills (KPI analysis, interpreting data, deriving actions).
Solid understanding of CRM tools, customer databases, segmentation and outreach logic.
Ability to translate business goals into CRM strategies, campaigns and concrete action plans.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; comfortable working with markets, Retail and Marketing.
Strong communication skills and strong presentation and training skills (designing and delivering trainings, creating materials).
Proficient in Excel Sheets and BI tools (e.g. BIS, dashboards); PowerPoint/Slides for presentations.
